title: 2 Construction Managers (Grand Junction, CO)
description:
Location: Lakewood,Colorado,United States

Planate Management Group (PMG) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) headquartered in Alexandria, Virginia, and Orlando, Florida USA with a technical support center in South East Asia and East Africa, that provides program management and facilities engineering services worldwide. Planate is a small business provider of planning, design, infrastructure management, technical consulting, engineering, and construction management services in support of the US Department of Defense (DOD) and its Service (Army, Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps) missions, along with other US federal agencies, all over the world.

We are seeking Construction Managers to support the VA Hospital in Grand Junction, Colorado, under contract with Davenergy. You will provide construction oversight and management to ensure compliance with contractual requirements. You will represent Planate to the client, provide sound technical advice and information as required. You will ensure coordination between construction activities and the facility occupants. You will perform inspections, identify risks and issues and recommend corrective action. You will provide technical input as required for design reviews, constructability and procurement of materials ad equipment. This position supports multiple construction projects and requires on-site work at a medical facility in Grand Junction, Colorado.

Planate Management Group (PMG), in partnership with Davenergy Solutions, provides engineering and construction management support services to the VA Western Colorado Health Care System. This position is based on-site in Grand Junction, Colorado.

Key responsibilities:

  • Provide leadership and mentorship in the completion of construction work and the documentation and inspection of construction quality
  • Monitor the means and methods of the construction contractor, providing oversight and direction to ensure compliance with contractual, safety and quality requirements
  • Review contractor submittals for compliance, provides approval and/ or guidance to the government
  • Perform field inspections to evaluate the work performed and materials used and verify quality of workmanship,
  • Ensure compliance with the design, specifications, standards and applicable codes and regulations;
  • Identify and track deficiencies and deviations from plans; works with construction team to mitigate and resolve
  • Review and implement construction safety and quality programs, ensure regulations on health, safety and the environment (HSE)
  • Review project plans and specifications for technical soundness and determine practicability from a construction management standpoint
  • Provide design input and oversight related to constructability and other engineering disciplines
  • Visit project sites to obtain information on facility/site conditions and develop recommendations during project development
  • Support the development of procurement packages for design and construction
  • Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.

Qualifications to be successful in the role:

  • Degree in Civil or equivalent experience related to job duties and functions.
  • Three (3) or more years of civil/construction management work experience preferably gained from healthcare or hospital facilities.
  • Previous experience with the Department of Veterans Affairs is an advantage.
  • Knowledgeable in construction scheduling methods and of building and construction crafts.
  • Good English communication both written and oral.
  • Proficient in using Microsoft Office suites.

Why Planate?

Planate Management Group is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Joining the Planate team opens you to an experience working for a Global company where you are among a team that is considered a premier trusted partner for planning, design, engineering, asset management, and professional service solutions anytime, anywhere. We Take Care of Our Own; Personally, and Profession.

Full-time employees enjoy the following benefits:

  • Medical insurance/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • 401K plan eligibility upon hire
  • Health and Savings Account plan
  • Life/AD&D Insurance Coverage
  • Short-Term Disability Insurance Coverage
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Time Off
  • Wellness Offering
  • Training and Development
  • License/Certification support
  • Recognition and Rewards program
  • Travel Insurance

We’d love for you to be a part of our Global workforce, helping us serve as an effective and integrated partner to advance every client's mission!

title: Intermediate Level Project Manager
description:
Evolver is an information technology, cybersecurity, and digital transformation company supporting national defense, federal civilian agencies, and Fortune 500 organizations. We help customers secure critical systems, modernize enterprise technology, and solve complex operational challenges through integrated technology capabilities spanning cybersecurity, enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud, software development, data analytics, legal technology and eDiscovery, applied AI, and electronic security systems. Our teams combine deep technical expertise with mission understanding to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions that advance performance in high-stakes environments.

Evolver is looking for an Intermediate Level Project Manager, to support an existing Federal Program.

This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days a week in the office in Albuquerque, NM and 2 days a week from home.

Responsibilities:

Provides project management leadership and services in support of the goal and objective of the PWS, as required by the COR. Oversees and manages compliance activities of project management teams, daily operations, client/customer relationships, has responsibility for the quality of deliverables, and develops, monitors, and reports on project objectives, budget, and schedule status and performance. The Project Manager is responsible for the technical, contractual, administrative, and financial aspects of the project(s) as assigned by the Government Task Manager (GTM). Responsible for identifying, proposing resolutions, and resolving project management issues in collaboration with applicable federal staff. Responsible for managing one or more projects, and successfully implements project(s) and associated services, in accordance with the task order, federal laws, regulations and procedures.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5 years of Project Management experience
  • PMP certification
  • 3 years of experience with IT Project Management processes including, but not limited to, industry standard Project Management principles and practices such as those defined by the PMI in the PMBOK.
  • 2 years of experience in Agile methodology
  • 3 years of experience with MS Visio
  • 2 years of experience with Azure DevOps (ADO)
  • Must be a US Citizen with ability to obtain Public Trust Clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3 years of experience with Waterfall methodology
  • 3 years of experience with Agile Methodology
  • Hands-on experience in an Agile transformation
  • 5 years of experience with IT Project Management processes including, but not limited to, industry standard Project Management principles and practices such as those defined by the PMI in the PMBOK.
  • Knowledge of and experience with FEA, CPIC, SDLC, IT Security Management, and Risk Management.
  • Knowledge of and experience with federal IT Investment laws, regulations and process including, but not limited to, FITARA, the Clinger-Cohen Act of 1996, Title III of the E-Government Act of 2002, and FISMA. Familiarity with the federal laws, regulations and circulars listed in subsequent parts of this PWS.
  • Proven ability to review and analyze cost, schedule, and performance requirements for federal IT investments.
  • Knowledge of OMB reporting requirements and adapting internal reporting to align with applicable external.
  • Ability to apply consistent management approaches to IT Portfolio Management that increases the quality of data through best practices and documentation.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and leadership skills

Evolver is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all job seekers. It is the policy of Evolver not to discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, age, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic factors, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, military/veteran status, or any other factor protected by law.

Actual salary will depend on factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, market and work location. Evolver offers competitive benefits, including health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), flexible spending account, and paid leave (including PTO and parental leave) in accordance with our applicable plans and policies.

title: Senior Manager, Strategic Finance
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Finance based in the United States.

The Senior Manager, Strategic Finance will play a pivotal role in guiding financial planning, business performance, and strategic decision-making across a global digital subscription and advertising business. This position combines long-range financial strategy with hands-on forecasting, budgeting, and business partnership. You will collaborate closely with senior leaders to translate financial data into actionable insights, identify growth opportunities, and manage risks. By improving financial models, reporting frameworks, and planning processes, you will help the organization scale efficiently and make informed investment decisions. The role also partners with finance, accounting, and executive teams on monthly reporting, leadership updates, and board-level communications. This is an opportunity for an experienced finance professional to influence business strategy, mentor emerging talent, and drive measurable impact in a remote-first, technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead annual budgeting and long-range financial planning for global subscription services and advertising business lines, aligning financial targets with strategic priorities.

  • Partner with business leaders to develop monthly forecasts, analyze actual results against expectations, identify variances, and assess emerging financial risks and growth opportunities.

  • Monitor spending against approved budgets and provide recommendations that support financial discipline, resource allocation, and operational efficiency.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and functional leaders, providing financial guidance that connects business performance with broader organizational objectives.

  • Develop strategic financial models, scenario analyses, and decision-making frameworks to evaluate business opportunities, investment priorities, and potential outcomes.

  • Collaborate with finance and accounting teams on month-end close activities, financial reporting, executive presentations, and board communications.

  • Improve forecasting and budgeting processes to increase accuracy, consistency, scalability, and efficiency across the organization.

  • Design new analytical tools, reporting methods, and financial processes while evaluating and enhancing existing systems to deliver timely, actionable business insights.

  • Translate complex financial information into clear recommendations that help leadership understand performance drivers, evaluate trade-offs, and make informed decisions.

  • Mentor and develop junior finance professionals, strengthening their analytical capabilities and helping them become effective strategic business partners.

  • Support additional financial planning and strategic initiatives as business needs evolve.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

    • At least 7 years of progressively responsible professional experience in the position offered or a related strategic finance role.

    • Strong understanding of financial planning and analysis, including annual budgeting, long-range planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and performance reporting.

    • Demonstrated ability to build financial models and conduct scenario analyses that support strategic decisions and business planning.

    • Experience partnering with business leaders to interpret financial results, identify risks and opportunities, and develop practical recommendations.

    • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to turn complex financial data into clear, relevant, and actionable insights.

    • Experience improving financial planning processes, reporting tools, analytical frameworks, or operational workflows to support efficiency and scalability.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively with finance, accounting, and cross-functional teams on reporting cycles, executive materials, and strategic initiatives.

    • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain financial concepts to stakeholders with varying levels of financial expertise.

    • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy.

    • Proven relationship-building and influencing skills, with the ability to establish credibility with senior stakeholders and support decisions across a complex organization.

    • Experience mentoring or developing junior team members and fostering a collaborative, high-performance environment.

    • Adaptability, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to problem-solving in a dynamic, technology-driven business.

    • Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment and collaborate with colleagues across teams and locations.

      • Benefits:

      • Annual base salary: $298,022 USD. Final compensation may vary based on relevant experience, job-related knowledge, skills, and geographic location, with US locations classified into compensation tiers.

      • Equity compensation: Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) included as part of the total compensation package.

      • Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with employee premiums fully covered.

      • Insurance protection: Life and disability insurance plans.

      • Retirement savings: 401(k) plan with a company matching program.

      • Paid parental leave: Support for employees welcoming a child.

      • Flexible time off: Flexible paid time off, companywide holidays, and scheduled summer and winter shutdowns.

      • Mental wellness support: Access to a mental wellness program and Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

      • Learning and development: Programs designed to support continued professional growth and skill development.

      • Remote-work support: Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support to help employees maintain a productive remote working environment.

      • Membership perks: Complimentary premium membership and tracking devices.

      • Remote-first culture: The position can be performed remotely within the United States, offering flexibility in where you work.

      • Strategic impact: The opportunity to influence financial planning, business strategy, and investment decisions within a growing digital technology environment.

title: Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps based in United Arab Emirates.

As a Senior Technical Trainer, you will combine hands-on DevOps expertise with a passion for teaching to develop practical, engaging courses on AI-powered engineering workflows. You will help engineers understand how to apply AI agents, coding assistants, and modern AI tools to real-world infrastructure and automation challenges. Working alongside a curriculum team and experienced technical educators, you will design lessons, develop hands-on lab specifications, and record clear, compelling instructional videos. This remote freelance opportunity begins with a paid course project, typically lasting around three months, with the potential for ongoing projects or a full-time position. You will have the flexibility to work alongside existing commitments while contributing your technical knowledge to a global engineering community. The ideal candidate is a practising DevOps engineer who can simplify complex concepts, communicate confidently on camera, and create learning experiences that make advanced technologies accessible.

Accountabilities

  • Design and develop technical courses

    • Collaborate with the curriculum team to define course structure, learning objectives, lesson sequences, and practical lab exercises focused on AI for DevOps.

    • Develop content that demonstrates how engineers use AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation in real infrastructure environments.

    • Ensure lessons are technically accurate, relevant, practical, and aligned with the needs of working engineers.

    • Create engaging instructional content

      • Write concise, story-driven video scripts designed to explain technical concepts clearly, with individual lessons typically lasting around six minutes.

      • Use AI tools where helpful during drafting while ensuring the final scripts reflect your own voice, expertise, and teaching style.

      • Narrate and present lessons confidently in English, making complex technical topics approachable for learners at different experience levels.

      • Develop and validate hands-on labs

        • Write detailed specifications for practical labs that demonstrate real-world DevOps and AI workflows.

        • Collaborate with the dedicated labs team responsible for building the lab environments.

        • Test completed labs, validate technical accuracy, and ensure exercises deliver the intended learning outcomes.

        • Record demonstrations and walkthroughs explaining how to complete lab exercises and solve practical challenges.

        • Collaborate on quality and editorial development

          • Work closely with curriculum and production teams throughout the course development process.

          • Incorporate structured editorial feedback, particularly during the initial course section, to align content with established teaching standards.

          • Participate in regular team syncs and maintain communication through collaboration tools such as Slack.

          • Focus on technical expertise, teaching, scripting, and recording while the production team manages video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

            • Requirements:

            • Hands-on DevOps and infrastructure experience

              • Strong practical knowledge of Linux, containers, Kubernetes, at least one major cloud platform, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (IaC).

              • Experience building, operating, and maintaining infrastructure rather than relying solely on theoretical knowledge.

              • The ability to demonstrate real engineering workflows and translate practical experience into effective learning materials.

              • Current experience with AI technologies

                • Practical experience using AI tools in engineering work, including AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation.

                • Genuine curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and a commitment to staying current with new tools and techniques.

                • The ability to explain how AI can support infrastructure engineering and DevOps workflows; deep specialization in AI research is not required.

                • Teaching and communication skills

                  • A demonstrated passion for teaching, supported by experience creating courses, publishing tutorials, delivering talks or workshops, mentoring colleagues, or sharing technical knowledge with a community.

                  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, naturally, and confidently on camera.

                  • Strong storytelling skills and the ability to break down complex technical concepts into simple, structured explanations.

                  • Empathy for learners, particularly beginners, and an understanding of how to make technical material engaging and accessible.

                  • Collaboration and adaptability

                    • Willingness to follow an established teaching methodology and incorporate constructive editorial feedback.

                    • Ability to work independently, organize deliverables, and meet an agreed project schedule.

                    • Comfort working remotely with a distributed team, including participation in weekly syncs and some time-zone overlap with colleagues based in Europe and Asia.

                    • Additional qualifications considered an advantage

                      • Previously published online courses on platforms such as Udemy or Pluralsight, or experience authoring a technical book.

                      • Experience speaking at conferences or meetups, maintaining a technical YouTube channel or blog, or contributing to technical communities.

                      • Community credentials or roles such as CNCF Ambassador, AWS Community Builder, or Microsoft MVP.

                      • Relevant Kubernetes certifications, including CKA, CKAD, or CKS, or recognition such as Kubestronaut.

                      • Cloud certifications from providers such as AWS or Microsoft Azure.

                        • Benefits:

                        • Competitive fixed fee per course, agreed upfront based on course length and topic complexity, with higher compensation for advanced topics and exceptional instructors.

                        • Paid freelance project that can be completed alongside an existing job, with no fixed weekly-hour requirement.

                        • A typical initial project duration of approximately three months, with a mutually agreed delivery plan.

                        • Potential to progress to a full-time role or take on additional course projects based on mutual fit.

                        • Fully remote working arrangements with flexible hours.

                        • Opportunity to collaborate with a global technical education team and reach a community of more than one million engineers.

                        • Dedicated production support for video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and course publishing, allowing you to focus on teaching and technical content.

                        • Opportunity to share your expertise in AI, DevOps, cloud, and Kubernetes through practical, hands-on education.

title: Prescription Benefit Representative
description:
TrueScripts Management Services is a pharmacist-founded, fully transparent Prescription Benefit Manager that has been revolutionizing the PBM industry since 2014. Our mission is to build lasting relationships by providing prescription benefit expertise at a personal and customized level to ensure optimum value at the lowest possible cost. We are committed to lowering prescription drug spending, achieving clinically effective outcomes, and always delivering Amazing Care. Did we mention Amazing Care? Good! Because this is so much more than just our tagline. It is the foundation upon which our business was built. We believe that Amazing Care starts from within, and our culture is reflective of this philosophy.

Our team members enjoy:

  • A wide range of health insurance options including medical, dental and vision
  • A strong salary and bonus program
  • A robust 401k and company match
  • TrueScripts is transitioning to an ESOP, a team member owned company! Each year team members are allocated shares of stock through our ESOP, a Qualified Retirement plan!
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • A wellness program including financial incentives, chiropractic and massage services, and fitness stipends
  • Dream Manager Program (yes, it’s a real thing!)
  • A cohesive, family-based culture
  • Charitable contributions and volunteer time
  • Lots of celebrations!

Ok, enough about us. Here’s what we need from you: A future team members' values need to align with TrueScripts' core values of Integrity, Respect, Innovation, and Service. This match in value systems is critical for our team's chemistry and continued success. Our culture is positive, and our people possess a ‘can do, proactive attitude. Honesty and transparency are the foundation that we build upon. What sets us apart from our competitors is the programs that we bring, the education that we provide, and the utmost respect for clients and their members to assist them when and where needed.


The Prescription Benefit Representative supports TrueScripts' members in accessing the lowest cost medications through programs. This position is responsible for coordinating the administrative process associated with seeking lowest cost opportunities, communicating with members and healthcare providers, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring applications and follow-up activities are completed timely and accurately.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Work with members to identify lowest cost medications right for them.
  • Conduct outreach to members to gather required information needed to get their medications at lowest cost.
  • Communicate with physician offices, pharmacies, to help get members the right medications.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation within applicable systems and workflows.
  • Monitor cost containment program queues and ensure tasks are completed within established timeframes.
  • Complete refill or renewal outreach as required by individual cost containment programs.
  • Prepare and maintain reports and metrics related to cost containment program activity.
  • Perform administrative duties including faxing, mailing, scanning, data entry, documentation, and other outreach activities.
  • Protect member privacy and maintain confidentiality of all members and patient information.
  • Work collaboratively with Clinical team members to identify opportunities to assist members with medication affordability.
  • Provide a high level of service and compassion when working with members who may be experiencing financial or medication-access challenges.
  • Identify opportunities to improve patient assistance processes, workflows, and the member experience.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Clinical Director.

title: Planner
description:
Join a Growing, Innovative Community in the Heart of Southeast Michigan

Are you passionate about shaping vibrant communities and guiding meaningful development? The City of Novi Planning Department is looking for a talented and motivated Planner or Senior Planner to join our collaborative Plan Review Center team.

In this role, you'll help shape the future of one of Michigan's most dynamic and diverse communities through site plan review, ordinance interpretation, implementation of the Master Plan, and by serving as a trusted resource to residents, businesses, and developers navigating planning projects and procedures.

Located in Novi, in Michigan's thriving Oakland County, our city is home to approximately 67,000 residents and is known for its welcoming neighborhoods, thriving business community, exceptional shopping and dining, award-winning schools, advanced healthcare systems, and outstanding parks and recreation amenities.

This is a professional staff-level opportunity for an experienced planning professional who is analytical, organized, and an exceptional communicator. Working under the direction of the City Planner, you'll manage impactful projects from concept through construction and play a key role in the future growth of our community.

What You'll Do:

As a member of our multi-disciplinary Plan Review Center team, you will:

  • Review site plans and development proposals for compliance with zoning and development regulations.
  • Interpret and apply the Zoning Ordinance, codes, and other applicable regulations.
  • Prepare planning studies, written reports, and professional recommendations.
  • Serve as project manager for proposed development projects, coordinating review comments from City staff and consultants.
  • Guide applicants through the City's review process from initial concept to final construction.
  • Review and process a variety of development applications, including:
    • Site plans
    • Condominiums
    • Rezoning applications
  • Present findings, reports, and recommendations to the Planning Commission and City Council.
  • For Senior Planner candidates: provide leadership support and serve as a substitute for the City Planner when needed.
  • Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8 am to 5 pm, Evening meeting attendence is also required on occasion.

What We're Looking For:

Planner – Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university in:
    • Urban Planning
    • Urban Studies
    • Architecture
    • Landscape Architecture
    • Public Administration
    • or a related field
  • Graduate Degree and/or American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) certification preferred
  • Prior municipal planning experience preferred
  • Valid Michigan driver's license

Senior Planner – Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university in:
    • Urban Planning
    • Urban Studies
    • Architecture
    • Landscape Architecture
    • Public Administration
    • or a related field
  • Master's Degree or at least 5 years of directly applicable experience
  • AICP certification required
  • Minimum of 2 years of professional planning experience with the City of Novi in the Planner position, or with a comparable community
  • Demonstrated experience substituting for the City Planner in:
    • Planning Commission committee meetings
    • Full Planning Commission meetings
    • City Council meetings
    • or similar meetings in a comparable community
  • Valid Michigan driver's license

Compensation & Benefits:

Salary: Planner Salary Range: $58,500 – $75,500, depending on qualifications, Applicants who qualify for Senior Planner consideration could anticipate a higher salary range, plus a comprehensive benefits package, including:

Generous Time Off

  • 14 paid holidays annually

Health & Wellness

  • Cafeteria Health Insurance Plan
  • Dental insurance provided by the City
  • Wellness Reimbursement Program
  • Robust Employee Wellness & Engagement Program

Financial Security

  • Life insurance provided by the City
  • 401(a) retirement plan
  • Retiree Health Savings Account with employer contribution
  • Optional Roth IRA & 457 retirement plans

Growth & Development

  • Tuition reimbursement program
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness eligibility
  • Personal and professional development training opportunities

Apply Today

If you're ready to make a lasting impact in a thriving and forward-thinking community, we'd love to hear from you.

All offers of employment are contingent upon passing a background check, physical examination, and drug screen (including marijuana testing).

Questions about the position or requests for application accommodations can be directed to the City of Novi Human Resources Department at humanresources@cityofnovi.org or 248-347-0452.

The promotion of diversity is fueled by the desire to seek equality of opportunity for all people. The City of Novi is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

title: Shipping Clerk I
description:
Our Marine organization is a trusted provider of innovative solutions for the worldwide boating and boat building industry, and we recently expanded our scope to lead the boating industry into an electrified future. Dometic has won numerous NMMA Innovation Awards over the years, and we are always striving for new ways to make boating easier, safer, and more enjoyable.

Dometic Marine’s facility in Sparta, TN produces roto-molded fuel and ballast tanks and other roto-molded products for industrial applications. The site also manufactures select marine furniture, aluminum tanks, blow-molded portable tanks, and sanitation systems.

We are on a journey of continuous growth – now looking for our next star – a passionate Shipping Clerk. This position reports to the Warehouse Supervisor and will work in Sparta, TN.

About the position

As Shipping Clerk of the Sparta team, you will be involved in processing shipments and confirming packing slips are correct. In this position you will use the internet to create bills of lading, figure freight charges and select carriers. This position requires the use of phone, email and internet to post shipments, get shipping instructions, and obtain bill of lading. The shipping clerk will also assist with other duties and requirements as needed.

Your Main Responsibilities

  • Attention to detail
  • Must be able to communicate with carriers, customers, and vendors
  • Use of internet for filling out paperwork and setting up shipments with carriers
  • Use of email to communicate with carriers and logistics companies
  • Ability to use Mapics to create shipments, and check inventory.
  • Processing Shipments
  • Classifying Freight
  • Create and/or obtain Bill of Lading and Commercial Invoices
  • May be assigned to perform other duties as requested

You are offered an interesting role in a dynamic, fast-paced and global environment with great opportunities to grow, evolve with the company and take on new challenges.

  • Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Disability insurance (STD/LTD)
  • 401 (k) with company match
  • PTO
  • Company defined holidays and two floating holidays for you to use as you choose
  • Paid maternity/paternity leave
  • Tuition assistance
  • Membership reimbursement (wholesale club and gym)
  • Employee discounts on our incredible products
  • Opportunities to make an impact

Skills & Requirements

A suitable background would be a solid experience within manufacturing and shipping/receiving as well as the following qualifications and experiences:

  • Previous warehouse, shipping, receiving, or logistics experience
  • Ability to accurately prepare shipping documents, labels, and packing slips
  • Experience with ERP systems, inventory management software or Microsoft office is a plus
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift throughout the shift as needed
  • Basic Math skills for counting inventory and verifying shipments
  • Self-starter and “Can do” attitude is a must!

A relevant combination of education and experience may also be considered.

To be successful in this role, we believe that you possess the following skills, competencies & characteristics:

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Excellent Verbal and written communication skills
  • Dependable with a strong work ethic
  • Critical thinking and Problem-Solving Skills

Dometic’s Core Values

To thrive and succeed in this role, you understand the importance of our core values – Together We build our future, We play to win, We embrace change and We walk the talk; these values reflect the heart and soul of Dometic and they define what it takes to work here and how we do things.

Are you our next star? Then we would love to see your application. Selection is being made on a running basis. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Taylor Webb, Human Resources Business Partner, at taylor.webb@dometic.com

Dometic is passionate about building together an inclusive and equitable working environment, that respects individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that diversity enables us to thrive across our differences. Be yourself and join us!

Dometic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Dometic evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: RT Technician - Level II - Corpus Christi, TX
description:
Turner Industries is a fully diversified industrial contractor. We help move the world forward by providing responsive, innovative solutions designed to increase plant production, reduce costs, reduce downtime, and even prevent shutdowns. Headquartered in Baton Rouge, LA, Turner Industries has over 20,000 employees with offices and job sites across the United States. Our single-solution approach in the petrochemical, refining, energy, pulp and paper, and related industries has made Turner one of the nation's top industrial contractors and earned us the No. 1 spot on ABC's 2024 Top Performers list. People are at the heart of everything we do. Their safety, security, and satisfaction have always been our top priorities. For proof, look no further than our strong working relationships and extraordinary workforce.

We are looking for an experienced RT Technician - Level II for work around the Corpus Christi, TX area. Required duties are associated with NDE of materials per the referencing code. The primary responsibilities of this role will include running an X-ray crew performing conventional X-ray.

Essential Qualifications:

  • Must hold level II RT certification
  • UT and PT level II certifications preferred
  • Documentation needed: NDE classroom training records, OJT hours, past certifications, and resume
  • Minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Must have a valid driver's license
  • Must possess excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational and problem solving skills
  • Post-offer drug/alcohol screen and physical evaluation.
  • Applicant/employee must not pose a direct threat to the health or safety of others in the workplace

Compensation

title: Software Engineer C++ CUDA – CFD & HPC (F/M)
description:
Powered by the 3DEXPERIENCE® platform, SIMULIA delivers realistic simulation applications that enable users to better understand and predict the behavior of the world around us.

SIMULIA applications accelerate the evaluation of the performance, reliability and safety of materials and products, helping our customers make informed decisions before committing to physical prototypes.

At Dassault Systèmes, we empower our employees and support their passion for changing the world and building the future. Join us and help design new horizons through the power of 3DEXPERIENCE virtual universes!

Position based in Madrid, Spain

Your missions :
As a Software Engineer, you will design, develop and continuously improve software to deliver high-quality applications, services and technologies that provide value to end users.

You will contribute to improving our solutions based on usage and user feedback, while working on advanced technologies at the intersection of software development, simulation and High Performance Computing.

Rapid execution of complex simulations is a key component of the SIMULIA MODSIM approach and an essential requirement for competitive simulation solutions.

To accelerate the deployment of multi-GPU simulation solutions, we are looking for a Software Engineer to join a team focused on High Performance Computing (HPC), with a particular emphasis on GPU development for fluid simulation technologies.

In this role, you will contribute to the development and optimization of software running on GPU-based computing architectures. You will work with C++ and CUDA and collaborate with specialists from different scientific and technical backgrounds to address complex simulation challenges.

You will have the opportunity to work on CFD algorithms and approaches, including one or more of the following:

* Lattice Boltzmann methods;
* Continuum approaches to Navier-Stokes, including finite volume or finite element methods;
* Lagrangian formulations, such as SPH or DEM;
* Ray tracing methods;
* Linear equation solvers.

A strong analytical mindset and a solid mathematical background will help you address complex technical challenges. Knowledge of Computational Fluid Dynamics algorithms and experience implementing physical models within commercial or academic CFD infrastructures will be valuable assets.

Your qualifications :
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Mathematics or a related field, with 6 years of relevant coding or software development experience


Hands-on professional or academic experience developing in C++ and CUDA on Linux
Background in scientific programming and familiarity with High Performance Computing (HPC)
Strong analytical skills and a solid mathematical background
Knowledge of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and fluid flow simulation is a plus
Familiarity with one or more fluid simulation approaches, such as Lattice Boltzmann, Navier-Stokes, SPH or DEM, is a plus
Experience contributing to CFD software or implementing physical models within a commercial or academic CFD environment is a plus
Familiarity with modern source code management and DevOps practices
Ability to collaborate effectively with specialists from diverse scientific and technical backgrounds
Curiosity, analytical thinking and a willingness to learn and take on new technical challenges

title: Prior Authorization & Referral Specialist – Athenahealth
description:
University Center for Pain Management is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Prior Authorization & Referral Specialist with strong working knowledge of Athenahealth and the insurance authorization process. This individual will be responsible for coordinating and managing prior authorizations and referrals for diagnostic imaging, medications, procedures, and other medically necessary services.

The ideal candidate understands the complexities of insurance requirements, can navigate Athenahealth efficiently, communicates effectively with insurance companies and healthcare providers, and proactively follows authorization requests through approval or resolution. Experience in pain management, orthopedics, neurology, gastroenterology, or another specialty practice is preferred.


Position Type: Full-Time Monday-Friday 8AM-4:30PM


Key Responsibilities

1. Athenahealth EHR Management

  • Navigate Athenahealth efficiently to manage referrals, authorization requests, patient records, and documentation.
  • Enter, update, and track authorization and referral information accurately in the patient's chart.
  • Monitor pending requests and maintain organized follow-up records.
  • Ensure documentation is complete and available to clinical and administrative staff.
  • Utilize Athenahealth work queues, tasks, and available tracking tools to monitor outstanding authorizations.

2. Diagnostic Imaging Authorizations

  • Obtain prior authorizations for MRI, CT, X-ray, and other diagnostic imaging services as required by insurance plans.
  • Determine insurance-specific requirements, including referrals, clinical documentation, and medical necessity criteria.
  • Coordinate with imaging facilities and insurance companies to obtain authorization numbers and approval dates.
  • Submit supporting clinical documentation and follow up on pending requests.
  • Resolve authorization delays, denials, and requests for additional information.
  • Communicate approval status and scheduling requirements to the appropriate team members.

3. Medication Prior Authorizations

  • Process medication prior authorizations through insurance portals, electronic systems, and telephone communication.
  • Understand formulary requirements, preferred medications, step therapy, quantity limits, and other coverage restrictions.
  • Coordinate with pharmacies, insurance companies, and clinical staff when additional information is needed.
  • Submit required clinical documentation and monitor requests until a determination is received.
  • Assist with appeals and reconsiderations for denied medications, working with the prescribing provider as appropriate.
  • Communicate authorization outcomes and next steps to the clinical team.

4. Referrals and Procedure Authorizations

  • Process specialist referrals and insurance-required authorizations.
  • Verify referral requirements and confirm that necessary documentation is submitted.
  • Obtain authorizations for covered procedures and services, as applicable to the practice.
  • Track expiration dates, approved service limits, and authorization requirements.
  • Coordinate with referring providers, receiving facilities, and insurance representatives to resolve outstanding issues.

5. Insurance Verification and Follow-Up

  • Verify insurance eligibility and benefits relevant to referrals, imaging, medications, and procedures.
  • Identify payer-specific authorization requirements before services are scheduled when possible.
  • Contact commercial insurance plans, Medicare Advantage plans, and other payers as appropriate.
  • Maintain an accurate log of pending, approved, denied, and appealed requests.
  • Escalate complex denials or unresolved cases to the practice manager or clinical team.
  • Communicate delays and authorization status changes promptly to appropriate staff.

6. Denial Management and Compliance

  • Identify reasons for authorization denials and determine the administrative steps needed for resolution.
  • Prepare and submit reconsiderations or appeals using documentation provided or approved by the clinical team.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely documentation of all authorization activities.
  • Protect confidential patient information and comply with HIPAA requirements.
  • Follow payer policies and practice procedures without independently making clinical medical-necessity determinations.

title: PW Water Operator 1
description:
POSITION SUMMARY


The City of Brandon is seeking a motivated, safety-conscious, and dependable Water Operator I (Class D Licensed) to join its Public Works Water Division. Under the general supervision of the Water Supervisor and the direct supervision of the Senior Water Operator, this position performs the operation, maintenance, inspection, repair, and construction of the City’s public water system. Responsibilities include maintaining wells, water distribution mains, service lines, valves, fire hydrants, booster stations, elevated storage tanks, and related infrastructure to ensure the delivery of safe, reliable drinking water in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


· Operate, inspect, maintain, and repair municipal groundwater wells, booster stations, elevated water storage tanks, pressure regulating equipment, and water distribution infrastructure.

· Monitor the City’s water system through routine inspections and SCADA, responding promptly to alarms and abnormal operating conditions.

· Collect bacteriological, chlorine residual, and other required water quality samples in accordance with Mississippi State Department of Health regulations.

· Perform preventive maintenance on pumps, motors, valves, hydrants, meters, generators, and other water system equipment.

· Install, repair, replace, and maintain water mains, water services, valves, fire hydrants, meter boxes, and water meters.

· Investigate and repair water leaks, service interruptions, and water main breaks.

· Exercise valves and flush fire hydrants in accordance with departmental maintenance programs.

· Assist with water line construction, utility relocations, and capital improvement projects.

· Operate excavators, backhoes, skid steers, loaders, dump trucks, trenchers, and other equipment necessary to perform assigned duties.

· Locate underground utilities using utility locating equipment, GIS mapping, and utility records.

· Maintain accurate records of inspections, maintenance activities, work orders, water quality testing, and regulatory documentation.

· Respond to after-hours emergencies, including water outages, line breaks, equipment failures, and other utility emergencies.

· Follow all applicable OSHA safety regulations and departmental safety policies, including trench safety, confined space entry, lockout/tagout procedures, traffic control, and the proper use of personal protective equipment.

· Maintain tools, vehicles, and equipment in a clean and serviceable condition.

· Provide courteous and professional customer service when interacting with residents, contractors, developers, and fellow employees.

· Participate in the department’s rotating on-call schedule.

· Perform other related duties as assigned.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY


The City of Brandon, MS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Selection of position will be made without discrimination for any reason such as race, color, religion, sex, national origin, politics, or marital status.

title: Logistics Analyst- RTI
description:
Logistics Analyst

Full Time, Ft. Belvoir, VA

Secret Clearance

Job Description:

Semper Valens Solutions is looking for a Logistics Analyst to support our team in Ft. Belvoir, VA.

This role will provide logistics support to the Research & Technology Integration (RTI) Directorate, specifically supporting the Business & Operations Facilities and Equipment Branch (FEB). This role contributes directly to the effective management, accountability, and sustainment of RTI facilities and equipment resources.

The candidate will be assigned to the Property Management section within the FEB and will be responsible for supporting government property and asset management activities in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulations. Candidate will support Government-designated property accountability personnel by maintaining data, preparing documentation, coordinating inventories, researching discrepancies, and developing recommendations. Provide subject-matter support for Army logistics platforms, including the Global Combat Support System–Army (GCSS-A) and the Electronic Financial Liability Investigation of Property Loss (eFLIPL) system, as authorized by Government-furnished access and direction.

The position requires close collaboration with RTI leadership, FEB personnel, and supporting organizations to ensure property and logistics processes are executed efficiently, accurately, and in compliance with established standards.

Major Duties and Key Responsibilities

Property Management and Systems Support

  • Provide technical support to Government property accountability personnel in maintaining accurate and timely property records in GCSS-A.
  • Research, compile, validate, and reconcile supporting data for property-book transactions, including receipts, issues, transfers, lateral transfers, turn-ins, and disposition actions.
  • Prepare draft transaction documentation and supporting packages for Government review, validation, certification, and approval.
  • Assist with tracking the status of pending property actions, documentation deficiencies, suspense dates, and reconciliation requirements.
  • Support the preparation, organization, and maintenance of eFLIPL-related records and supporting documentation, as directed by the Government.
  • Conduct research and compile information supporting Government-led eFLIPL or other property-loss actions; the Contractor shall not make findings of negligence, recommend or determine financial liability, serve as an investigating officer, or approve eFLIPL actions.
  • Identify data discrepancies, missing documentation, aging transactions, and potential compliance issues; provide written findings and recommended corrective actions to the Government-designated lead.

Inventory Coordination and Audit-Readiness Support

  • Develop proposed inventory schedules, coordination plans, count sheets, trackers, and status reports for Government approval.
  • Support cyclical, monthly, quarterly, and special inventories across the Directorate.
  • Assist Government personnel in conducting physical counts, reconciling inventory results, documenting discrepancies, and assembling supporting records.
  • Prepare draft documentation, routing packages, and administrative products associated with property accountability and audit-readiness requirements, including as applicable:
    • DA Form 4949, Administrative Adjustment Report
    • DA Form 3161, Request for Issue or Turn-In
    • DA Form 1687, Notice of Delegation of Authority / Signature Card
    • Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) memorandums
    • Property Book Adjustment Memorandums (PBAMs)
  • Maintain electronic and hard-copy files, trackers, and supporting records in accordance with Government-directed records-management procedures.
  • Prepare audit-support packages, reconciliation reports, deficiency trackers, and draft corrective-action recommendations for Government reviews.
  • Support the Government in identifying trends, recurring discrepancies, overdue actions, and potential risks to property accountability or audit readiness.

Regulatory, Policy, and Procedure Support

  • Research and analyze applicable Department of the Army, Department of Defense, and local policies, procedures, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and taskers relevant to property accountability and logistics operations.
  • Provide draft interpretations, summaries, implementation checklists, and recommended process improvements for Government consideration.
  • Assist in updating documentation, training resources, inventory procedures, and SOPs when directed by the Government.
  • Identify potential compliance gaps or process-control weaknesses and provide supporting analysis and recommended mitigation measures.
  • Perform all work under Government oversight and in accordance with applicable contract requirements, access controls, handling procedures, and Government direction.

Stakeholder Coordination and Communication Support

  • Participate in recurring Microsoft Teams meetings, in-person coordination sessions, and working groups with C5ISR G4 personnel and other Government-designated stakeholders.
  • Prepare meeting agendas, read-ahead materials, minutes, action-item trackers, and follow-up correspondence as directed.
  • Develop draft executive summaries, status reports, briefing slides, and decision-support materials addressing property posture, inventory results, documentation status, audit readiness, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Present technical findings, data analyses, and status updates to Government personnel and other authorized stakeholders when requested.
  • Coordinate with property custodians, hand-receipt holders, logistics personnel, warehouse personnel, and other stakeholders to obtain records, schedule inventories, and resolve administrative discrepancies.
  • Escalate unresolved issues, conflicting guidance, or potential compliance concerns to the Government-designated task lead.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Systems Proficiency: Working knowledge of GCSS-A and eFLIPL, commensurate with authorized system access and assigned support duties. Microsoft applications skillset.
  • Property Accountability Knowledge: Familiarity with Army property-book processes, hand-receipt procedures, inventory controls, adjustment documentation, and logistics transaction records.
  • Documentation and Analysis: Ability to organize source documentation, reconcile records, maintain accurate trackers, identify discrepancies, and develop clear analytical products.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise staff products, brief technical findings, and coordinate effectively with diverse stakeholders and RTI leadership.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to interpret Government-furnished guidance, manage competing priorities, identify issues requiring Government decision, and provide well-supported recommendations.
  • Professional Judgment: Ability to work independently within the scope of the contract while recognizing and elevating matters requiring Government approval, direction, or adjudication.

Requirements / Preferred Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • Obtain and maintain required SECRET security clearance
  • Obtain and maintain all contractually required training, system access, certifications, licenses, and credentials necessary to perform assigned duties.
  • Be capable of performing physical activities associated with inventory and warehouse-support duties, including standing, walking, lifting, carrying, bending, and squatting, consistent with applicable workplace-safety requirements.
  • Be capable of supporting property inventories and site visits at Government-designated locations.
  • Possess and maintain a valid driver's license if operation of Government or organizational vehicles is required; use of Government vehicles remains subject to Government authorization and applicable policy.
  • Be willing and able to perform authorized field and warehouse-support duties in clement and inclement weather conditions, consistent with safety requirements.

title: Junior Software Engineer (SQL)
description:

As a Junior Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of software solutions that support organizations delivering essential healthcare and human services.
You will work across the full stack, with a primary focus on SQL Server databases, queries, and stored procedures that power backend APIs and user-facing applications.
Working alongside experienced engineers, you will develop your technical expertise while delivering reliable features, resolving bugs, and improving application performance.
This role offers hands-on exposure to C#, .NET Core, React, and the software development lifecycle in a collaborative engineering environment.
You will gradually take on greater responsibility as you deepen your understanding of the products, architecture, and customer needs.
Your work will directly contribute to the reliability of technology used by organizations serving individuals and communities.
Data security, code quality, continuous learning, and thoughtful collaboration are central to success in this position.

Accountabilities:

  • Develop, test, and deliver well-defined software features and bug fixes across the full stack, with an emphasis on SQL Server queries, T-SQL, and stored procedures.
  • Support the backend services and user interfaces by contributing to .NET Core REST APIs and React-based applications.

  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET Core, including experience building or consuming REST APIs.
  • A foundational understanding of full-stack application architecture and how data flows from a SQL Server database through a .NET Core API to a React frontend.

  • Experience with Fluent UI or similar user interface libraries.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot.

Benefits:

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Data Analysis Intern - Open The Books
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About Open the Books
Open the Books is a project of American Transparency, a 501(c)(3) dedicated to educating the public on waste, fraud and abuse and fighting for real-time spending transparency. We believe transparency building block of representative government that makes all our other freedoms possible.
We operate the largest private database of public spending in history: 10 billion points of data that includes all federal salaries, line-by-line federal spending, all 50 state “checkbooks,” millions of state-level salaries and pension funds, and spending across more than 17,000 municipalities.
We won’t stop until we’ve captured every dime and put it online, in a close to real-time as possible. The database is open to journalists, researchers, activists, public officials – and most importantly – every American taxpayer.
About the role
The Data Analysis Intern will help brainstorm and develop creative research projects that leverage Open the Books’ proprietary database to tell unique stories about government waste. Leveraging the nation’s largest repository of public spending, a successful candidate will be excited to consider data comparisons that can move the needle on the conversation about wasteful spending at every level of government (federal, state and local).
Candidates with an interest in quantitative research and those who follow the news cycle closely will be a fit with our team of watchdog journalists!
This is a full-time, fully remote role.

Responsibilities

  • Work with Deputy Policy Director to understand the depth and breadth of available datasets
  • Work with the Deputy Policy Director and analyze the relevant datasets to draw interesting conclusions
  • Brainstorm and pitch comparative analyses that can offer taxpayers new insights about the efficacy of public spending

Qualifications

  • Willing to proactively report progress and pitch ideas in a remote work environment
  • Proficient with Microsoft Excel with an interest in further training on data analytics tools.
  • Experience with visualization tools like Tableau, PowerBI or comparable tools is a plus.
  • Enthusiastic about using data to tell surprising, counterintuitive stories about public policy outcomes
  • Aligned with our vision to hold government accountable for its use of tax dollars and steer public spending back toward founding principles
Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

title: Ergoterapeut - Holbæk Sygehus
description:
Ergoterapeuter – med fokus på trivsel, tværfaglighed og det gode patientforløb

Fysio- og Ergoterapiafdelingen på Holbæk Sygehus søger en ergoterapeut til en fast stilling pr. 01.01.2027 eller snarest muligt.

Har du lyst til at blive en del af en faglig stærk og udviklingsorienteret afdeling? Så har du muligheden nu.

Vi søger en engageret ergoterapeut, der har lyst til at indgå i vores medicinsk/kirurgiske team.

Om os

Fysio- og Ergoterapiafdelingen yder fysioterapi, ergoterapi og diætbehandling til patienter på sygehusets sengeafsnit og ambulatorier. Vi lægger vægt på høj faglighed og har fokus på fleksible og effektive arbejdsgange. I Ergoterapien på Holbæk Sygehus er vi organiseret i to teams: et medicinsk/kirurgisk team, der løser opgaver på tværs af sygehuset, og et neurologisk team, der er tilknyttet sengeafsnittet for patienter indlagt med apopleksi.

Du bliver en del af det medicinske og kirurgiske ergo-team, men vil efter behov også skulle bidrage på tværs og varetage opgaver i apopleksi-teamet. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du trives i en hverdag, hvor du både arbejder på specialistniveau inden for eget team og kan bringe dine ergoterapeutiske basiskompetencer i spil, når der er behov for hjælp på tværs.

Vi tilbyder

Vi byder dig velkommen til en udviklingsorienteret Fysio- og Ergoterapiafdeling med mulighed for medinddragelse, spændende opgaver og kompetenceudvikling. Vi tror på, at vi sammen skaber et godt arbejdsmiljø og høj trivsel, hvor faglighed og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd.

Som ny medarbejder hos os tilbydes du et introduktionsforløb med mentor, for at give dig en tryg start. Du tilbydes en grundig og struktureret oplæring, der giver dig de nødvendige redskaber og viden til at trives i din nye rolle, som ergoterapeut her hos os.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som ergoterapeut er du en central del af patientforløbet, hvor du

  • Bidrager til at klarlægge patientens motoriske og processuelle dysfunktioner gennem blandt andet ADL-observation
  • Tilrettelægger og udfører træning
  • Varetager undersøgelse og behandling af dysfagi, og herunder udarbejder spise- og drikkevejledninger.
  • Har fokus på den tværfaglige sparring og formidler viden til andre faggrupper, samt til patient og pårørende
  • Vurderer potentiale og genoptræningsbehov samt udarbejder genoptræningsplaner, ofte i samarbejde med fysioterapeut
  • Deltager i planmøder og understøtter den gode udskrivelse
  • Deltager i tværfaglige konferencer
  • Vurderer patientens behov for hjælpemidler

Som ergoterapeut i afdelingen bidrager du også til den kliniske undervisning ved at en ergoterapeutstuderende følger med til dine interventioner og løbende faglig sparring.

Dig som kollega

Vi søger en ergoterapeut, der:

  • Er nysgerrig på egen og andres praksis, og som har lyst til løbende at udvikle sig både fagligt og personligt. Du bidrager aktivt til et fagligt miljø, hvor sparring, refleksion og videndeling med kollegaer er en naturlig del af hverdagen
  • Har kendskab til eller erfaring med at udføre vurdering og behandling af dysfagi.
  • Bidrager til en aktiv indlæggelse og fremmer den rehabiliterende tilgang
  • Trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, med mange bolde i luften
  • Er omstillingsparat, løsningsorienteret og bidrager aktivt for at prioritere dagens opgaver
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt og professionelt, både mundtligt og skriftligt, da samarbejde og dialog med forskellige faggrupper på sygehuset og vores kommunale samarbejdspartnere er en væsentlig del af hverdagen
  • Har dansk autorisation som ergoterapeut

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Det medicinske/kirurgiske team arbejder alle årets dage i faste rul. Efter en introduktionsperiode indgår du i weekend- og helligdagsvagter.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: 20/11-2026 kl. 12.00

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt i starten af uge 48

Ønskes yderligere information kontaktes overterapeuter, Simone Billeschou Noer Larsen eller Ergoterapeutisk Tillidsrepræsentant, Tanja Kjøller Brandstrup

Telefon: 59 48 46 20

Yderligere information findes via vores hjemmeside: Fysio- og Ergoterapiafdelingen - Holbæk Sygehus eller via vores instagramprofil: @fysergo_holbaeksygehus

Ansættelsen er betinget af modtagelse af tilfredsstillende børneattest

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Holbæk Sygehus

Holbæk Sygehus er en innovativ arbejdsplads med masser af muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling. Vi vil være førende i diagnostik og behandling af almene og hyppigt forekommende sygdomme, og vi har velfungerende forskningsmiljøer på disse områder.

Vi er et ambitiøst og veldrevet sygehus med en flad ledelsesstruktur – så vejen fra idé til handling er kort. Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen på holdet. Du kan se mere om job på Holbæk Sygehus her.

We are seeking a hands-on Project Manager to lead pharmacy acquisitions, integrations, new pharmacy launches, and relocations across a growing healthcare services organization. In this role, you will transform approved growth opportunities into structured project plans and oversee execution from initial planning through launch, stabilization, and operational handoff. You will coordinate multidisciplinary teams, manage timelines and budgets, and ensure critical regulatory, technical, financial, and operational requirements are met. Working across pharmacy operations, clinical quality, finance, legal, IT, facilities, and other key functions, you will help deliver seamless transitions while protecting continuity of patient and client care. You will also strengthen implementation processes, improve project visibility, and develop repeatable frameworks that support sustainable growth. This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful healthcare outcomes in a collaborative, fast-paced, and mission-driven environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead end-to-end project execution: Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and deliverables, ensuring clear ownership and accountability across concurrent initiatives.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams: Align stakeholders across operations, clinical and quality, legal and compliance, finance, HR, IT, revenue cycle, payer relations, licensing, facilities, procurement, sales, marketing, 340B, and logistics.

  • Oversee Day 1 readiness and post-close integration: Coordinate employee onboarding, financial and billing continuity, technology transitions, supplier changes, procurement, communications, and operational workflows to support smooth acquisitions.

title: Clinical Supervisor
description:
Department: Clinical Services Program: OASAS Part 820 Residential Services

About Anchor House

Anchor House, Inc. is a nonprofit, faith-rooted residential substance use disorder treatment organization in Brooklyn. Our work reaches beyond the individual to the family, the next generation and the community.

Position Summary

The Clinical Supervisor is the designated Part 820.6(c)(2) clinical supervisor for both Anchor House residences (Men's and Women's), accountable for day-to-day clinical operations and for routine, documented supervision of clinical staff. The role develops counselors, owns the quality of treatment planning and documentation, and serves as the on-site clinical resource for CASACs, CASAC-Ts and other clinical staff.

This is a supervisory role with protected time and no routine counseling caseload. As a last resort during a sudden staff shortage or emergency, the supervisor may temporarily cover counseling duties with the written approval of the Director of Clinical Services, co-signature of cases by another QHP, and Executive Director review beyond 30 days.

Essential Responsibilities

Supervision and Staff Development

  • Provide weekly, documented clinical supervision to CASACs, CASAC-Ts and other clinical staff, and own each employee's individualized training plan, reviewed with staff at least quarterly.
  • Verify credential status, supervision hours and CASAC-T work plans, and contribute to hiring, performance evaluation and succession planning for clinical staff.
  • Coach and develop staff, lead clinical onboarding, and, with the Director of Clinical Services, set corrective-development strategies.

Clinical Oversight and QHP Review

  • Provide real-time consultation on complex cases and direct escalation to the Director of Clinical Services, trauma specialist, Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner or medical staff.
  • Serve as QHP of record for treatment/recovery plan approval and for admission and level-of-care determinations within required timeframes; a designated QHP covers during absences.
  • Oversee, without serving as, the separately designated Health Coordinator through monthly review of communicable-disease education, counseling and referral documentation.

Quality and Compliance

  • Review treatment plans, progress notes and discharge plans for quality and timeliness, and support Medicaid managed care authorizations and utilization review.

title: Coding & Documentation Compliance Specialist (CPC/CPMA)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Coding & Documentation Compliance Specialist (CPC/CPMA) based in the United States.

We are seeking an experienced Coding & Documentation Compliance Specialist to strengthen coding accuracy, documentation integrity, and reimbursement compliance within a physician-led healthcare environment. In this remote, independent contractor role, you will ensure that clinical documentation fully supports billed services while identifying opportunities to improve coding practices and revenue integrity. You will conduct prospective code evaluations, retrospective chart audits, and targeted reviews across providers and service lines. Working closely with clinical teams, billing professionals, and medical leadership, you will translate audit findings into practical documentation guidance, workflow improvements, and staff education. You will also contribute to Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) reporting and quality-measure compliance. This opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented coding professional with strong Medicare expertise who can combine hands-on auditing with actionable recommendations that support high-quality, compliant patient care.

Accountabilities

  • Conduct baseline documentation audits of 10–20 charts per billing provider across encounters and deliver detailed findings reports, including error rates by provider and service line.

  • Perform ongoing quarterly audits of approximately 10 charts per provider, along with focused reviews of specific service lines as needed.

  • Implement 100% pre-bill reviews during new-code rollouts until the error rate falls below 5%.

  • Place providers with error rates above 10% on monthly review, providing targeted education and follow-up audits until performance returns below the established threshold.

  • Evaluate the appropriateness of unused or underutilized codes within the care model and define the documentation required to support compliant billing.

  • Develop clear, practical documentation guidance for clinical staff and billing teams to improve coding consistency and accuracy.

  • Support successful MIPS participation by identifying appropriate quality measures and ensuring documentation meets or exceeds applicable requirements.

  • Recommend improvements to clinical documentation templates, workflows, and supporting materials to strengthen coding compliance and MIPS performance.

  • Identify recurring documentation gaps and translate audit findings into clinician education, workflow enhancements, and sustainable corrective actions.

  • Collaborate with medical leadership and relevant operational teams to maintain accurate, defensible, and compliant coding practices.

    • Requirements:

    • Current Certified Professional Coder (CPC) certification through AAPC or Certified Coding Specialist–Physician-based (CCS-P) certification through AHIMA.

    • Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA) certification strongly preferred, or equivalent demonstrated experience conducting medical chart audits.

    • At least five years of experience coding outpatient evaluation and management (E/M) services, including direct auditing responsibilities.

    • Strong understanding of Medicare billing requirements, particularly telehealth rules and documentation standards.

    • Experience supporting MIPS reporting and documenting quality measures in accordance with applicable requirements.

    • Strong knowledge of outpatient coding, documentation integrity, coding accuracy, and compliant reimbursement practices.

    • Demonstrated ability to identify coding and documentation deficiencies, assess risk, and develop practical corrective recommendations.

    • Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex coding requirements clearly to clinicians and billing professionals.

    • Must be based in the United States and have substantial experience working with Medicare.

    • Experience in obesity medicine, endocrinology, or primary care is an advantage.

    • Familiarity with OIG self-disclosure processes or responding to payer audits is desirable.

    • Experience developing clinical documentation templates, clinician reference guides, or coding cheat sheets is a plus.

    • Ability to work independently, manage ongoing audit cycles, and collaborate effectively with medical leadership and cross-functional teams.

      • Benefits:

      • Work arrangement: Fully remote within the United States.

      • Employment type: Independent contractor.

      • Workload: Approximately 15–20 hours per week, on an ongoing basis.

      • Reporting structure: Direct collaboration with and reporting to the Senior Medical Director.

      • Professional impact: Help improve coding accuracy, documentation quality, reimbursement integrity, and regulatory compliance.

      • Meaningful contribution: Support a healthcare model focused on accessible, evidence-based care and improved long-term patient outcomes.

      • Process improvement opportunities: Shape documentation standards, clinical workflows, and audit-driven education initiatives.

description:

This remote freelance opportunity begins with a paid course project, typically lasting around three months, with the potential for ongoing projects or a full-time position.
