The ideal candidate is a practising DevOps engineer who can simplify complex concepts, communicate confidently on camera, and create learning experiences that make advanced technologies accessible.

Accountabilities

  • Design and develop technical courses

    • Collaborate with the curriculum team to define course structure, learning objectives, lesson sequences, and practical lab exercises focused on AI for DevOps.

    • Develop content that demonstrates how engineers use AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation in real infrastructure environments.

    • Ensure lessons are technically accurate, relevant, practical, and aligned with the needs of working engineers.

    • Create engaging instructional content

      • Write concise, story-driven video scripts designed to explain technical concepts clearly, with individual lessons typically lasting around six minutes.

      • Use AI tools where helpful during drafting while ensuring the final scripts reflect your own voice, expertise, and teaching style.

      • Narrate and present lessons confidently in English, making complex technical topics approachable for learners at different experience levels.

      • Develop and validate hands-on labs

        • Collaborate with the dedicated labs team responsible for building the lab environments.

        • Test completed labs, validate technical accuracy, and ensure exercises deliver the intended learning outcomes.

        • Record demonstrations and walkthroughs explaining how to complete lab exercises and solve practical challenges.

        • Collaborate on quality and editorial development

          • Incorporate structured editorial feedback, particularly during the initial course section, to align content with established teaching standards.

          • Participate in regular team syncs and maintain communication through collaboration tools such as Slack.

          • Focus on technical expertise, teaching, scripting, and recording while the production team manages video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

            • Requirements:

            • Hands-on DevOps and infrastructure experience

              • Strong practical knowledge of Linux, containers, Kubernetes, at least one major cloud platform, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (IaC).

              • Experience building, operating, and maintaining infrastructure rather than relying solely on theoretical knowledge.

              • The ability to demonstrate real engineering workflows and translate practical experience into effective learning materials.

              • Current experience with AI technologies

                • Practical experience using AI tools in engineering work, including AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation.

                • Genuine curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and a commitment to staying current with new tools and techniques.

                • The ability to explain how AI can support infrastructure engineering and DevOps workflows; deep specialization in AI research is not required.

                • Teaching and communication skills

                  • A demonstrated passion for teaching, supported by experience creating courses, publishing tutorials, delivering talks or workshops, mentoring colleagues, or sharing technical knowledge with a community.

                  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, naturally, and confidently on camera.

                  • Strong storytelling skills and the ability to break down complex technical concepts into simple, structured explanations.

                  • Empathy for learners, particularly beginners, and an understanding of how to make technical material engaging and accessible.

                  • Collaboration and adaptability

                    • Willingness to follow an established teaching methodology and incorporate constructive editorial feedback.

                    • Ability to work independently, organize deliverables, and meet an agreed project schedule.

                    • Comfort working remotely with a distributed team, including participation in weekly syncs and some time-zone overlap with colleagues based in Europe and Asia.

                    • Additional qualifications considered an advantage

                      • Previously published online courses on platforms such as Udemy or Pluralsight, or experience authoring a technical book.

                      • Experience speaking at conferences or meetups, maintaining a technical YouTube channel or blog, or contributing to technical communities.

                      • Community credentials or roles such as CNCF Ambassador, AWS Community Builder, or Microsoft MVP.

                      • Relevant Kubernetes certifications, including CKA, CKAD, or CKS, or recognition such as Kubestronaut.

                      • Cloud certifications from providers such as AWS or Microsoft Azure.

                        • Benefits:

                        • Competitive fixed fee per course, agreed upfront based on course length and topic complexity, with higher compensation for advanced topics and exceptional instructors.

                        • Paid freelance project that can be completed alongside an existing job, with no fixed weekly-hour requirement.

                        • A typical initial project duration of approximately three months, with a mutually agreed delivery plan.

                        • Potential to progress to a full-time role or take on additional course projects based on mutual fit.

                        • Fully remote working arrangements with flexible hours.

                        • Opportunity to collaborate with a global technical education team and reach a community of more than one million engineers.

                        • Dedicated production support for video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and course publishing, allowing you to focus on teaching and technical content.

                        • Opportunity to share your expertise in AI, DevOps, cloud, and Kubernetes through practical, hands-on education.

title: ACH Exceptions Specialist
description:
Overview:

The ACH Exceptions Specialist is responsible for the accurate, timely, and compliant processing and resolution of ACH exceptions, returns, disputes, and related payment activity. This position serves as the Bank’s primary ACH subject matter expert and escalation point, providing guidance across departments while ensuring adherence to Nacha Operating Rules, Regulation E, Federal Reserve requirements, Bank policies, and applicable regulatory standards. As a critical operational function, the position requires independent judgment, strong attention to detail, effective risk management, and dependable daily coverage of time-sensitive ACH activity. As a member of the Payment Operations Team, this individual will be cross trained on additional Payment Operations functions to maximize department capacity and coverage.


Primary Accountabilities / Responsibilities:

  1. Manage the end-to-end daily processing of ACH exception activity, including unposted transactions, NSF items, stop payments, returns, and other exceptions, ensuring timely and accurate resolution in accordance with current Nacha Operating Rules, Regulatory requirements, Bank policies, and established processing deadlines.
  2. Research and process death notification entries, including post-death government benefit returns and reclamations; restrict or freeze associated deposit accounts when appropriate.
  3. Process and monitor Notices of Change (NOCs), ensuring required account information updates are communicated to the appropriate department.
  4. Research and resolve originated ACH returns, errors, and exceptions in collaboration with Treasury Services and Loan Operations as needed, including taking appropriate corrective action to prevent balance discrepancies in the ACH In-Process General Ledger account.
  5. Verify pre-notification entries and return items with invalid account or payee information.
  6. Balance and reconcile daily ACH settlement General Ledger account and research to resolve any discrepancies.
  7. Research and resolve consumer and commercial reports of unauthorized or erroneous ACH debits.
  8. Manage the Written Statement of Unauthorized Debit (WSUD) process, including obtaining required documentation, reviewing for completeness, maintaining appropriate records, and initiating related return activity within applicable time frames.
  9. Apply applicable Nacha requirements, SEC codes, and return codes when processing unauthorized ACH transactions, including transactions subject to Regulation E.
  10. Escalate legal, compliance, fraud, or operational-risk concerns as appropriate.
  11. Maintain complete and accurate records supporting ACH disputes and returns.
  12. Monitor ACH return activity and return ratios for commercial ACH originators using available reporting.
  13. Identify originators approaching or exceeding applicable Nacha return-rate thresholds and escalate concerns appropriately.
  14. Serve as the Bank’s primary ACH subject matter expert and escalation point for ACH-related questions, issues, and exceptions.
  15. Provide guidance to Retail, Operations, Treasury Services/Treasury Management, Lending, Fraud, Compliance, BSA, and other departments regarding ACH processing, Nacha requirements, exceptions, disputes, and operational questions.
  16. Participate in testing and implementation of system enhancements, ACH changes, and other payment-related initiatives.
  17. Develop and deliver periodic ACH training for Retail, Operations, and other Bank personnel.
  18. Educate employees on the appropriate questions and information-gathering requirements for reports of unauthorized ACH activity, with particular emphasis on NACHA’s definition of "unauthorized" as well as proper completion of WSUDs.
  19. Maintain current ACH knowledge and required professional certifications.
  20. Provide documentation and support for independent ACH audits, regulatory examinations, internal reviews, and risk assessments.
  21. Develop, maintain, and periodically review detailed ACH procedures to support consistent processing, operational continuity, cross-training, and backup coverage.
  22. Performs related and unrelated duties as may be required.

title: Senior Manager, Site Optimization
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manager, Site Optimization based in the United States.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced e-commerce and conversion optimization professional to drive digital growth for a globally recognized skincare brand.
You will lead the strategy, execution, and analysis of experiments designed to improve conversion rates, increase revenue, and enhance the direct-to-consumer (DTC) shopping experience.
From homepage navigation and product detail pages to cart and checkout, you will identify opportunities to reduce friction and make online shopping more intuitive and effective.
Combining rigorous experimentation with strong UX judgment, you will translate customer behavior and performance data into measurable business improvements.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams spanning e-commerce, creative, marketing, technology, product development, and regulatory affairs to deliver high-quality digital experiences.
The role offers significant ownership over the testing roadmap, with the opportunity to influence broader merchandising decisions and long-term e-commerce strategy.
This remote-eligible position is ideal for a detail-oriented, analytical leader who thrives in a collaborative environment and knows how to balance commercial performance with brand integrity and customer trust.

Accountabilities

  • Conversion Optimization Strategy: Develop and execute a structured testing roadmap focused on improving conversion rates, revenue, average order value (AOV), revenue per visitor, customer acquisition, and retention across the entire DTC shopping journey.
  • A/B and Multivariate Testing: Plan, build, launch, and analyze high-impact experiments across desktop and mobile experiences. Test copy, user interface elements, page layouts, product merchandising, promotional offers, navigation, and other components that influence customer behavior.
  • E-commerce Experience Optimization: Evaluate and improve key customer touchpoints, including the homepage, collection pages, product detail pages, routine and regimen builders, cart, and checkout. Identify usability issues and implement data-informed solutions that simplify the shopping experience.
  • Quality Assurance and Launch Management: Ensure that experiments and website changes meet specifications, function correctly, and launch on schedule. Validate links, page layouts, user interactions, and analytics tracking before deployment, identifying and resolving bugs or measurement gaps before they affect customers.
  • Performance Analytics and Reporting: Build and maintain clear performance reports that combine key metrics, including conversion rate, average order value, revenue per visitor, new-customer acquisition, and retention indicators. Share findings with e-commerce leadership and translate results into actionable recommendations.
  • Experimentation Insights and Documentation: Document test hypotheses, methodologies, outcomes, and key learnings. Maintain a centralized knowledge base that helps teams make informed decisions, avoid repeating unsuccessful experiments, and incorporate proven insights into broader DTC strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with e-commerce, creative, brand, performance marketing, CRM, product development, technology, and regulatory teams to gather requirements, coordinate assets, finalize content, and deliver successful launches.
  • Execution and Project Ownership: Manage multiple optimization initiatives simultaneously, coordinate dependencies, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain momentum across the testing roadmap. Serve as a go-to resource for understanding customer shopping behavior and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Brand and Regulatory Alignment: Balance conversion objectives with brand standards, merchandising priorities, promotional profitability, and approved product claims. Ensure that experiments and website updates respect applicable compliance requirements without compromising customer experience.
  • Continuous Improvement and Strategic Influence: Identify performance trends, evaluate emerging opportunities, and recommend changes that improve the overall digital shopping experience. Use experimentation results to inform decisions across creative development, merchandising, customer engagement, and e-commerce strategy.
  • Success Measurement: Maintain high on-time launch rates, minimize post-launch defects, improve campaign and website performance, and ensure that testing insights lead to measurable commercial results. Build strong relationships with stakeholders by delivering reliable execution and actionable recommendations.

Requirements

  • Professional Experience: At least 8 years of experience in e-commerce, performance marketing, conversion rate optimization (CRO), or a related discipline, with demonstrated ownership of testing strategy, execution, quality assurance, and performance analysis.
  • DTC E-commerce Expertise: Proven experience optimizing direct-to-consumer e-commerce experiences, ideally within beauty, skincare, personal care, wellness, or consumer goods. Familiarity with high-consideration purchasing journeys in which product education and customer trust influence conversion is particularly valuable.
  • Experimentation and Testing: Hands-on experience designing, launching, and evaluating A/B and multivariate tests. Strong understanding of hypothesis development, experimental methodology, statistical rigor, and the interpretation of results.
  • Testing Platforms and CMS Tools: Experience working directly with experimentation platforms such as Optimizely, VWO, or AB Tasty, as well as e-commerce platforms or content management systems. Ability to update copy, layouts, and page flows and validate implementations before launch.
  • Analytics Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and the ability to measure digital performance accurately. Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms is an advantage.
  • User Experience Judgment: Ability to recognize friction points in the shopping journey and recommend practical improvements grounded in customer behavior, usability principles, and performance data.
  • Data-Driven Decision-Making: Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect multiple performance indicators, interpret trends, and communicate findings in a clear, actionable format.
  • Quality Assurance and Attention to Detail: A systematic approach to reviewing digital experiences, validating tracking events, identifying errors, and ensuring that launches meet defined specifications.
  • Commercial Awareness: Ability to balance conversion and revenue goals with brand experience, promotional margins, customer acquisition, retention, and compliance with approved product claims.
  • Project and Process Management: Excellent organizational skills, strong follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple experiments and launches in parallel while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across creative, brand, marketing, technology, regulatory, and senior leadership teams.
  • Ownership and Adaptability: A proactive, execution-focused mindset, with the confidence to make recommendations, resolve obstacles, adjust priorities, and continuously seek better ways to improve performance.
  • Remote Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and collaborate with stakeholders across North America and Europe, with occasional coordination across Asia. Availability aligned with Eastern Time is preferred.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Approximate annual base salary range of $125,000–$135,000, depending on experience, skills, education, geographic location, and prevailing market conditions.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Eligibility to participate in a discretionary company bonus plan, subject to applicable terms.
  • Remote Work Flexibility: Remote-eligible position within the United States, with the ability to collaborate with a globally distributed team. Support for Eastern Time working hours is preferred.

  • Retirement Benefits: Access to a retirement savings plan and related benefits.

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Paid leave designed to support rest, personal commitments, and work-life balance, including opportunities to volunteer.

title: Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps based in Australia.

As a Senior Technical Trainer, you will combine hands-on DevOps expertise with a passion for teaching to develop practical, engaging courses on AI-powered engineering workflows. You will help engineers understand how to apply AI agents, coding assistants, and modern AI tools to real-world infrastructure and automation challenges. Working alongside a curriculum team and experienced technical educators, you will design lessons, develop hands-on lab specifications, and record clear, compelling instructional videos. This remote freelance opportunity begins with a paid course project, typically lasting around three months, with the potential for ongoing projects or a full-time position. You will have the flexibility to work alongside existing commitments while contributing your technical knowledge to a global engineering community. The ideal candidate is a practising DevOps engineer who can simplify complex concepts, communicate confidently on camera, and create learning experiences that make advanced technologies accessible.

Accountabilities

  • Design and develop technical courses

    • Collaborate with the curriculum team to define course structure, learning objectives, lesson sequences, and practical lab exercises focused on AI for DevOps.

    • Develop content that demonstrates how engineers use AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation in real infrastructure environments.

    • Ensure lessons are technically accurate, relevant, practical, and aligned with the needs of working engineers.

    • Create engaging instructional content

      • Write concise, story-driven video scripts designed to explain technical concepts clearly, with individual lessons typically lasting around six minutes.

      • Use AI tools where helpful during drafting while ensuring the final scripts reflect your own voice, expertise, and teaching style.

      • Narrate and present lessons confidently in English, making complex technical topics approachable for learners at different experience levels.

        • Write detailed specifications for practical labs that demonstrate real-world DevOps and AI workflows.

        • Collaborate with the dedicated labs team responsible for building the lab environments.

        • Test completed labs, validate technical accuracy, and ensure exercises deliver the intended learning outcomes.

        • Record demonstrations and walkthroughs explaining how to complete lab exercises and solve practical challenges.

        • Collaborate on quality and editorial development

          • Work closely with curriculum and production teams throughout the course development process.

          • Incorporate structured editorial feedback, particularly during the initial course section, to align content with established teaching standards.

          • Participate in regular team syncs and maintain communication through collaboration tools such as Slack.

          • Focus on technical expertise, teaching, scripting, and recording while the production team manages video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

            • Requirements:

            • Hands-on DevOps and infrastructure experience

              • Strong practical knowledge of Linux, containers, Kubernetes, at least one major cloud platform, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (IaC).

              • Experience building, operating, and maintaining infrastructure rather than relying solely on theoretical knowledge.

              • The ability to demonstrate real engineering workflows and translate practical experience into effective learning materials.

              • Current experience with AI technologies

                • Practical experience using AI tools in engineering work, including AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation.

                • Genuine curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and a commitment to staying current with new tools and techniques.

                • The ability to explain how AI can support infrastructure engineering and DevOps workflows; deep specialization in AI research is not required.

                • Teaching and communication skills

                  • A demonstrated passion for teaching, supported by experience creating courses, publishing tutorials, delivering talks or workshops, mentoring colleagues, or sharing technical knowledge with a community.

                  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, naturally, and confidently on camera.

                  • Strong storytelling skills and the ability to break down complex technical concepts into simple, structured explanations.

                  • Empathy for learners, particularly beginners, and an understanding of how to make technical material engaging and accessible.

                  • Collaboration and adaptability

                    • Willingness to follow an established teaching methodology and incorporate constructive editorial feedback.

                    • Ability to work independently, organize deliverables, and meet an agreed project schedule.

                    • Comfort working remotely with a distributed team, including participation in weekly syncs and some time-zone overlap with colleagues based in Europe and Asia.

                    • Additional qualifications considered an advantage

                      • Previously published online courses on platforms such as Udemy or Pluralsight, or experience authoring a technical book.

                      • Experience speaking at conferences or meetups, maintaining a technical YouTube channel or blog, or contributing to technical communities.

                      • Community credentials or roles such as CNCF Ambassador, AWS Community Builder, or Microsoft MVP.

                      • Relevant Kubernetes certifications, including CKA, CKAD, or CKS, or recognition such as Kubestronaut.

                      • Cloud certifications from providers such as AWS or Microsoft Azure.

                        • Benefits:

                        • Competitive fixed fee per course, agreed upfront based on course length and topic complexity, with higher compensation for advanced topics and exceptional instructors.

                        • Paid freelance project that can be completed alongside an existing job, with no fixed weekly-hour requirement.

                        • A typical initial project duration of approximately three months, with a mutually agreed delivery plan.

                        • Potential to progress to a full-time role or take on additional course projects based on mutual fit.

                        • Fully remote working arrangements with flexible hours.

                        • Opportunity to collaborate with a global technical education team and reach a community of more than one million engineers.

                        • Dedicated production support for video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and course publishing, allowing you to focus on teaching and technical content.

                        • Opportunity to share your expertise in AI, DevOps, cloud, and Kubernetes through practical, hands-on education.

title: Industrial AutoCAD Designer
description:
Thermo-Trol Systems Inc. (TTS) is a provider of industrial automation and control solutions. We specialize in designing, installing, and maintaining systems that optimize processes, increase efficiency, and ensure reliable operations for a range of clients in food and beverage and Navy facilities. An Industrial AutoCAD Designer is sought to join a growing Systems Integrator team.


Compensation & Benefits:

Competitive hourly rate, $19.00 to $37.00 per hour based on experience, skill level, and certifications.

  • Junior Level: $19.00 to $29.00 per hour
  • Mid Level: $28.00 to $37.00 per hour

Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance.

Paid vacation and sick leave.

401(k) plan with company match.

Profit Sharing.

Tuition Reimbursement.

Opportunities for career advancement and ongoing training.

Collaborative and innovative work environment.


Job Summary:

This role involves designing the project lifecycle of automation and control systems for various industrial clients. The designer will use expertise to design and develop project solutions. Collaboration with cross-functional teams and clients to understand their needs and deliver innovative solutions is essential.


Responsibilities:

  • Electrical Schematics & Drawings: Create detailed electrical schematics, panel layouts, wiring diagrams, loop drawings, and network architectures using AutoCAD Electrical.
  • Bill of Materials (BOM): Generate and maintain accurate component lists, terminal strip schedules, and cable schedules for procurement and manufacturing.
  • Standards Compliance: Ensure all designs comply with relevant industrial and safety codes such as NEC, NFPA 79, NFPA 70, and UL508A.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with controls engineers, PLC programmers, and shop floor panel builders to clarify design details and resolve assembly issues.
  • As-Built Documentation: Update design packages and redlines to reflect final factory acceptance testing (FAT) and field commissioning changes.

About Thermo-Trol Systems:


Thermo-Trol Systems is a construction contractor specializing in HVAC and Industrial Control Systems, Integration Solutions, UL 508A Custom Control Panel Manufacturer, Controls & HVAC Mechanical Service Company, primarily serving Southeastern Virginia and Northeastern North Carolina. Thermo-Trol Systems has been in business since 1967.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin.

title: Quality Assurance Inspector - Aluminum Division 3rd shift
description:
Quality Assurance Inspector - Aluminum 3rd shift

2nd shift Sunday night - Friday morning 9pm - 5:30am

Job Summary

The QA Inspector is responsible for inspecting products and materials to ensure compliance with quality standards, specifications, and safety regulations. This role involves performing visual and functional inspections, documenting findings, identifying defects, and collaborating with production teams to maintain high-quality standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Inspect in-process production, and finished products for quality and compliance
  • Perform visual, dimensional, and functional inspections using measuring tools and testing equipment
  • Identify defects, deviations, and non-conforming products
  • Record inspection results and maintain accurate quality documentation
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, industry standards, and safety regulations
  • Report quality issues to supervisors and recommend corrective actions
  • Monitor production processes to ensure consistent quality
  • Support audits and quality management system activities

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required; technical certification preferred
  • Experience in quality inspection, manufacturing, or quality assurance
  • Knowledge of quality control procedures and inspection techniques
  • Ability to read blueprints, specifications, and technical documents
  • Familiarity with measuring instruments such as calipers, micrometers, and gauges
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Basic computer and documentation skills
  • Good communication and teamwork abilities

Functional Requirements

Consistently able to:

  • Manually lift and move product and materials up to 55 lbs. through regular physical exertion, including but not limited to reach forward, reach overhead, lift, carry, crouch and bend.
  • Power grip and wrist turn, including the use of hand tools and/or steering for truck.
  • Walk, sit or stand for up to 12 hours with intermittent breaks.
  • Push / pull 100lbs.
  • See, inspect, and evaluate product quality
  • Read and understand written work instructions in English
  • Work in a non-climate controlled environment, including hot and humid conditions.
  • Walk up and down steps
  • Climb ladders and stairs of varying height
  • Wear task-based Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
    • Protective Footwear;
    • Hearing Protection
    • Protective Eyewear
    • Gloves
    • Additional PPE may as required by specific tasks

title: Solution Engineer
description:
Salesforce Solution Engineer
Location: Remote, United States (US - Central / Eastern Time Preferred; Chicago, IL preferred)

Thunder is a Salesforce-native systems integrator backed by Salesforce Ventures. We help growing companies design, build, and run Salesforce so it actually moves their business.

As our Sales Engineer, you are the technical lead in every pursuit. You partner with Client Directors and Salesforce AEs to turn a prospect's business problem into a credible solution, a scoped estimate, and a demo that wins the deal. You are the bridge between what we sell and what Delivery builds, so the promises we make are ones we can keep.

Role + Responsibilities
  • Run discovery. Lead technical discovery with business and IT stakeholders to map current-state processes, data, integrations, and pain points.
  • Design the solution. Shape solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, and MuleSoft, and know when not to recommend something.
  • Build demos that win. Configure tailored demos and proofs of concept in Salesforce orgs that speak to the client's own data and workflows.
  • Scope and estimate. Own level-of-effort estimates, assumptions, and risks; draft SOWs and solution sections of proposals and RFP responses with Delivery.
  • Partner with Salesforce. Work alongside Salesforce AEs and SEs on joint pursuits, and earn a reputation as their go-to partner technical resource.
  • Hand off cleanly. Transfer context to Delivery at close so projects start with clear scope, architecture, and expectations.
  • Sharpen the playbook. Build reusable demo assets, estimation templates, and solution accelerators; give product and positioning feedback to leadership.

Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years in the Salesforce ecosystem, including 2+ years in a pre-sales, solution engineering, or solution architect role at a consultancy or Salesforce
  • Hands-on configuration skills across Sales Cloud and Service Cloud; working knowledge of Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce
  • Track record of scoping and estimating fixed-fee and time-and-materials projects that delivered on margin
  • Ability to run a room: crisp discovery with executives, deep dives with admins and architects, and demos that tell a business story
  • Strong writing for proposals, SOWs, and solution designs
  • Salesforce Certifications: Administrator plus at least two of Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, or an Architect credential


How Success is Measured

  • Technical win rate on pursuits you support
  • Bookings influenced and sourced alongside Client Directors
  • Estimate accuracy: delivered margin versus scoped margin on closed projects
  • Satisfaction scores from Client Directors, Delivery, and Salesforce partners


Why Thunder? Because You Deserve More Than Just a Job.
  • A Culture of Builders – We’re a remote-first, global team of curious, collaborative problem-solvers. You’ll have the opportunity to refine processes, solve challenges, and help shape the future of Salesforce and Amazon consulting. If you’re excited to build, innovate, and grow, you’ll fit right in.
  • Forge Your Own Path – At Thunder, you’re not just filling a role—you’re shaping it. Whether it’s jumping into presales, refining our methodology, or building something entirely new, the opportunity to innovate is yours to take.
Perks In Store for You:
  • Comprehensive Benefits with Sequoia – Medical, Dental, Vision, and Employer-Paid Life/Disability Insurance to keep you and your loved ones covered.
  • Ownership & Impact – Stock options in a fast-moving, high-growth company. Every employee plays a part in what we’re building. Come make your mark!
  • Level Up Your Career – Real opportunities to grow your Salesforce and Amazon expertise through mentorship, certifications, and hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology.
  • Work from anywhere (well, almost 😉) - Enjoy the freedom of remote work, flexible PTO (with a 2-week minimum!), and generous leave policies - because the best work happens where you’re happiest.
  • People-First Flexibility – We’re always listening, evolving, and adapting. Your feedback helps shape our policies, ensuring you can thrive - professionally and personally.

U.S. citizens and those authorized to work in the US are encouraged to apply.

title: Data Analyst
description:
PRIMARY PURPOSE:
Design and maintain data systems, including fixing coding errors and other data problems. Draft, update, and maintain all relevant documentation. Interpret data sets using statistical techniques and other tools, paying particular attention to trends and patterns that could be valuable for diagnostic and predictive analytic efforts.
--ALL CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED WITHIN A 60 MILE RANGE OF THE KETTERING, OHIO OFFICE--
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Gathers and Interprets data associated with Quality Control, analyzes results using statistical techniques, and provides ongoing reports.
Develop and implement databases, data collection systems, data analytics, and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality.
Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and maintain databases/data systems.
Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets.
Filter and “clean” data by reviewing computer reports, printouts, and performance indicators to locate and correct code problems.
Work with management to prioritize business and information needs.
Locate and define new process improvement opportunities.
Functions as a QC Inventory Control Specialist.
Perform related duties as assigned, within your scope of practice.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

BS and/or equivalent experience.
Three years of experience in quality control, quality assurance, clinical laboratory, tissue banking, or pharmaceutical/other manufacturing environments.
Proven working experience as a Data Analyst or Business Data Analyst.
Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
Knowledge of and experience with data visualization software (Power BI etc.), databases (SQL, etc.), programming (Python, XML, JavaScript, or ETL frameworks).
Knowledge of statistics and experience using statistical packages for analyzing datasets (Excel, SPSS, SAS, etc.)
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Adept at queries, report writing, and presenting findings.

WORK ENVIRONMENT and PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES

Must be able to meet the required physical demands with or without reasonable accommodation.

BS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics, or similar. Certified Tissue Bank Specialist (CTBS) certification.
Strong analytical/quantitative skillset with the ability to identify, collect, organize, and analyze data from primary and secondary sources.
Experience in quality control, quality assurance, clinical laboratory, blood/tissue banking, or pharmaceutical/other manufacturing environment.
Knowledge and understanding of GMP requirements and industry standards.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications Excel in aggregating, presenting, and summarizing data.

title: 2 Construction Managers (Grand Junction, CO)
description:
Location: Grand Junction,Colorado,United States

Planate Management Group (PMG) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) headquartered in Alexandria, Virginia, and Orlando, Florida USA with a technical support center in South East Asia and East Africa, that provides program management and facilities engineering services worldwide. title: Freelance Data Science Engineer (Python & Sql)
description:
About Ornata

Ornata is building the remote operations platform for agriculture.

We help farms operate machinery without a human in the cab, using the equipment they already own. Our service combines retrofit autonomy hardware, remote operators, AI, and operational systems to unlock the benefits of autonomy for every farm.

We are working with some of Australia's leading broadacre farming businesses and are now building the operational foundations required to scale safely, reliably, and repeatably.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Robotics Software Engineer to design and own the embedded and edge software that keeps autonomous tractors operating safely and reliably in the field.

You will work closely with operators and the engineering team to understand how our machines behave in real conditions, then independently drive robust technical solutions. This is a hands‑on senior role centred on safety‑critical systems, fault tolerance, and resilient autonomy in demanding outdoor environments.

You will report directly to the CTO and help shape the future of Ornata's autonomy stack. Your software will directly control heavy machinery working in the paddock, so engineering excellence, safety, and reliability sit at the heart of everything you do.

What you'll do

  • Design and implement tractor safety systems — failsafes, watchdogs, redundancy strategies, and recovery behaviours.
  • Develop and maintain high‑reliability software running on edge devices and microcontrollers, with a focus on uptime and deterministic behaviour.
  • Contribute to localisation, path planning, and control systems that operate reliably across variable terrain and environmental conditions.
  • Design and implement perception pipelines using LiDAR, cameras, and other onboard sensors, and build robust sensor fusion for localisation, obstacle detection, and environmental understanding in dynamic field conditions.
  • Design and maintain robust communication pipelines between field hardware and cloud services, including telemetry and command pathways.
  • Build automated unit, integration, and simulation‑based test frameworks, and lead hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) testing to validate behaviour across real sensors and actuators.
  • Implement logging, telemetry, and on‑device diagnostics to support safe deployment and rapid field debugging.

What success looks like

In the first 90 days, you will understand Ornata's autonomy stack, how our machines behave in the field, and where the reliability and safety risks sit — and you will be shipping improvements to the edge software with confidence.

Over the first 12 months, success means the on‑machine software is more reliable, safer, and easier to debug in the field: safety mechanisms you can trust, perception and control that hold up across variable terrain, and test and observability frameworks that let the team deploy changes to heavy machinery with confidence.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in embedded systems, robotics, or autonomous platforms.
  • Strong C/C++ skills, including on microcontrollers, with proficiency in Python.
  • Deep understanding of navigation systems (localisation, path planning) and control theory.
  • Built safety‑critical or fault‑tolerant systems, and think naturally about failure modes, redundancy, and recovery.
  • Practical experience with HIL testing and automated validation frameworks.
  • Comfortable with Linux‑based edge devices and distributed system communication.
  • Experience developing perception systems using LiDAR and/or camera data, including point cloud processing and sensor fusion.
  • Hold a degree in Robotics, Computer, Electrical, or Mechatronic Engineering.

Useful experience — any of the following would help, but none are strict requirements:

  • ROS / ROS2, ArduPilot, or Gazebo simulation.
  • NVIDIA Jetson platforms and/or OTA update systems.
  • CAN bus systems and standards (e.g. J1939).
  • Buildroot or Yocto.
  • Working on real‑world autonomous vehicles or heavy machinery.

Benefits

  • Be part of a committed team and see the rewards of your work — all early team members, including this role, hold company options, so each of us is rewarded for the company's success.
  • Real‑world impact: your software directly controls heavy machinery operating in the paddock.
  • Architectural influence: report directly to the CTO and help shape the future of Ornata's autonomy stack.
  • A hands‑on engineering environment in Richmond, with access to live hardware, testing rigs, and field deployments.
  • Quick‑paced career growth for tenacious go‑getters.
  • Be part of an inner‑city Melbourne team building technology for one of Australia's most important industries.
  • A base package of $130,000–$160,000, plus superannuation and employee share options (ESOP). We expect to offer a competitive senior package for the right person.

Location

Melbourne, Australia (on‑site, at least 3 days a week, at our Melbourne office)

title: Senior Software Engineer - Agent Team
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Agent Team based in the United States.

Join a distributed engineering team building a cloud-native endpoint management platform that helps organizations secure, configure, and maintain devices at scale. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Agent Team, you will design and develop reliable, secure services that communicate with millions of software agents deployed across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. You will take ownership of complex features throughout the entire development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Working across backend services, frontend interfaces, and event-driven architectures, you will help deliver scalable solutions that simplify modern IT operations. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, mentor fellow engineers, and champion high standards for security, quality, and performance. This remote opportunity offers meaningful technical ownership, challenging distributed systems problems, and the chance to shape products used by organizations worldwide.

Accountabilities:

  • Design and develop scalable solutions: Research, architect, build, secure, and maintain software services that support communication with more than two million deployed endpoint agents worldwide.
  • Own features end to end: Lead significant features and services from technical design and implementation through testing, release, production monitoring, and ongoing maintenance, including associated frontend interfaces.
  • Evolve distributed systems: Extend and improve event-driven services, microservices, and large-scale event ingestion platforms to support new capabilities across the endpoint management platform.
  • Prioritize security and reliability: Apply secure coding practices, follow established security standards, and proactively address vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks.
  • Champion engineering excellence: Lead by example in code quality, testing, documentation, refactoring, automation, and adherence to modern software development practices.
  • Optimize application performance: Monitor production behavior, evaluate the impact of changes, use data to guide decisions, and continuously improve scalability, responsiveness, and system stability.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with Product, Program Management, Quality Engineering, and Technical Support to clarify ambiguous requirements, define practical solutions, and deliver customer-focused outcomes.
  • Provide technical leadership: Mentor junior engineers, share knowledge, contribute to architectural discussions, and promote effective engineering practices across the team.
  • Support continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve development workflows, testing strategies, usability, and operational processes while maintaining a high standard of software quality.

Requirements:

  • Professional experience: At least five years of experience designing, developing, testing, and monitoring applications in high-availability SaaS environments.
  • Backend engineering: Strong professional experience with Go or Java, along with the versatility to work across multiple programming languages and technology stacks.
  • Distributed systems: Experience developing applications that maintain continuous connectivity with client software, ideally involving real-time communication, persistent connections, or large-scale agent-based architectures.
  • Cloud infrastructure: Hands-on experience building and operating production applications in cloud environments, particularly AWS, with a strong focus on security, availability, and scalability.
  • Frontend development: Professional experience delivering frontend functionality using TypeScript and a modern JavaScript framework. You should be comfortable owning the user interface associated with backend features without needing to specialize exclusively in frontend engineering.
  • Security expertise: Practical experience implementing secure coding practices and applying relevant security principles, such as the OWASP guidelines.
  • Microservices and event-driven architecture: Familiarity with scaling microservices, event ingestion systems, WebSockets, real-time messaging technologies such as Kafka or MQTT, and non-relational databases such as DynamoDB.
  • Systems and operations knowledge: Understanding of networking, DevOps practices, application monitoring, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
  • Testing and quality assurance: A quality-first mindset, with experience designing effective tests, improving automated testing practices, and validating the impact of changes before and after release.
  • Leadership and communication: Strong communication skills, sound technical judgment, and the ability to mentor colleagues while working effectively with engineering and non-engineering stakeholders in a remote environment.
  • Collaboration and ownership: A proactive, analytical approach to solving complex problems, taking responsibility for outcomes, and balancing independent execution with close team collaboration.
  • Additional advantages: Experience developing desktop or cross-platform applications; building software that runs on customer endpoints across Windows, macOS, or Linux, such as agents, installers, and system services; or writing automated end-to-end tests using Python, Playwright, or similar tools.
  • Work authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future employer-sponsored visa support.
  • Location eligibility: This is a fully remote position within the United States. Candidates based in California or the New York metropolitan area are not eligible.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation: Annual base salary ranging from $140,000 to $190,000 USD, depending on experience, skills, industry knowledge, and location.
  • Additional compensation: Bonus opportunities and equity for full-time employees, in addition to base salary and benefits.
  • Retirement planning: 401(k) matching to help support long-term financial goals.
  • Flexible time off: Flexible paid time off and a generous sick leave policy.
  • Comprehensive healthcare: Medical coverage with substantial employer contributions, along with comprehensive health plan options.
  • Insurance protection: Company-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance.
  • Health savings support: Monthly employer contributions to a Health Savings Account (HSA), ranging from $100 to $200 depending on the selected plan tier.
  • Lifestyle benefits: A $25 monthly lifestyle spending allowance to support personal well-being and everyday needs.
  • Remote work support: $50 per month in internet reimbursement and a $500 home office stipend.
  • Family support: A $10,000 adoption benefit and family planning coverage through the applicable medical plan.
  • Remote-first culture: Work from a home office as part of a fully distributed team that values autonomy, collaboration, and meaningful ownership.
  • Professional development: Opportunities to strengthen technical leadership, tackle complex engineering challenges, and contribute to the evolution of a widely used cloud-native platform.
  • Inclusive workplace: A commitment to equal employment opportunities and a respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued.

  • Experience supporting classified surveillance aircraft or specialized federal law enforcement aviation programs.

Top Secret (TS) - must be able to obtain and retain.

Primarily supporting activities in the National Capital Region (NCR), with travel to aircraft, maintenance providers, and other customer locations as required.

This position is anticipated to be available upon contract award in 2027.

title: 2027 Spring Pulliam Journalism Fellowship in Photojournalism
description:
IndyStar, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is seeking a college student or recent graduate with a talent for video and photojournalism to join our award-winning visuals staff for an exciting and demanding spring fellowship.

The fellow will work 40 hours per week, covering a full range of assignments — including news, sports and features — with an equal focus on stills and video (including social video). There will also be opportunities to work on long-term projects, photo pages and documentary videos. Night and weekend shifts will be required.

We are looking for someone who is highly driven and eager to generate story ideas. The right candidate will be a sponge, ready to absorb knowledge from this veteran staff.

Why should I apply for this journalism program?
You'll be a member of our newsroom, work hard and gain valuable journalism experience as part of the prestigious Pulliam Journalism Fellowship.

You'll get paid, too. Fellows earn $720/week ($18/hr) for the 19-week spring program.

IndyStar supplies a laptop and full range of camera equipment. Mileage is also covered.

Am I qualified for this journalism program?
Recent graduates and college juniors, seniors and graduate students enrolled in a journalism or related degree program as of Nov. 1, 2026, are eligible.

Experience in a previous newspaper journalism internship and/or at a college newspaper is required.

You need to be committed to a career in news journalism. You must have reliable transportation and arrange for your own housing. We are an equal opportunity employer that values diversity among its journalism fellows.

What's the deadline for this fellowship application?
All application materials must be submitted by Nov. 20, 2026, but applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis so candidates are encouraged to apply now.

When should I be there?
Dates are flexible, but expect the 19-week fellowship to run from January 2027 through the end of May 2026, capping off the term as part of the team covering the Indy 500.

How do I apply?
Please attach your resume and cover letter stating why you would be a good fit for our team along with your application.

If you have questions, please contact Senior Visuals Editor Max Gersh at max.gersh@indystar.com.

title: Assistant General Manager

About the Company
At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.

About the Role

The Assistant Property Manager will complete daily transactions and tasks related to the financial operations of the community, including collecting and posting rent, fees, and other payments, preparing daily bank deposits, and preparing financial reports using appropriate property management systems while working closely with the accounting department to identify and trace transactions that do not reconcile with bank records.

This role supports property operations, leasing, resident relations, and financial performance while ensuring a positive living experience for all residents.

  • Assist in marketing efforts to attract and retain residents.

  • Assist in managing lease applications, renewals, and move-ins/move-outs.
  • Ensure all leasing paperwork is completed accurately and efficiently.
  • May assist in-person leasing and marketing efforts to achieve the property's revenue and occupancy goals by greeting prospective residents face-to-face, gathering information about the prospect, showing ready apartments and models, assisting the prospective resident in completing the rental application and credit verification, and closing lease by obtaining required payments and security deposit.
  • Participate and assist team efforts to elevate the resident experience and maximize building revenues.

  • Responsible for managing Flow’s Resident Experience Team
  • Respond to resident inquiries, concerns, and complaints in a professional and timely manner. Maintain regular communication with residents and proactively address residents’ concerns to maintain an elevated resident experience.
  • Support community events and initiatives to foster positive resident engagement.
  • Assist in enforcing property rules and policies to ensure a safe and harmonious environment.
  • Promote resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues. This includes the ability to work in a fluid environment and work peacefully with co-workers and residents.
  • Follow the Company’s established procedures related to evictions with proper notice requirements and represent the property as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.

Financial Management

  • Assist in the collection of rent payments, security deposits, and other fees.
  • Follow up on delinquent accounts and coordinate with the Community Manager on rent collection efforts.
  • Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports as required.
  • Accurately enter all approved bills into the property accounting system scan all invoices to the community’s data drive, and submit them to accounting for processing.
  • Review resident files and accounting records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicate with residents regarding outstanding balances, implement procedures for collecting delinquencies, and enforce lease terms to maximize revenue.

Property Operations

  • Support the Community Manager with managing maintenance requests and ensuring timely completion.
  • Conduct property inspections to maintain curb appeal, safety standards, and compliance with regulations.
  • Coordinate with vendors and contractors for property-related services.
  • Act as the on-site supervisor in the absence of the Community Manager by organizing and delegating daily work, coordinating maintenance and make-ready tasks with the maintenance supervisor, and managing the operation of the community in compliance with company policies, procedures, and business practices.
  • Support with the hotel operation rentals

Administrative Support

  • Maintain accurate records of resident information, leasing agreements, and financial documentation.
  • Assist with managing budgets, monitoring expenses, and identifying cost-saving opportunities.
  • Support compliance with Fair Housing laws, local, state, and federal regulations.
  • Process resident move-outs by reviewing lease terms and notice requirements, applying appropriate deposit and lease cancellation fees if applicable, and processing the disposition in accordance with established procedures and legal requirements.

Ideal Background:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years of experience in property management, leasing, or customer service with a preference for Class A high-rise multifamily
  • Experience with sales, marketing, and financial data
  • Proficiency in computer software including but not limited to G-Suite and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) required
  • Experience with Yardi, Payscan, Rent Cafe, Commercial Cafe, and Bluemoon preferred
  • Strong customer service, problem solving, and interpersonal skills
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail required
  • Knowledge of rental contracts and property and anti-discrimination laws preferred
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities
  • Understanding of Fair Housing regulations and compliance.
  • Experience in multi-family housing or residential property management.
Benefits

We take care of our people so they can do their best work.

  • Health and Wellness Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance and parental leave benefits. On-staff doctor, free therapy through SpringHealth, acupuncture, an Employee Assistance Program, and other wellness offerings.
  • Time Off PTO and paid holidays.
  • Financial 401(k) retirement plan, healthcare and dependent care FSAs, HSA-compatible plan options with annual employer HSA funding and pre-tax commuter benefits.
  • Life at Flow Weekly catered lunches, wellness classes and employee discounts on Flow hotel stays, grocer products, and merch.
Flow is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and hires regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity and/or expression, pregnancy, Veteran status any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. title: Quality Risk Specialist III
description:
Location: Lynnwood,Washington,United States

POSITION SUMMARY

The Quality Risk and Compliance Mission is to provide best practices of quality risk management, data integrity and auditing, to ensure patient safety and product quality at PTx. The Quality Risk Specialist III serves to keep patients safe by managing risks to cGMP manufacturing (drug product and drug substance) and testing operations. This position is primarily responsible for supporting growth of the Data Integrity and Quality Risk Management programs.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the development and continuous improvement of the Quality Risk Management program to ensure product quality, patient safety, and regulatory compliance.
  • Facilitate Quality Risk Assessments using established methodologies, including Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and risk-based assessments.
  • Partner with cross-functional subject matter experts to identify, evaluate, and mitigate quality risks to acceptable levels, including data integrity risks.
  • Maintain the risk library through periodic reviews, change control assessments, and updates to existing risk evaluations.
  • Evaluate residual risks following implementation of mitigation measures to ensure effectiveness.
  • Serve as a Quality Risk Management subject matter expert, providing guidance, coaching, and training to risk facilitators, process owners, and cross-functional teams.
  • Develop training materials and deliver training on risk management principles, methodologies, and tools.
  • Prepare risk assessment reports and manage documentation, review, and approval workflows through MasterControl.
  • Communicate significant quality risks, trends, and mitigation strategies to leadership through Management Review, Quality Council, and risk reporting processes.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to resolve complex risk-related issues, escalate concerns, and implement sustainable process improvements.
  • Manage multiple risk assessment projects independently, ensuring timely completion and alignment with organizational priorities.
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable GMP regulations, ICH Q9 guidelines, industry best practices, and evolving quality risk management standards.
  • Ensure compliance with company SOPs, applicable regulatory requirements, and mandatory Quality and Compliance training.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES

Required:

  • Well-grounded in FDA and/or other regulatory agencies expectations.
  • Experienced in report writing for this regulated industry.
  • Experienced in Quality Risk Management principles and applications.
  • Experience participating in external agency inspections (i.e., FDA, EMA)
  • Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the proven ability to formulate solutions to propel the organization forward.
  • Resourceful with proven ability to lead, manage, and leverage an extensive internal network of stakeholders, team members, and external resources to plan and resolve issues. Strong, collaborative relationship management and interpersonal skills required to quickly gain confidence of stakeholders and team members.
  • Possesses strong organizational and prioritization skills to maintain a high level of productivity and priority-setting in order to complete assignments on-time and on-budget.
  • Excellent soft skills including a bias towards action, the ability and willingness to give and receive constructive feedback, is comfortable working within a diverse team and across multiple functions, exhibits a consistently constructive attitude, and is adaptable and at ease with handling unexpected changes and challenges.
  • Solid English language communication skills, both oral and written, are required for this highly collaborative role. Willingness and ability to clearly express opinions and ask questions. Comfortable actively participating in cross-functional meetings.
  • Proficiency with MS Office products, especially Word and Excel essential; ability and willingness to quickly adopt other job-specific applications will be necessary.

Preferred:

  • Demonstrated experience in writing risk assessment reports with clear justification/rationale that informs the risk scores and draws logical, clearly written conclusions based on risk.
  • Demonstrated experience in leading risk teams in performing risk analysis with various risk tools, including assessing risks to data integrity.
  • Experience creating training materials and delivering training in person, virtual or through web videos.
  • Experience with Stature software for conducting risk analysis.
  • Knowledge of Data Integrity in a highly regulated environment.
  • Software application experience with Smartsheet, MS Project, and SharePoint.
  • Project management experience or formal training.

EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION

Required:

  • High School diploma or GED.
  • 4 + years of experience in manufacturing, testing, quality or regulated operational environment
  • 3+ years of conducting or supporting formal risk assessments in a regulated setting.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Science, Computers, or Quality Engineering
  • ASQ credential specialty in Risk Management and Data Quality
  • ASQ certifications such as Quality Management (CMQ/OE) or Quality Engineer (CQE), Lean Six Sigma Greenbelt or Blackbelt (CCSGB or CCSBB) or related certification

title: Solution Architect - Malaysia
description:
Are you passionate about technology and enjoy explaining complex solutions in a way that everybody gets excited? If so, read on!
About Picus
Picus Security is an exposure validation company. One platform proves what attackers can exploit and what your defenses stop, turning every exposure into a defensible decision, autonomously and at the machine speed today's AI threats demand.

Picus validates attack surfaces, exposures, and security controls as one continuous loop: validate, decide, fix, re-validate. Instead of ranking findings by severity score, Picus proves which exposures are genuinely exploitable in your environment, including the business-critical, restricted, and air-gapped assets a live exploit can never safely touch, so teams act on what truly matters and resolve each exposure into a clear call to patch, mitigate, monitor, or accept with evidence.

The Picus Platform spans Autonomous Penetration Testing, Exposure Validation, and Breach and Attack Simulation, unified by Picus Swarm, a swarm of AI agents that runs the whole validation loop continuously. It reaches across on-prem, hybrid cloud, and endpoint environments, with 75+ integrations that ingest from scanners like Tenable and Wiz and operationalize through your EDR, SIEM, firewall, and ticketing tools.

The pioneer of Breach and Attack Simulation, Picus proves and improves the security controls you already own, doubling control effectiveness within three months. Picus holds a 95% recommendation rate, 4.9 on G2, and 4.8 on Gartner Peer Insights, and is the #1 Leader on Frost Radar for Automated Security Validation.


About the Role
We are looking for a hardworking Solutions Architect with 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity and a passion for turning security validation into measurable customer outcomes. Reporting to the Solution Architect Manager, APAC, you will be part of the regional SA team and partner with Account Executives and channel partners to win new business and grow our Enterprise customer base. This position requires a technically credible professional who is comfortable working across teams and has a record of contributing to closed deals and customer expansion.
What You'll Do

  • Bring deep knowledge of the Picus platform to help the sales team present and position it to prospects and customers,
  • Run technical discovery to understand customer needs, challenges, and infrastructure, acting as a trusted technical advisor throughout the sales cycle,
  • Deliver tailored live demos and proof-of-value engagements that show how Picus helps customers validate their defenses and reduce exposure,
  • Respond to technical sections of RFPs and RFIs with clear and compelling answers,
  • Work with sales and product teams to design and refine solutions that connect security detail to business outcomes,
  • Work alongside Customer Success to support adoption and spot expansion opportunities,
  • Educate partners on the technical aspects of the Picus platform to help them sell more effectively and accelerate revenue,
  • Relay feedback from the field to product and engineering teams to contribute to ongoing product improvement.
What You Have
  • Bachelor’s degree, or an equivalent combination of education and Sales Engineering or Customer Success experience in Security, Cloud, or Network Systems,
  • 3-5 years of experience in a Sales Engineering or Customer Success role,
  • Demonstrated success building executive relationships and driving strategic account planning,
  • Broad technology experience across risk visibility and prioritization, SIEM, EDR, cloud architecture, networking, security, and IT transformation,
  • Understanding of solution architecture and design across on-prem and cloud environments,
  • Experience managing complex customer lifecycles from onboarding through renewal and expansion,
  • A consultative, proactive, and outcome-focused approach,
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Working at Picus
Fascinating work - a chance to shape and lead an exciting, fast-growing cyber security segment. Security Validation is a concept that helps organizations evaluate their security posture in a continuous, automated, and repeatable way. This approach allows for the identification of imminent threats, provides recommended actions, and produces valuable metrics about cyber-risk levels.
Unlimited opportunity! We are growing. At Picus, you'll be provided with as much responsibility as you can handle - new career development opportunities constantly arise given our rate of growth.
Global exposure - Get a lot of experience working not only in a fast-growing startup but also interact with customers all around the world.
Be part of a global remote team who is taking on Exposure Validation and a growing market segment.

title: Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps based in Ireland.

As a Senior Technical Trainer, you will combine hands-on DevOps expertise with a passion for teaching to develop practical, engaging courses on AI-powered engineering workflows. You will help engineers understand how to apply AI agents, coding assistants, and modern AI tools to real-world infrastructure and automation challenges. Working alongside a curriculum team and experienced technical educators, you will design lessons, develop hands-on lab specifications, and record clear, compelling instructional videos. This remote freelance opportunity begins with a paid course project, typically lasting around three months, with the potential for ongoing projects or a full-time position. You will have the flexibility to work alongside existing commitments while contributing your technical knowledge to a global engineering community. The ideal candidate is a practising DevOps engineer who can simplify complex concepts, communicate confidently on camera, and create learning experiences that make advanced technologies accessible.

Accountabilities

  • Design and develop technical courses

    • Collaborate with the curriculum team to define course structure, learning objectives, lesson sequences, and practical lab exercises focused on AI for DevOps.

    • Develop content that demonstrates how engineers use AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation in real infrastructure environments.

    • Ensure lessons are technically accurate, relevant, practical, and aligned with the needs of working engineers.

    • Create engaging instructional content

      • Write concise, story-driven video scripts designed to explain technical concepts clearly, with individual lessons typically lasting around six minutes.

      • Use AI tools where helpful during drafting while ensuring the final scripts reflect your own voice, expertise, and teaching style.

      • Narrate and present lessons confidently in English, making complex technical topics approachable for learners at different experience levels.

      • Develop and validate hands-on labs

        • Write detailed specifications for practical labs that demonstrate real-world DevOps and AI workflows.

        • Collaborate with the dedicated labs team responsible for building the lab environments.

        • Test completed labs, validate technical accuracy, and ensure exercises deliver the intended learning outcomes.

        • Record demonstrations and walkthroughs explaining how to complete lab exercises and solve practical challenges.

        • Collaborate on quality and editorial development

          • Work closely with curriculum and production teams throughout the course development process.

          • Incorporate structured editorial feedback, particularly during the initial course section, to align content with established teaching standards.

          • Participate in regular team syncs and maintain communication through collaboration tools such as Slack.

          • Focus on technical expertise, teaching, scripting, and recording while the production team manages video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

            • Requirements:

            • Hands-on DevOps and infrastructure experience

              • Strong practical knowledge of Linux, containers, Kubernetes, at least one major cloud platform, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (IaC).

              • Experience building, operating, and maintaining infrastructure rather than relying solely on theoretical knowledge.

              • The ability to demonstrate real engineering workflows and translate practical experience into effective learning materials.

              • Current experience with AI technologies

                • Practical experience using AI tools in engineering work, including AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation.

                • Genuine curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and a commitment to staying current with new tools and techniques.

                • The ability to explain how AI can support infrastructure engineering and DevOps workflows; deep specialization in AI research is not required.

                • Teaching and communication skills

                  • A demonstrated passion for teaching, supported by experience creating courses, publishing tutorials, delivering talks or workshops, mentoring colleagues, or sharing technical knowledge with a community.

                  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, naturally, and confidently on camera.

                  • Strong storytelling skills and the ability to break down complex technical concepts into simple, structured explanations.

                  • Empathy for learners, particularly beginners, and an understanding of how to make technical material engaging and accessible.

                  • Collaboration and adaptability

                    • Willingness to follow an established teaching methodology and incorporate constructive editorial feedback.

                    • Ability to work independently, organize deliverables, and meet an agreed project schedule.

                    • Comfort working remotely with a distributed team, including participation in weekly syncs and some time-zone overlap with colleagues based in Europe and Asia.

                    • Additional qualifications considered an advantage

                      • Previously published online courses on platforms such as Udemy or Pluralsight, or experience authoring a technical book.

                      • Experience speaking at conferences or meetups, maintaining a technical YouTube channel or blog, or contributing to technical communities.

                      • Community credentials or roles such as CNCF Ambassador, AWS Community Builder, or Microsoft MVP.

                      • Relevant Kubernetes certifications, including CKA, CKAD, or CKS, or recognition such as Kubestronaut.

                      • Cloud certifications from providers such as AWS or Microsoft Azure.

                        • Benefits:

                        • Competitive fixed fee per course, agreed upfront based on course length and topic complexity, with higher compensation for advanced topics and exceptional instructors.

                        • Paid freelance project that can be completed alongside an existing job, with no fixed weekly-hour requirement.

                        • A typical initial project duration of approximately three months, with a mutually agreed delivery plan.

                        • Potential to progress to a full-time role or take on additional course projects based on mutual fit.

                        • Fully remote working arrangements with flexible hours.

                        • Opportunity to collaborate with a global technical education team and reach a community of more than one million engineers.

                        • Dedicated production support for video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and course publishing, allowing you to focus on teaching and technical content.

                        • Opportunity to share your expertise in AI, DevOps, cloud, and Kubernetes through practical, hands-on education.
