title: Account Director, Content (Film/Television/Streaming)
description:
Sunshine Sachs Morgan & Lylis is a leading global communications agency built to navigate the complexities of a hyper-connected world. We represent the icons and innovators shaping culture—from global heritage corporations and high-growth tech startups to the non-profits, creative legends, and visionary founders who define the global discourse.
Our expertise spans the full cultural spectrum. We operate at the intersection of entertainment, social impact, corporate reputation, and consumer lifestyle, executing seamlessly across traditional media, social-first outlets, brand partnerships, and influencer ecosystems. Whether we are navigating complex crisis management, elevating advocacy campaigns, or launching global consumer brands, we are storytellers at our core.
You may notice our digital presence is purposefully understated. While our clients are global household names, we believe the best work happens when the spotlight stays firmly on those we represent. We fly under the radar by design - preferring to let our campaigns, and our results, speak for themselves.
If you're driven, intentional, and ready to do good, we're ready for you!

Sunshine Sachs Morgan & Lylis has an immediate opening for a strategic, high-energy Account Director to join our Los Angeles team. We are looking for a modern storyteller who understands that in 2026, a successful release is no longer just about a premiere—it is about architecting a narrative that lives across streaming platforms, social ecosystems, and global cultural conversations.
You have at least 7–8 years of experience and a deep mastery of the film and television landscape. You understand the nuances of a festival run, the mechanics of an awards campaign, and the shifting dynamics of the streaming world. Most importantly, you know that a true modern storyteller looks beyond the red carpet to drive engagement both online and offline, rethinking traditional concepts to ensure content breaks through the noise.

The Role:

  • Modern Storytelling & Release Strategy: Lead the development of 360-degree communications strategies for film, TV, and streaming projects. You understand how to build a narrative that captures the attention of trade editors, consumer media, and digital-first audiences alike.
  • Integrated Campaign Leadership: Manage account teams and projects from inception to completion. You serve as a strategic partner to production companies, directors, and creators, ensuring that every campaign is integrated with brand, influencer, and digital strategy.
  • Executive & Talent Counsel: Build impactful, trusting relationships with clients and talent. You provide thoughtful counsel through the high-pressure environments of premieres, press junkets, and stressful release windows, acting as a steady advisor to senior stakeholders.
  • Media & Cultural Authority: Leverage an elite network of entertainment press contacts to secure impactful media moments. You understand how to bridge the gap between traditional prestige outlets and the emerging platforms where modern audiences live.
  • Cross-Discipline Collaboration: Partner with senior colleagues across our national offices on integrated, bi-coastal accounts. You are energized by the opportunity to collaborate with our talent, social, and brand integration teams to create truly multidimensional campaigns.
  • Mentorship & Team Architecture: Train and mentor junior staff on the inner workings of entertainment PR and modern client management. This is incredibly important to us—you are a natural coach who is invested in building the next generation of account leaders.
  • Business Development: Lead new business meetings and draft persuasive proposals. You are a confident closer who can articulate the value of a modern, integrated approach to entertainment communications.
  • Relationship Driven: You recognize that the entertainment business is built on trust and integrity. You lead by example in every interaction—prioritizing professional poise and transparency with your team, your clients, and the media.

Who You Are:

  • The Entertainment Specialist: You have at least 8 years of experience in public relations, with a specific focus on film and television releases. You have a proven track record of maneuvering through the complexities of the studio and streaming landscape.
  • The Modern Strategist: You are an outside-the-box thinker who loves a good brainstorm. You know how to rethink traditional concepts to drive engagement and establish media opportunities for talent that feel fresh and authentic.
  • A Meticulous Storyteller: You are a strong writer—persuasive, concise, and creative. You can take a complex production or a visionary director’s concept and translate it into a narrative that compels an editor to take notice.
  • Entrepreneurial & Curious: You have an innate curiosity and a desire to grow your skills beyond a single vertical. You are excited to work with everyone from established studios to emerging content creators.
  • Exceptionally Organized: You excel at managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. You are accountable, decisive, and take genuine pride in the precision of your work.
  • Driven to Over-Deliver: You take pride in being part of something good and are energized by the challenge of bringing entertainment moments to life in a way that exceeds client expectations.
Benefits x Perks
We go well beyond the benefits that you’re looking for like medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with matching, annual merit-based bonuses, PTO, fertility, FSA for medical, childcare, and commuter expenses. Eligible employees at Sunshine Sachs Morgan & Lylis may access these benefits, along with many additional perks including, a flexible work schedule, Work from Anywhere program, Summer Fridays, Wellness Days, and a 4-week sabbatical or trip to celebrate select anniversaries. We love to socialize so, we have collaborative workspaces, some offices even have rooftops, celebrations, networking opportunities, and community volunteering. We frequently mark opportunities to listen, learn and act throughout the year (Juneteenth, Election Day, International Women’s Day, etc.).
SSM&L is committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and ability. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, identity and expression, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
There’s more!
From day one, employees are carefully matched with a mentor to guide them on their path to success. Training and mentoring are a big deal here and since we are into promoting from within, we make sure to provide more than enough tools for you to learn and grow. We are proud to offer training throughout the year on topics for professional growth as well as personal growth. We have also developed a series of teaching workshops that are structured for each level of the company. Sunshiners also take love to take advantage of the monthly Meet the Industry series where industry thought leaders provide valuable insider info on how to work with them and their colleagues.

title: Apparel Technical Designer
description:
CREATIVE + TECHNICAL + ACCURATE + TEAM-FIRST.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We live in a fast-paced creative world. Lakeshirts is looking for an experienced Apparel Technical Designer to help move apparel ideas from concept to production-ready reality.

You will partner with design and product teams to build garments across multiple product lines. This role creates tech packs, reviews samples, supports fittings, troubleshoots construction details, and communicates technical updates with vendors. It is a strong fit for someone who loves apparel product development, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, accuracy, and teamwork.

PAY + SCHEDULE

Location: Detroit Lakes, MN. This is a full-time, onsite role.

Shift: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-5:00 PM.

Pay: $18.00-$22.00 per hour, based on experience.

Growth: This role can grow through stronger fit ownership, vendor communication, technical documentation, and product development support. Advancement opportunities vary by department and business need.

BENEFITS

Lakeshirts offers a fun, creative, and team-driven culture where employees are empowered to grow and thrive. We provide competitive pay with daily pay options, comprehensive insurance benefits, up to 22 paid days off in the first year, profit sharing, a 401(k) plan, a relaxed dress code, unique perks like an onsite cafeteria and more. Join us and be part of a company that values teamwork, innovation, and making work better in a t-shirt.

A TYPICAL DAY

  • Move apparel styles from concept to production-ready samples by resolving fit, construction, measurement, and specification questions.
  • Create and update tech packs, specs, grading rules, point-of-measurement standards, and fit documentation in Excel and related systems.
  • Apply knowledge of fabrics, trims, garment construction, sewing, technical drawing, measuring, and fitting to support quality and consistency.
  • Manage incoming samples and sample libraries; review fit, construction, design intent, and production readiness.
  • Coordinate model fittings, document measurements, and update specs based on fit sessions, size runs, revisions, and vendor feedback.
  • Troubleshoot fit, grading, construction, production, quality, and costing concerns while recommending practical solutions.
  • Communicate technical updates, specification changes, fit requirements, and sample feedback to vendors, suppliers, and teammates.
  • Support fabric testing, process improvements, product presentations, and technical design standards while performing other duties as assigned.

SKILLS

  • Degree in Fashion, Apparel Design, Technical Design, or related apparel fieldrequired.
  • 4+ years of technical design experience in apparel, merchandising, product development, or a related apparel environment.
  • Knowledge of pattern making, grading, garment construction, sewing, technical drawing, measuring, fitting, fabrics, trims, and development timelines.
  • Proficient in Adobe Illustrator, PLM or product systems, Microsoft Office, and Excel; able tomaintain accurate technical documentation.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple apparel projects in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Strong written communication, decision-making, follow-through, and time-management skills; comfortable working with vendors and cross-functional teams.

WHY LAKESHIRTS IS THE PLACE YOU WANT TO BE

At Lakeshirts, we believe in making work as awesome as the apparel we create. We are not just a t-shirt company; we are also a hat, sticker, sock, and so-much-more company. Creativity meets culture here, and ideas, innovation, and teamwork are part of the day-to-day. Better in a t-shirt. And work should be too.

COGNITIVE OR MENTAL REQUIREMENTS OF THE JOB

Employee must be able to read, write, understand, and communicate work instructions, measurements, specifications, and vendor feedback. This role requires good judgment, attention to detail, organization, flexibility, problem solving, follow-through, collaboration, and the ability to manage changing priorities.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

CONTINUOUSLY: Use a computer, review apparel details, communicate with teammates, and alternate between sitting, standing, and walking as needed.

FREQUENTLY: Handle garments, samples, trims, documents, and other materials; reach at desk or table height; lift or carry items under 10 lbs.

OCCASIONALLY: Lift, carry, push, or pull materials weighing 10-50 lbs.; bend, twist, reach above or below shoulder height, climb, balance, or move sample materials as needed. Move items over 50 lbs. with assistance or equipment when appropriate.

NEVER: Crawl as an essential function of the role.

NOTE / DISCLAIMER

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, skills, effort, or working conditions. Responsibilities may change based on business needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

title: Senior/Principal Systems Information Systems Architect, Onsite
description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

  • Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
  • Extraordinary co-workers
  • Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
  • Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
  • Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov


*These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

The Technical Systems Security Department (9246) is seeking an Information Systems Architect to translate complex Technical Security Systems requirements into secure, high-performance hardware and software solutions. This role will lead end-to-end system design, integration, and testing, as well as feasibility studies, requirements gathering, and technology evaluations to enhance and modernize our Intrusion Detection and Access Control Systems.

The Technical Systems Security Department (9246) is seeking an Information Systems Architect to translate complex Technical Security Systems requirements into secure, high-performance hardware and software solutions. This role will lead end-to-end system design, integration, and testing, as well as feasibility studies, requirements gathering, and technology evaluations to enhance and modernize our Intrusion Detection and Access Control Systems.

Partnering closely with cross-functional teams, you will develop detailed specifications, assess technical alternatives, and recommend improvements that ensure scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency across the organization. You will also provide technical leadership and guidance to drive strategic initiatives and foster collaboration.

On any given day, you may be called to:

  • Translate business needs into technical solutions and define solutions to business problems through reasoned application of information technology.
  • Determine integrated hardware and software architecture solutions that meet performance, scalability, reliability, and security needs.
  • Design, develop, and analyze overall architecture of internal systems, including hardware and software.
  • Work with stakeholders and staff to conduct high-level investigations for strategy studies, requirements specifications, and feasibility studies, and communicate requirements to management.
  • Coordinate design and integration of information systems, including subsystems such as networking, virtual machines, and traditional servers/workstations across all SNL sites.

*Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite.

Salary Range

$102,400 - $199,700

*Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems / Management Information Systems (MIS), Computer Science or Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or relevant discipline and 8 years relevant experience or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Master's degree in Info Systems, MIS, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Tech Management (IT/Enterprise Architecture track), or related fields like Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing.
  • Designs, develops, and analyzes overall architecture of internal systems, including hardware and software.
  • Create architectural diagrams, models, and specifications for hardware, software, networks, and data storage
  • Translate organizational objectives and stakeholder requirements into scalable technical solutions
  • Evaluate existing legacy systems, identify bottlenecks or vulnerabilities, and recommend modernizations or upgrades
  • Research and recommend technology to improve systems, tackle emerging threats, and boost innovation.
  • Develop/modify info systems by analyzing needs, documenting requirements, and updating configurations.
  • Manage and maintain system architecture for peak performance.
  • Troubleshoot system issues to minimize downtime and keep systems solid.
  • Configure settings, run tests (unit, integration, acceptance), and ensure DOE compliance and meet business requirements.
  • Use industry tools to monitor, analyze, and fix system problems, maintaining efficiency and security.
  • Document system architecture and procedures to support knowledge sharing and future upgrades.

Skills & Knowledge:

  • Knowledge and experience with CISCO appliances.
  • Cisco CCNA Certification (CCNP or CCIE Preferred).
  • Enterprise/Solution Architecture Frameworks: TOGAF, Zachman, FEAF, DoDAF.
  • Cloud Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Architect.
  • Security Certifications: CISSP, CISM, SABSA.
  • IT Service & Governance: ITIL, COBIT.
  • Agile & DevOps: SAFe Architect, Scrum (PSM/CSM).
  • Systems Design & Integration: Systems engineering, data modeling, database management.
  • Networking & VM Architecture: Network design, VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, KVM.
  • Cybersecurity Basics: Secure architecture, threat modeling, risk management.
  • Software Dev Life Cycle: DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, automation tools.
  • Business/IT Alignment: Requirements analysis, project management, stakeholder communication.
  • Leadership & Collaboration: Technical leadership, cross-team coordination, mentoring.

About Our Team

The Technical Security Systems (TSS) department at Sandia National Laboratories (SNL) provides a secure, robust, and sustainable electronic security system in support of Sandia's critical missions. The department is responsible for sustaining this security system at an acceptable level that meets Department of Energy (DOE) requirements. This is achieved by implementing high level standards and configuration control to the security systems followed by structured, preventive, and corrective maintenance processes. The TSS department interfaces and integrates with other departments within the Safeguards and Security Center which include Physical Security, Personnel Security, and the Protective Force. In addition to supporting the electronic security systems at SNL-NM, TSS provides program and technical support to several remote sites within the US.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

EEO

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements for MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

title: Associate HR Analyst - APAC
description:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?
At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

We are looking for an Associate HR Analyst, to join the Human Resources team in Manila, supporting our APAC markets. This is an early-career position that plays a key operational role supporting our Regional HR Business Partners (HRBPs), ensuring our people processes run smoothly across multiple markets.

You will work closely with the Regional HRBP, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition (TA), People Service Delivery (PSD), and business leaders across the region, contributing to a seamless employee experience and helping turn people priorities into action. You will support key HR processes, provide insights and follow-up, and help ensure that our people practices are consistently and effectively delivered across the region in line with global guidelines.

This role is designed for someone who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and is energized by problem-solving. It is a permanent, hybrid position based in Manila, with three days per week in the office.

What You Will Do

Hiring and Selection

  • Support the Regional HRBP in submitting hiring requests to TA through Workday
  • Share regular updates with the Regional HRBP on hiring status and flag any potential hiring risks or challenges

    • Onboarding and Offboarding

    • Coordinate and facilitate welcome meetings and inductions for new hires
    • Ensure hiring managers take an active role in a standardized onboarding and induction template, and contribute to the onboarding process where necessary
    • Conduct the scheduled check-in meetings with new employees and their managers; document key findings and flag risks to the Regional HRBP
    • Track onboarding and offboarding processes: documentation, system updates, coordination with legal providers, and final payment follow-up
    • Conduct the exit interview for voluntary resignations and analyze exit surveys to flag risks or challenges to the Regional HRBP

      • HR Employee Support

      • Collaborate with PSD on complex employee queries related to other HR topics such as time-off requests and balances, Workday challenges, and more
      • Liaise with PSD on open Jira tickets and ensure timely resolution and follow-up
      • Actively contribute to the FAQ and knowledge base for recurring questions to reduce query volume over time, in partnership with the broader HR team

        • Coordinate logistics for engagement activities: communications, scheduling, materials, and tracking
        • Assist in collecting and organizing data for engagement surveys and post-program follow-ups

          • HR Systems and Data Integrity (HRIS)

          • Own the accuracy of Workday organizational structures: positions, attributes, reporting lines, and job profiles
          • Perform regular audits to ensure all people movements (new hires, transfers, promotions, terminations) are correctly reflected in the system
          • Cross-check open positions in Workday against workforce planning data and flag discrepancies to the Regional HRBP
          • Coordinate with HR teams globally to resolve data inconsistencies
          • Prepare HR reports on demand: headcount, open positions, engagement metrics, and data sanity checks
          • Support the Regional HRBP with data preparation for leadership presentations and business reviews
          • Maintain data hygiene across HR tracking tools (spreadsheets, Workday exports, dashboards)

What We Are Looking For

Background

  • A degree in Human Resources (Human Resource Management), Labor Relations, Organizational Psychology, or a related field

    • Experience

    • 1 to 3 years of HR experience in dynamic, fast-moving environments (for example HR operations, HR generalist, or HRIS support)
    • Experience with HRIS platforms (Workday experience is a strong plus, not a requirement)
    • Exposure to multi-country HR operations is valued but not mandatory

      • Skills

      • Advanced English, written and spoken; most team communication is in English
      • Google Workspace (Google Sheets, Docs, Slides): advanced level required
      • AI tools literacy (familiarity with Claude or similar tools is a plus)
      • Analytical mindset: comfortable working with data, spotting inconsistencies, and building clean reports

What Will Set You Apart

  • High tolerance for ambiguity: you don’t need everything to be defined to take action
  • Dynamism: you shift context quickly and don’t lose quality when the pace picks up
  • Comfort with uncertainty: you see change as the norm, not the exception
  • Proactive communication: you flag issues before they become problems
  • Discretion: you handle sensitive information with care and sound judgment

Why Join Aleph

  • Real impact across APAC: Your accuracy in Workday and your follow-through keep hiring, onboarding, and people movements running smoothly across multiple markets, and your insights help the Regional HRBP and business leaders decide what to do next.
  • A clear path into HR business partnering: Learn the HRBP craft from the inside (employee relations, workforce planning data, leadership business reviews) with day-to-day exposure to the Director, HR Business Partners.
  • Collaborative, supportive team culture: Work alongside Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, and People Service Delivery colleagues in an English-speaking team that values proactive communication, discretion, and flagging issues early.
  • Modern tools and AI-forward work: Build hands-on experience with Workday, Google Workspace, Jira, and AI tools, and help deliver AI and Automation initiatives as part of the APAC Engagement Plan.
Why Join Us?
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

title: Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps
description:

          • Focus on technical expertise, teaching, scripting, and recording while the production team manages video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

            • Requirements:

            • Hands-on DevOps and infrastructure experience

              • Strong practical knowledge of Linux, containers, Kubernetes, at least one major cloud platform, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (IaC).

              • Experience building, operating, and maintaining infrastructure rather than relying solely on theoretical knowledge.

              • The ability to demonstrate real engineering workflows and translate practical experience into effective learning materials.

              • Current experience with AI technologies

                      • Community credentials or roles such as CNCF Ambassador, AWS Community Builder, or Microsoft MVP.

                      • Relevant Kubernetes certifications, including CKA, CKAD, or CKS, or recognition such as Kubestronaut.

title: Software Integration Engineer
description:
Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN) is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non-human pilot to deliver full-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown. The Merlin Pilot autonomy system powers a growing range of aircraft and mission profiles and has been proven through hundreds of autonomous flights from Merlin's global flight test facilities, including Kerikeri, New Zealand; Smithfield, Rhode Island; and soon, Bedford, Massachusetts. Headquartered in Boston, Merlin is expanding its organization to accelerate the development and deployment of its autonomy platform, helping customers solve some of aviation's most pressing challenges, from pilot shortages to improving flight safety. Backed by some of the world's leading investors prior to its public listing, Merlin continues to advance the certification and commercialization of autonomous flight across commercial and defense aviation.

About You:

You are a hands-on software engineer who enjoys connecting software, simulation models, and physical hardware. You take ownership of well-defined engineering efforts, troubleshoot methodically, and collaborate with teammates to deliver reliable solutions. You are comfortable writing code, working in Linux, and testing directly with laboratory equipment.

As part of Merlin’s Virtual Test Environments (VTE) team, you will help develop and maintain hardware-in-the-loop test environments and the software that captures, displays, and replays engineering data. Working alongside our Staff Software Integration Engineer, you will help engineers exercise aircraft systems and resolve integration issues before flight.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain C++ and Python software connecting aircraft avionics, simulation models, test hardware, and engineering tools.

  • Implement software components and hardware interfaces within the architecture established by the Staff Software Integration Engineer, contributing to design decisions and code reviews.

  • Integrate UEI PowerDNA equipment through vendor SDKs, low-level I/O APIs, and hardware abstraction layers.

  • Configure and validate ARINC 429, CAN, serial, analog, and discrete interfaces using aircraft interface control documents, including signal mapping, message encoding, update rates, and error handling.

  • Support real-time execution of aircraft simulation models, including periodic processing, I/O exchange, watchdogs, and performance diagnostics.

  • Develop and maintain telemetry interfaces and data-processing components that collect, validate, record, and distribute data over UDP, TCP, and messaging systems.

  • Contribute to asynchronous Rust services for telemetry ingestion, timestamp alignment, flight-test displays, and session recording, with technical guidance from senior engineers.

  • Build operator displays and diagnostic tools using technologies such as GL Studio, React, HTML5, SQL, and web APIs.

  • Build, deploy, and troubleshoot software on Linux hosts and embedded targets using established cross-compilation, packaging, systemd, and Docker workflows.

  • Write unit tests, Python-based smoke tests, and hardware integration tests; help reproduce defects and add regression coverage.

  • Collaborate with avionics, aircraft software, flight dynamics, and lab engineers to diagnose issues across software, networks, and connected hardware.

  • Maintain code and configuration changes in Git, track work in Jira, and document interfaces, deployment steps, and troubleshooting procedures.

Qualifications:

  • Proficiency developing and debugging modern C++ and Python software.

  • Strong working familiarity with Linux host systems, including command-line tools, software builds, dependencies, services, permissions, networking, and diagnostics.

  • Experience integrating software with physical hardware, external systems, or vendor libraries and APIs.

  • Understanding of resource management, multithreading, synchronization, and error handling in C++.

  • Familiarity with UDP/TCP networking and binary data formats, including byte order, message framing, and input validation.

  • Familiarity with timing-sensitive software concepts such as periodic execution, buffering, latency, and watchdogs.

  • Ability to interpret technical documentation and interface definitions and translate them into working software and tests.

  • Experience using Git for collaborative development, automated testing, and Jira or comparable issue tracking.

  • Familiarity with Docker-based application deployment.

  • Willingness to learn Rust, embedded Linux deployment, and avionics interfaces with support from experienced engineers.

  • Ability to work independently on assigned components, communicate progress and blockers, and seek guidance when needed.

  • Ability to work regularly onsite in our Boston lab to integrate and troubleshoot physical equipment.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with UEI PowerDNA/PDNA SDKs or comparable data acquisition and avionics interface platforms.

  • Familiarity with ARINC 429, CAN, and RS-232/RS-422 serial interfaces.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, ARM targets, cross-compilation, CMake, Yocto SDKs, Debian packaging, or systemd services.

  • Experience with Rust, particularly asynchronous programming using Tokio, serde, or axum.

  • Experience integrating or troubleshooting low-level I/O APIs, device drivers, or hardware abstraction layers.

  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing, aircraft simulation, or integrating generated simulation models into C++ applications.

  • Familiarity with telemetry systems, timestamp synchronization, IRIG time, or flight-test displays such as IADS.

  • Experience with GL Studio, React and JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, SQL, or REST APIs.

  • Experience with GoogleTest, pytest, parser fuzzing, or continuous integration using GitHub Actions.

  • Familiarity with ZeroMQ, session recording, S3 storage, or simulation replay workflows.

  • Aviation experience through professional work, flight simulation, or a pilot’s license.

This position is based on-site at Merlin HQ in Boston, MA.
Once you’re here, you’ll enjoy a variety of on-site perks designed to make your workday enjoyable and convenient. These include catered lunches featuring a rotating menu of delicious options, an assortment of snacks to keep you fueled throughout the day, and a selection of beverages, including coffee, tea, and other drinks, to keep you refreshed.
Our goal is to create an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally.
Merlin Labs offers an innovative, entrepreneurial, and team-focused startup environment. We also offer a top-notch benefits package (health, dental, life, flexible paid time off, and 401k with match) and work/life integration. title: Head of Testing and Automation
description:
Company Overview:

Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.

We are growing our team and seeking out world-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future.

Role:

Function Health is looking for a hands-on engineering leader to build the testing and automation systems that help us release software with confidence. You will set technical direction and build practical systems that verify product behavior, identify regressions, and use AI to reduce repetitive testing work. You will combine conventional test infrastructure with AI-assisted approaches where they improve reliability and efficiency, supported by independently verifiable evidence and clear human oversight.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define the testing and automation roadmap with Engineering and Product, starting with priority workflows and release risks.
  • Build reusable test infrastructure, repeatable environments, test data, and CI/CD integration across the agreed product surfaces.
  • Develop AI-assisted test creation, exploration, maintenance, and failure investigation; evaluate computer-use agents where they fit.
  • Establish meaningful assertions, reproducible failure evidence, and release criteria that independently check agent output.
  • Measure escaped defects, flaky tests, verification time, false alarms, and maintenance effort; help teams adopt the system through implementation, documentation, and coaching.

Qualifications/Skills:

  • Strong software engineering and hands-on ownership of automation, quality infrastructure, developer tooling, or comparable systems.
  • Experience making verification reliable in a delivery pipeline and debugging failures across code, data, and infrastructure.
  • Practical experience building with LLMs or agents and evaluating their outputs.
  • Technical leadership across teams, with clear judgment about quality, delivery, and adoption tradeoffs.
  • Experience with browser or computer-use agents, Playwright or similar automation, AI evaluation, and sensitive-data products.

title: Senior Research Scientist, AI & Workforce Intelligence
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Research Scientist, AI & Workforce Intelligence based in the United States.

We are seeking a Senior Research Scientist who combines deep knowledge of industrial-organizational (I-O) psychology with hands-on machine learning engineering expertise to transform how organizations understand jobs, talent, and workforce potential. In this fully remote role, you will lead the evolution of an AI-powered job analysis platform that processes labor market data to generate evidence-based insights across thousands of occupations. You will develop and refine advanced NLP and machine learning models while ensuring their outputs remain accurate, explainable, fair, and scientifically defensible. Working closely with product managers, engineers, and assessment scientists, you will shape how AI supports employee selection, professional development, coaching, and organizational decision-making. This position offers meaningful technical ownership, opportunities to influence AI strategy, and the chance to solve complex problems at the intersection of people science and production-grade technology. You will help build responsible AI solutions that improve how individuals and organizations understand work, performance, and potential.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the continued development, architecture, and expansion of an AI-powered job analysis engine that transforms labor market data into structured, evidence-based occupational insights.

  • Build, evaluate, and refine machine learning models that infer job content, cognitive complexity, occupational interests, and related attributes from unstructured text and diverse data sources.

  • Apply modern NLP techniques, including embeddings, semantic search, clustering, text classification, transformer architectures, and model tuning, to improve job analysis coverage and accuracy.

  • Integrate and extend established occupational frameworks, such as O*NET and ESCO, while developing approaches that capture emerging roles and evolving workforce requirements beyond existing taxonomies.

  • Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, and I-O psychologists to translate scientific requirements into scalable AI capabilities across assessment interpretation, manager and team reporting, coaching content, and employee development.

  • Advise cross-functional teams on appropriate AI and machine learning approaches, clarifying technical limitations, evaluation standards, uncertainty, and the role of human expertise.

  • Establish and apply rigorous evaluation methods for generative AI outputs, including rubric-based assessments, groundedness checks, error analysis, regression testing, and quality assurance for generated job descriptions and work-context summaries.

  • Ensure AI-supported employment and development tools meet relevant scientific, professional, ethical, and legal standards.

  • Incorporate responsible AI practices, including fairness evaluation, adverse impact analysis, bias mitigation, explainability, auditability, and appropriate human review.

  • Apply I-O psychology principles to norm group construction, assessment interpretation, job-relatedness evaluation, criterion relationships, and evidence-based measurement.

  • Balance scientific rigor with practical product delivery, making informed trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, automation, maintainability, and operational constraints.

  • Contribute to the development of new assessments that use emerging technologies to support richer, more secure, and effective evaluation of individuals.

  • Establish collaborative relationships across scientific and product teams, develop technical roadmaps, and deliver measurable improvements to model performance and platform capabilities.

    • Requirements:

    • Graduate degree in Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Organizational Psychology, Organizational Development, or a closely related field. A strong quantitative focus is preferred, and a doctoral degree is an advantage.

    • At least three years of applied industry experience, with five or more years preferred.

    • Demonstrated machine learning engineering experience delivering production-grade systems, rather than experience limited to academic research or coursework.

    • Practical experience applying modern NLP and machine learning techniques to behavioral, assessment-related, occupational, or labor market data.

    • Strong technical skills in embeddings, semantic search, clustering, text classification, transformer architectures, model tuning, and model evaluation.

    • Experience modeling occupational data, including job titles, tasks, skills, competencies, credentials, job families, seniority levels, title normalization, job similarity, and role differentiation.

    • Familiarity with occupational taxonomies such as O*NET and ESCO, vocational interests, cognitive ability frameworks, and job analysis methodologies is highly desirable.

    • Working knowledge of I-O psychology and assessment science, including job-relatedness, criterion relationships, adverse impact, norm groups, assessment profiles, and score interpretation.

    • Demonstrated understanding of responsible AI in employment contexts, including algorithmic fairness, explainability, auditability, bias mitigation, and legal and ethical considerations.

    • Experience evaluating generative AI systems through structured rubrics, groundedness checks, error analysis, regression testing, or similar approaches.

    • A track record of delivering solutions that are both technically robust and professionally or legally defensible.

    • Strong product judgment and the ability to balance scientific validity, model performance, user needs, uncertainty, expert review, and real-world implementation constraints.

    • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions, learn unfamiliar domain constraints, and develop durable solutions.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain complex scientific and technical concepts to multidisciplinary audiences.

    • A pragmatic, adaptable mindset and the ability to take ownership in a small-team environment where creativity, independent thinking, and hands-on execution are essential.

    • Genuine interest in understanding how people work, what drives performance, and how evidence-based technology can improve employee selection and development.

    • Must be based in the United States and comfortable working remotely.

      • Benefits:

      • Annual base salary: $130,000–$150,000, depending on experience and expertise.

      • Fully remote work: Work from anywhere in the United States.

      • Four-day workweek: Full-time schedule of 32 hours across four days.

      • Paid time off: Generous PTO and paid holidays.

      • Year-end company shutdown: Paid time off from December 24 through January 1.

      • Healthcare coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

      • Retirement benefits: 401(k) plan with company matching.

      • Paid parental leave: 10 weeks of paid leave for new parents.

      • Wellness support: Dedicated wellness benefit to support personal well-being.

      • Meaningful scientific impact: Help advance evidence-based employment assessments and responsible AI applications that influence workforce decisions.

      • Technical and scientific ownership: Shape the direction of applied AI systems while collaborating with experts across machine learning, product development, and I-O psychology.

      • Innovation-focused environment: Work on complex, real-world challenges at the intersection of workforce intelligence, assessment science, and emerging AI technologies.

title: Spray Booth Operator
description:
Spraying Technician

Schwieters Companies is a family-owned and oriented company specializing in millwork, doors, cabinets, and hardware. Our team offers a turnkey solution for these interior finishes including procurement, pre-fabrication, delivery, and installation. With a commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction, we have built and maintained strong customer relationships for over 40 years.

Here at Schwieters, communication is at the heart of our business model which is why we aim to make sure that every employee is heard and feels valued. Relationship building is paramount in what we do every day for both our team and our customers.

Schwieters Companies is hiring a detail-oriented Spraying Technician to join our production team. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing materials, configuring spray guns, and ensuring a high-quality finish on all products.

PAY

Schwieters Companies was founded in 1982 by Joel Schwieters, who trimmed 40 homes during his first year in business. title: Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps
description:

As a Senior Technical Trainer, you will combine hands-on DevOps expertise with a passion for teaching to develop practical, engaging courses on AI-powered engineering workflows. You will help engineers understand how to apply AI agents, coding assistants, and modern AI tools to real-world infrastructure and automation challenges. Working alongside a curriculum team and experienced technical educators, you will design lessons, develop hands-on lab specifications, and record clear, compelling instructional videos. This remote freelance opportunity begins with a paid course project, typically lasting around three months, with the potential for ongoing projects or a full-time position. You will have the flexibility to work alongside existing commitments while contributing your technical knowledge to a global engineering community. The ideal candidate is a practising DevOps engineer who can simplify complex concepts, communicate confidently on camera, and create learning experiences that make advanced technologies accessible.

Accountabilities

  • Design and develop technical courses

    • Develop content that demonstrates how engineers use AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation in real infrastructure environments.

    • Ensure lessons are technically accurate, relevant, practical, and aligned with the needs of working engineers.

    • Create engaging instructional content

      • Write concise, story-driven video scripts designed to explain technical concepts clearly, with individual lessons typically lasting around six minutes.

      • Use AI tools where helpful during drafting while ensuring the final scripts reflect your own voice, expertise, and teaching style.

      • Narrate and present lessons confidently in English, making complex technical topics approachable for learners at different experience levels.

              • Strong practical knowledge of Linux, containers, Kubernetes, at least one major cloud platform, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (IaC).

              • Experience building, operating, and maintaining infrastructure rather than relying solely on theoretical knowledge.

              • The ability to demonstrate real engineering workflows and translate practical experience into effective learning materials.

                • Genuine curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and a commitment to staying current with new tools and techniques.

                • Teaching and communication skills

                  • A demonstrated passion for teaching, supported by experience creating courses, publishing tutorials, delivering talks or workshops, mentoring colleagues, or sharing technical knowledge with a community.

                  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, naturally, and confidently on camera.

                  • Strong storytelling skills and the ability to break down complex technical concepts into simple, structured explanations.

                  • Empathy for learners, particularly beginners, and an understanding of how to make technical material engaging and accessible.

                  • Collaboration and adaptability

                      • Experience speaking at conferences or meetups, maintaining a technical YouTube channel or blog, or contributing to technical communities.

                      • Community credentials or roles such as CNCF Ambassador, AWS Community Builder, or Microsoft MVP.

                      • Relevant Kubernetes certifications, including CKA, CKAD, or CKS, or recognition such as Kubestronaut.

                      • Cloud certifications from providers such as AWS or Microsoft Azure.

                        • Benefits:

title: Foreperson/Bucket Operator: Griffin, GA

  • Direct crew members and manage equipment each day
  • Assign specific tasks to crew members and supervise performance
  • Plan and execute the assigned work and tasks in a safe and professional manner
  • Organize job assignments so that work is completed as efficiently as possible

title: Supervisor - Technical Production
description:
Igloo Products Corp. is an iconic, fast-growing American brand known for its exceptional and durable coolers that meet everyday needs. For more than 75 years, Igloo has been a leader in the housewares industry and has since evolved into a high-growth lifestyle brand, inspiring outdoor experiences centered around fun, family, and friends.

Founded in as a metalworking shop bringing fresh cold water to Texas workers in the field to inventing the Playmate to becoming America’s most recognizable brand of ice chests, the Igloo story spans more than 75 years of delivering coolness to the world. Today, Igloo has 90% + brand awareness and is #1 in market share in the US, is a pioneer in sustainability for our category with the launch of biodegradable coolers and coolers made with from post-consumer recycled resin and other sustainable materials and has a growing DTC business allowing us to build direct relationships with our consumers. In 2021, Igloo was acquired by Dometic Brands and now there is the opportunity to Globally grow both brands together.

We are on a journey of continuous growth – now looking for our next star – a passionate Supervisor - Technical Production.

This position is responsible for supervising and coordinating the technical production teams and safety initiatives in a continuous fast paced, quality conscious, high-speed manufacturing operation; performing as a key member of a management team committed to World-Class Performance and department goals.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Ensure all employees, both new and current, feel welcomed and are treated with respect as well as providing them with clear instructions/training along with the correct tools and PPE required.
  • Ensure safe working practices are followed and all accidents, hazards, near misses, and property damage are reported in the required time. Ensure that Safety and Quality requirements are in compliance.
  • Supervisor is responsible of auditing at the beginning of the shift as well as at least 3 times during the day the following:
    • Lock Out/ Tag Out
    • Change Over Log Sheets
    • Material Usage Forms
  • Supervisor is responsible to manage the scheduling for change overs in the molding departments.
  • Supervisor is responsible to manage material usages in the molding departments.
  • Conduct the Safety Monthly training to all direct reports
  • Develop and execute a Cross-Training Program for a positions rotation plan.
  • The Supervisor is responsible to keep payroll system updated at all times and timecards must be approved by the end of the last day of their shift.
  • The Supervisor is required to navigate in both Oracle and OBIEE systems, to verify inventories and/or scheduling requirements.
  • Perform duties to support the Manager as needed.
  • Utilize properly the assigned manpower, material, equipment and space to perform in a profitable and efficient manner by coordinating all activities within the scope of approved procedures and sets priorities necessary to accomplish pre-determined goals.
  • Identifies and resolves manufacturing problems in order to deliver production efficiency, attainment and scrap control results.
  • Monitors equipment, methods of operation and coordinates equipment repairs in order to reduce spoilage (scrap) and ensure established quantity and quality of output is met.
  • Help implement and maintain 5S practices in all areas of the plant.
  • Ensure safe working practices are followed and all accidents, hazards, near misses and property damage are reported in the required time.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA and company safety and hygiene standards.
  • Promote Safety, Quality, and Environmental Awareness by following the requirements in the area of responsibility.
  • Ensure production activities are carried out within budgeted labor hours.
  • Ensure all labor and machine timesheets are completed and submitted accurately as required. Also, must maintain accurate personnel data: attendance, counseling,
  • performance and other, to provide accurate payroll data to proper personnel.
  • The Supervisor will ensure the transfer of knowledge and/or issues between shifts, to the relieving Supervisor.
  • All Igloo policies and procedures are enforced fairly and equally.
  • Assembly Supervisor must be willing to be cross trained to fill in for Molding Supervisor position as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned

Minimum Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalency.
  • Experience: Minimum of three (3) years of Production experience in assembly repetitive manufacturing and supervision of technical employees.
  • Supervisory Experience: Minimum of three (3) years supervisory experience over technical employees.
  • Strong technical skills in relation to molding, mold change, and material blending systems.
  • Ability to lead others including people from diverse backgrounds.
  • English language skills: Able to read, write, speak and comprehend English.
  • Math skills: Strong ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide.
  • Physical Demands: Able to lift a maximum of 50 lbs. multiple times a day during a 12 hr. shift; Bend and stand in difficult positions up to 12 hours; Able to manipulate tools with both hands and stand for long hours; Able to walk quickly and climb stairs; Walk approximate distance between 3-4 miles per day.
  • Work environment: Warehouse environment hot and humid in summer months, cold in winter months. High noise requiring use of hearing protection.
  • Proficient in MS Office suite.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Injection Mold, Vacuum Form or Blow Mold Process, mold change, and material setup experience.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish).
  • College degree preferred.
  • Experience and familiarity SMED, Process Lockdown Sheets, and Material Blending Ratios.
  • Experience in Lean Manufacturing.

Physical Demands & Conditions
(Applicable to Igloo Operators, Technicians, Leaders, and Other Roles in Manufacturing)

Standing & Walking
Roles may involve extended periods (up to 12 hours) of standing and walking, including moving at a brisk pace and occasional stair climbing.

Postural Requirements
Frequent bending, stooping, kneeling, and working in low or awkward positions during production or maintenance tasks.

Lifting & Material Handling

  • Operator-level roles may involve lifting up to 25 lb repeatedly throughout the shift.
  • Technician-level roles may involve lifting up to 50 lb multiple times per day, including overhead lifts.
  • Where possible, mechanical aids (e.g., hoists, forklifts) are used.

Fine Motor Skills & Tool Use
Use of both hands is required to operate tools, perform adjustments, and handle assembly materials with precision.

Visual Requirements
Sufficient visual acuity (e.g., 20/40 with or without correction) is necessary for tasks involving inspection and safe equipment operation.

Environmental Conditions

  • Work is performed in a production setting where seasonal temperatures may range from 100–120°F (with humidity) in summer to cooler conditions in winter.
  • High noise levels are common; hearing protection is provided and required.
  • Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as ear protection, safety glasses, steel-toed shoes, gloves, and protective clothing may be required depending on the task.

Additional Job Considerations
These roles can be physically demanding, involving repetitive motions and long hours. Technicians may be required to handle heavy molds and materials; use of material handling equipment is provided and encouraged.

And of course – our Core Values

To thrive and succeed in this role, you understand the importance of our core values – Together We build our future, We play to win, We embrace change and We walk the talk; these values reflect the heart and soul of Dometic and they define what it takes to work here and how we do things.

Are you our next star? Then we would love to see your application.

Dometic is passionate about building together an inclusive and equitable working environment, that respects individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that diversity enables us to thrive across our differences. Be yourself and join us!

Igloo offers equal opportunities for everyone. Equal opportunities mean that all employees shall be treated according to their abilities and qualifications in every employment decision, including but not limited to hiring, advancement, compensation benefits, training, lay-offs and termination. title: Staff Software Engineer, Constraint Generation

title: Y-Cap Program Advisor (PT)
description:
The YMCA Y-CAP Program Advisor is an early intervention/prevention program for students that would benefit from social emotional learning wraparound services. The Y-CAP Program Advisor will assist the Director of Prevention Programs with daily program operations.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

1. To be a role model for Y-CAP youth utilizing the YMCA ideal of “Spirit, Mind and Body,” along with reflecting the character development values of caring, honesty, respect and responsibility.

2. To coordinate and interact in activities with Y-CAP enrolled youth and their families using prosocial and positive redirection techniques.

3. To monitor and supervise Y-CAP youth during programming time.

4. To work with other Y-CAP staff in setting up meetings and program schedules during program hours of 8am-9:30am and 2pm – 6pm Monday thru Friday.

5. To assist with the implementation of Y-CAP programs, delivery of value sessions and other community programming.

6. To assist the Director of Prevention Programs with volunteer recruitment and management.

7. Employee will accurately report work time via approved YMCA Clocking method: personal electronic device, YMCA Site Phone, YMCA iPad or time sheet.

8. To assist with record collection and individual case management.

9. To maintain a high level of commitment to the youth and families that has been entrusted to Y-CAP.

10. Work in partnership with Drive The Dream (DTD) United Way referral services for children and families.

11. Access to reliable transportation is required for visits to YMCA Centers, schools and communities programming sites.


QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

1. The Y-CAP Program Advisor should have a minimum of high school diploma.

2. Previous YMCA experience, experience working with at-risk youth, and/or experience working with youth and teens is preferred.

3. Minimum age requirement of 18. Must be able to work alone with youth. (15-25 hrs. per week)

4. Must be available to work afternoons and evenings. (2pm-5pm)

5. Must have reliable transportation as programming takes place at various schools Monday-Friday.


YMCA COMPETENCIES (Team Leader):

Mission Advancement: Models and teaches the Y’s values. Ensures a high level of service with a commitment to changing lives. Provides volunteers with orientation, training, development, and recognition. Cultivates relationships to support fund-raising.


Collaboration: Champions inclusion activities, strategies, and initiatives. Build relationships to create small communities. Empathetically listens and communicates for understanding when negotiating and dealing with conflict. Effectively tailors communications to the appropriate audience. Provides staff with feedback, coaching, guidance and support.


Operational Effectiveness: Provides others with frameworks for making decisions. Conducts prototypes to support the launching of programs and activities. Develops plans and manages best practices through engagement of the team. Effectively creates and manages budgets. Holds staff accountable for high-quality results using a formal process to measure progress.


Personal Growth: Shares new insights. Facilitates change; models adaptability and an awareness of the impact of change. Utilizes non-threatening methods to address sensitive issues and inappropriate behavior or performance. Has the functional and technical knowledge and skills required to perform well; uses best practices and demonstrates up-to date knowledge and skills in technology


WORK SCHEDULE:

This part-time position will average 20 - 25 hours per week, Monday through Friday. Must be available to work the afternoon shift from 2 pm - 5 pm.


WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Frequent climbing, sitting, standing, pushing, walking, kneeling, and stooping. ? Ability to respond quickly and swiftly to emergency situations.
  • Occasionally lift up 35 pounds using proper technique
  • Ability to travel to various site locations in the local area on a daily basis.
  • Sufficient strength, agility and mobility to perform essential functions of position and to safely supervise youth activities.

  • Encouraging philanthropy by sharing personal YMCA experiences and inviting participation in fundraising efforts.
  • Celebrating members' achievements in health and well-being goals.
  • Promoting meaningful youth programs and services to nurture the potential of all youth.

All responsibilities are essential to the position

Inclusion
Collaboration

Developing Others and Self
Emotional Maturity
Functional Expertise

Within 90 days of completing MODS, Preventing Sexual Abuse Between Youth Children, Youth Affirmations: Distinguishing Between Praise and Encouragement, Foundations of Listen First, and Engaging with Families trainings required.

May also be enrolled in and obtain their high school diploma within the school year they were employed. College degree in a child-related field is preferred.

Work Experience: Experience working with children preferred.

Certificates/Licenses: Must have or be enrolled in state mandated trainings within 30 days of employment. Trainings must be complete within 12 months of employment. CPR/AED, First Aid, Lifeguard and Listen First certification preferred.

Physical: Must be 16 years of age or older. Must be able to stand, remain outdoors and maintain continual physical endurance for extended periods of time. Must be able to lift and carry 50 pounds, watch, listen and facilitate group activities.

Mental: Must be mentally alert and be able to process and follow directions.

Skills: Must be able to supervise and instruct large groups of children. Knowledge of sports and children's programming preferred.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Hybrid
description:
Job Description

We are building modern financial infrastructure for the next generation of businesses. We create secure, scalable, and developer-first software that powers complex financial workflows through intuitive products, robust APIs, and cloud-native architecture.

Our platform is built with TypeScript, React, and AWS serverless technologies, enabling businesses to manage financial operations through reliable software, APIs, and intelligent automation. We embrace modern engineering practices, AI-assisted development, and a strong culture of ownership to build products customers can trust.

If you’re excited about solving complex engineering challenges and building production systems that matter, we’d love to hear from you.

Attributes We Value

We look for engineers who combine technical excellence with ownership and product thinking. You enjoy solving difficult problems, care deeply about software quality, and take responsibility for delivering secure, reliable systems from design through production.

You embrace AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier, while applying sound judgment around architecture, security, testing, and long-term maintainability.

About the Team

Our Engineering team builds a modern serverless fintech platform powering accounts, transactions, payments, integrations, and developer-facing products. We build not only exceptional web experiences, but also APIs, SDKs, and AI-ready interfaces that enable developers, customers, and intelligent agents to interact with our platform safely and efficiently.

What You’ll Do

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help build and scale our cloud-native fintech platform. You’ll work across React, TypeScript, AWS serverless infrastructure, and developer-facing APIs, taking ownership of features from architecture through production.

Working closely with Product and Engineering, you’ll help transform early-stage ideas into secure, scalable, and production-ready systems while contributing to engineering best practices, automation, testing, and AI-assisted development.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain production-grade full-stack applications using TypeScript, React, and Node.js. Build serverless backend services with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS, and AWS CDK. Develop secure customer-facing APIs, SDKs, and developer-facing interfaces. Build reliable event-driven systems, webhook handlers, and transaction workflows with strong operational resilience. Integrate third-party financial services, payment providers, and external APIs. Implement secure authentication, authorization, RBAC, and multi-tenant application architecture. Write high-quality automated tests and contribute to CI/CD, observability, and monitoring. Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering velocity while maintaining production-quality code. Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical planning, and continuous platform improvements.

Who You Are

We’re looking for candidates who meet the minimum qualifications below. Preferred qualifications are a plus.

Qualifications

7+ years of professional software engineering experience building production full-stack applications. Strong expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and modern React development. Experience building production frontend applications, including API integrations, state management, routing, and responsive UI. Proven experience with AWS serverless technologies, including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS, and AWS CDK. Experience building APIs, background workers, webhooks, and event-driven systems. Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, API security, and multi-tenant applications. Experience designing reliable transaction workflows with robust testing and error handling. Experience integrating third-party APIs, ideally within fintech, payments, banking, or other high-reliability environments. Comfortable using AI-assisted engineering tools and applying strong technical judgement to AI-generated code. Preferred Qualifications Experience in fintech, payments, banking, treasury, or financial infrastructure. Familiarity with Hono, OpenAPI, React Query, React Router, Playwright, or Turborepo. Experience designing SDKs, developer platforms, customer-facing APIs, or AI-agent interfaces. Experience with DynamoDB data modeling and production serverless operations. Experience building internal developer tooling, automation, or AI-powered engineering workflows.

Why Join Us

Build technology that powers real-world financial operations. Work with a modern TypeScript stack, AWS serverless infrastructure, and AI-native engineering workflows. Own meaningful technical decisions and make a direct impact on product direction. Join a collaborative team focused on engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.

Equal Opportunity

Canvas Digital is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We celebrate diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Senior Technical Trainer — Machine Learning

In this remote freelance role, you will help learners progress from core machine learning concepts to training and evaluating their own models through practical, lab-based learning. You will collaborate with curriculum specialists and production teams to develop clear lessons, hands-on exercises, and real-world demonstrations.     • Requirements:

    • Excellent English proficiency: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to write natural scripts, deliver clear narration, and communicate confidently on camera.

    • A genuine passion for teaching: Evidence of enjoying knowledge-sharing through online courses, tutorials, technical talks, workshops, mentoring, or other educational activities.

    • Current technical knowledge: An active interest in machine learning developments and a commitment to continuously learning and improving.

    • Presentation confidence: Comfort presenting technical material on camera in a clear, engaging, and accessible way.

    • Openness to feedback: Willingness to follow an established teaching methodology, collaborate with editors, and improve course content through structured feedback.

      • Experience publishing courses on platforms such as Udemy, Pluralsight, or Coursera, or creating educational content on YouTube.

      • Practical knowledge of fine-tuning, MLOps, or deploying machine learning models in production.

      • Cloud machine learning certifications related to AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or Databricks.

        • Benefits:

        • Flexible working arrangements: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with no fixed weekly-hour requirement and a delivery schedule agreed in advance.

        • Defined project scope: The initial course project typically takes around three months, providing a clear timeframe for planning and delivery.

        • Payment upon completion: Receive the agreed course fee when the completed course is delivered.

        • Long-term career potential: Successful collaboration may lead to additional course projects or a full-time opportunity as part of a growing trainer network.

        • Collaborative remote environment: Work closely with curriculum and production specialists through regular team syncs and Slack communication.

title: MLOps Engineer
description:
Valarian Technologies is a dual-use technology company building critical tools to safeguard the future in an era of evolving global security challenges. We're rethinking security beyond traditional military domains, addressing asymmetric threats that impact our technological advantage, economic strength, and democratic institutions.

We build Acra – the platform foundation for everything we do as a dual-use technology company. The platform’s name, rooted in the Greek word for citadel (or, fortress), reflects the design and purpose of our infrastructure-agnostic secure enclaves: protecting critical data. Some of the government and commercial workflows include: increased operational resiliency for mission-critical systems and functions; enabling organisations to more quickly and widely adopt emerging technologies while ensuring the integrity of their intellectual property; information flow during disaster response scenarios, and zero-trust / least-privilege environments for M&A, attorney-client privileged communications, etc. And we’ve only scratched the surface.

At our core, we're driven by a shared mission and a belief in making a tangible impact on our world. Whether you join our London HQ or the wider global organisation, you’ll be a part of collaborative, high-performing teams, creating cutting-edge software, platforms, and infrastructure.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior MLOps / LLMOps Engineer to lead the deployment, monitoring, orchestration, and operational reliability of our production LLM applications and agentic AI platform. In this role, you will bridge the gap between AI development and production infrastructure, ensuring multi-step agentic workflows, data pipelines, and retrieval-augmented systems run reliably, securely, and at scale within a large-scale Kubernetes environment. 

What you’ll do:

  • Design, deploy, and manage LLM services, agentic applications, and supporting AI workloads inside high-throughput Kubernetes clusters.

  • Automate containerized deployments, scalable inference endpoints, and blue/green or canary rollout strategies for LLM/Agent releases via modern CI/CD pipelines.

  • Support and maintain the production operation of agentic AI workflows, including multi-step tool execution, state management, and multi-agent coordination.

  • Rapidly triage and resolve issues across AI application logic, orchestration frameworks, external API integrations, and underlying cloud infrastructure.

  • Build end-to-end monitoring and evaluation (Eval) frameworks to measure and maintain AI output accuracy, drift, latency, cost, and hallucination metrics.

  • Implement trace-level observability for agent execution paths (tracking prompts, completions, tool calls, and agent steps).

  • Monitor and optimize real-time and batch data pipelines powering AI workloads, including feature stores, vector indexing, and embedding updates.

  • Manage resource allocation (GPU/CPU utilization), memory footprint, autoscaling strategies, and cloud infrastructure expenditure to optimize time-to-first-token (TTFT) and throughput.

What we are looking for:

  • 3+ years of experience in MLOps, LLMOps, Platform Engineering, AI Infrastructure, or SRE with a focus on machine learning workloads.

  • Hands-on experience managing and deploying complex containerized applications on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS, or bare metal) at scale.

  • Strong proficiency in Python for backend automation, system debugging, custom tooling, and integration development.
