title: Senior Counsel, Technology & Strategic Partnerships
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Counsel, Technology & Strategic Partnerships based in the United States.

Join a forward-thinking, AI-driven cybersecurity environment where technology, innovation, and strategic business partnerships converge.
As Senior Counsel, Technology & Strategic Partnerships, you will lead complex technology transactions, negotiate strategic agreements, and provide legal guidance on high-impact commercial initiatives.
You will play a key role in structuring partnerships involving technology licensing, OEM arrangements, AI solutions, and service providers.
Working closely with senior legal leadership and cross-functional teams, you will help translate innovative business strategies into practical, scalable contractual frameworks.
This hands-on position offers the opportunity to own significant transactions from negotiation through execution while supporting mergers and acquisitions.
You will also contribute to building the processes, templates, and playbooks that establish a new strategic legal function.
If you combine strong technology law expertise with commercial judgment and a passion for emerging technologies, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a rapidly evolving industry.

Accountabilities

  • Lead strategic technology partnerships: Draft, review, and negotiate complex agreements covering OEM relationships, technology licensing, strategic alliances, and service-provider partnerships. Manage transactions end to end and collaborate with senior legal leadership on the most significant deals.
  • Manage intellectual property and technology rights: Negotiate IP ownership, licensing arrangements, data rights, and AI-related contractual provisions, ensuring appropriate protection of technology and business interests.
  • Support strategic product initiatives: Partner with Product and Go-to-Market teams to develop contractual frameworks for new products, services, and commercial offerings.
  • Contribute to mergers and acquisitions: Conduct commercial contract due diligence for acquisition targets, identify material risks in customer, partner, and intellectual property agreements, and support post-acquisition contract integration and assignment activities.
  • Provide strategic legal advice: Deliver practical, business-oriented guidance to deal teams, identify key legal and commercial risks, and recommend clear, actionable solutions.
  • Build scalable legal processes: Develop and refine contract templates, negotiation playbooks, and operational processes to improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability across strategic transactions.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration: Coordinate with Business Development, Technology Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Finance, Corporate Development, and legal colleagues across commercial contracts, intellectual property, AI, privacy, security, and procurement.

Requirements

  • Education and qualifications: Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited U.S. law school or equivalent qualification, with an active license to practice law in at least one U.S. state.
  • Professional experience: At least 8 years of legal experience focused on technology transactions, ideally combining experience at a leading law firm with in-house legal work at a technology company.
  • Technology transactions expertise: Strong knowledge of intellectual property licensing and complex technology agreements, including OEM, strategic alliance, technology licensing, and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) arrangements.
  • Negotiation skills: Demonstrated ability to independently lead and negotiate complex commercial agreements with sophisticated counterparties, managing transactions from initial discussions through execution.
  • AI fluency: Experience using AI tools to improve efficiency and quality in legal drafting, contract review, due diligence, and knowledge management.
  • Commercial judgment: Strong business acumen and the ability to understand broader commercial objectives, balance risk, and deliver practical legal solutions.
  • Communication and collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal concepts in clear, accessible business language and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Preferred industry experience: Background in cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS, with exposure to channel partnerships, OEM arrangements, and managed security service provider (MSSP) or other service-provider programs.
  • Preferred AI expertise: Experience negotiating terms for agentic or autonomous AI products, including provisions addressing training data, output rights, and liability allocation.
  • Additional advantage: Experience supporting M&A transactions, particularly commercial contract due diligence and post-acquisition contract integration.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation: Annual base salary ranging from $184,000 to $253,000 USD, depending on the candidate's location. Different salary ranges may apply in certain locations and will be communicated during the recruitment process.
  • Equity and financial rewards: Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
  • Time off and work-life balance: Flexible time off, paid company holidays, paid sick leave, gender-neutral parental leave, and grandparent leave.
  • Healthcare coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with life and disability insurance.
  • Retirement and financial planning: 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions, health and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), and voluntary hospital, accident, and critical illness coverage.
  • Additional protection and support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), prepaid legal services, nationwide pet insurance, cancer care support, and global business travel medical insurance.
  • Remote work support: Home office allowance and mobile phone reimbursement.
  • Wellness and lifestyle benefits: Access to a wellness coach, gym and wellness reimbursement, fertility coverage, and adoption and surrogacy reimbursement.
  • Remote flexibility: A U.S.-based remote working arrangement.

title: Senior / Staff Data Engineer | AI, Data Platforms & Data Products | Remote Canada
description:
Fully Remote, Canada
Competitive Salary + Equity
Canadian work authorisation required, no sponsorship available

“The best infrastructure isn’t inherited. It’s imagined, built, tested and made indispensable.”

This is not a role for someone who simply maintains an existing data platform.

We’re looking for someone who has built one.

We’re working with a fast-growing, venture-backed technology company looking for an exceptional Senior or Staff Data Engineer to become one of the foundational members of its data engineering function.

This is an opportunity for someone who loves the difficult, high-leverage end of data engineering: building platforms from scratch, making architectural decisions, creating AI-powered data products and owning systems all the way into production.

You won’t be joining a huge data organisation with layers of specialists around you.

You’ll work closely with an experienced technical data lead and take significant ownership across the data platform, helping determine what should be built, how it should be built and what will create the greatest impact for the business and its customers.

What makes this role different?

They don’t want a traditional warehouse or ETL engineer.

They want a builder.

Someone who has taken a problem from zero to one, then helped scale it from one to one hundred.

Perhaps you were an early data hire. Perhaps you helped establish a data engineering function. Perhaps you built a new platform inside a scale-up. Or perhaps you created customer-facing data products that became commercially important.

Ideally, you can point to systems and say:

“I designed that.”
“I built that from scratch.”
“Customers use that.”
“That generated revenue, saved serious money or fundamentally changed how the company operated.”

That type of ownership matters far more here than having a long list of technologies on your resume.

What you’ll be building

You’ll operate across the full data stack, from infrastructure and distributed systems through to AI-powered analytics and customer-facing data products.

You’ll be:

  • Designing and evolving modern cloud data infrastructure
  • Building scalable, reliable pipelines and event-driven systems
  • Working with technologies including AWS, Snowflake, Databricks and dbt
  • Developing AI-enabled and agentic data capabilities
  • Building semantic layers and self-service analytics experiences
  • Creating customer-facing and embedded data products
  • Tackling streaming, governance, metadata and knowledge-management challenges
  • Evaluating emerging technologies as the AI and data landscape evolves
  • Owning reliability, observability and production performanceParticipating in on-call and taking responsibility for what you build
  • Influencing architecture, engineering standards and the future direction of the data function

Who are we looking for?

You’ll likely have 5+ years of professional engineering experience, but years alone won’t determine whether you’re right.

What matters is what you’ve actually built.

We’d particularly like to speak with engineers who can demonstrate:

  • Genuine zero-to-one data infrastructure or platform experience
  • Strong distributed systems or platform engineering fundamentals
  • Experience building rather than simply inheriting data systems
  • Production ownership, monitoring, incident response and on-call experience
  • AWS or equivalent cloud infrastructure experience
  • Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Airflow, dbt or similar technologies
  • Streaming or event-driven architecture
  • AI/LLM experience within modern data platforms
  • Semantic layers, AI data assistants or natural-language analytics
  • Self-service analytics platforms
  • Customer-facing or embedded analytics
  • Data products tied to revenue, product adoption or customer experience
  • Measurable commercial or technical impact
  • Staff-level architecture and technical leadership
  • Experience mentoring engineers or helping grow a data engineering function
  • Startup or scale-up experience where ambiguity comes with the territory

A background spanning software engineering, data engineering, machine learning or quantitative disciplines could be particularly interesting.

What this role is NOT

This isn’t simply about:

  • Maintaining ETL pipelines.
  • Writing SQL all day.
  • Producing dashboards.
  • Building dbt models inside someone else’s architecture.
  • Administering an established warehouse.

And having “Principal” or “Staff” in your current title won’t necessarily make you right for the role.

The strongest candidates will show technical ownership, product thinking, AI curiosity, commercial awareness and measurable impact.

You should be comfortable independently identifying an important problem, designing the architecture, defending your technical decisions, building the solution and then owning it in production.

Why join?

Because very few Staff-level roles offer this level of influence.

Instead of becoming engineer number 40 in an established data organisation, you’ll help shape how an entire modern data capability develops.

The company is growing quickly. The engineering problems are complex. Data sits at the heart of the product. AI is becoming increasingly important to the platform.

And the work you build won’t disappear into the plumbing.

The goal is to create data infrastructure and products that engineers, teams and customers actually depend on.

You must already have unrestricted Canadian work authorisation. Visa sponsorship or visa transfer is not available.

title: Security Manager
description:
Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society.

Stand Together's Security team seeks an experienced Security Manager to support the safety and security of its Washington, DC-based facility, events, personnel, and operations. This role implements comprehensive security measures, conducts risk assessments, coordinates executive protection, and ensures the effective execution of facility and event security programs. The ideal candidate brings strong protective services experience, sound judgment, and the ability to proactively identify risks and implement practical security solutions.

As a key representative of the Security team, this individual will build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, and government officials. Success in this role requires a high level of professionalism, emotional intelligence, discretion, and a service-oriented approach to security.

This is a full-time, in-person position based at the Freedom Embassy in Washington, DC. Approximately 15% travel is expected in support of organizational initiatives and events.

How You Will Contribute

  • Develop and implement comprehensive security plans for facilities, personnel, executives, and on-site and off-site events to ensure safe and secure operations.
  • Conduct security risk assessments, identify potential vulnerabilities, and implement proactive mitigation strategies to protect personnel, facilities, and organizational assets.
  • Collect, analyze, and communicate relevant risk and threat intelligence to support informed security decisions and preparedness.
  • Oversee physical security operations, including facility access control, perimeter security, surveillance systems, and other security technologies.
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute security operations for organizational events, executive engagements, and other high-profile activities.
  • Coordinate with federal and local law enforcement agencies, government officials, and private security partners to ensure appropriate security support and effective incident response.
  • Serve as a trusted security resource for internal stakeholders, providing responsive, professional support while strengthening security awareness and preparedness across the organization.
  • Manage security vendor relationships, oversee service delivery, and conduct quality assurance to maintain high standards of performance and operational effectiveness.
  • Respond to security incidents and emergencies, exercising sound judgment and coordinating appropriate response and resolution efforts.
  • Travel as needed to support organizational initiatives, events, and security operations.

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in executive protection, military service, law enforcement, federal protective services, or a comparable security-related field.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting security risk assessments, identifying vulnerabilities, and implementing effective mitigation strategies.
  • Strong understanding of physical security principles, executive protection practices, and the ability to translate security requirements into practical, actionable plans.
  • Experience planning, coordinating, or executing security operations in dynamic environments, including facilities, events, or high-profile engagements.
  • Familiarity with modern security technologies, including access control, surveillance, and other physical security systems.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and respond effectively to evolving security needs.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with a polished professional presence and the ability to engage confidently with executives, government officials, and diverse stakeholders.
  • High emotional intelligence, discretion, and sound judgment, with a personable, service-oriented approach to building trust and delivering a high level of security support.
  • Ability to remain composed under pressure, navigate sensitive situations, and make informed decisions in fast-paced or high-stakes environments.
  • Enthusiasm for contributing to Stand Together's vision and principled approach to problem-solving, and a commitment to stewarding our culture, which champions values including transformation and innovation, entrepreneurialism, humility, and respect.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and remain on foot for extended periods while supporting security operations, events, and facility activities.
  • Ability to perform the physical duties associated with security operations, including responding to incidents and providing on-site support as needed.
  • Ability to perform the essential physical functions of the role, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to remain calm during stressful periods.

Standout Candidates Will Bring

  • Experience providing executive protection or security support for senior executives, high-profile individuals, or distinguished guests.
  • Background in corporate security, executive services, or complex operational environments requiring a high level of professionalism and discretion.
  • Experience supporting nonprofit organizations, government agencies, or environments involving frequent interaction with public officials and external dignitaries.
  • A strong customer-service mindset, with experience delivering discreet, high-touch security support while maintaining a welcoming and professional environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive benefits: Enjoy a 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting, flexible time off, comprehensive health and dental plans, plus wellness and mental health support through Peloton and Talkspace
  • A meaningful career: Join a passionate community of over 1,300 employees dedicated to improving lives and driving innovative solutions to complex social challenges
  • Commitment to growth: Thrive in a non-hierarchical environment that empowers employees to discover, develop and apply their unique talents
  • Competitive compensation: Our approach rewards the value you create through competitive salaries and bonus opportunities, allowing you to share in the success you help drive
Our Values Working at Stand Together is different from many other organizations. Our culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers our employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success, and that is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity.

title: Agency Development Lead - France
description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts.

Spotify is expanding our Agency development team dedicated to driving new and innovative strategic partnerships with our largest agency partners in France. You will showcase all the technological and data assets available to drive business goals.

The Agency Development Lead will own strategic agency partnerships across the French market. This is not an account management role — you'll architect the agency relationships and commercial frameworks which create opportunities for the FR sales team to activate. You bring deep experience in partnership development and senior agency relationships at the holding company level, with an established track record of building long-term consultative solutions and innovative ways of working with agencies which create value for advertisers. You have a passion for digital media, music, podcasts and innovation, and you know how to translate that into commercial strategy.

What You'll Do

  • Be the primary liaison, internal advocate and thought leader representing Spotify with a specific focus on key C-Level relationships, in partnership with the Sales leadership team in France.
  • Design and negotiate commercial frameworks (incentive structures, commitments, preferred partner terms), key initiatives and areas of focus that align with Spotify solutions to drive innovation, data activation, insights, research and audio engagement
  • Own agency contact mapping, business reviews, education plans, and communication across assigned agencies
  • Partner with Agency Commercial, Activation, and Product teams to accelerate adoption of Spotify's automation, self-service, and programmatic buying solutions — ensuring commercial strategy and execution are aligned to prioritized business goals.
  • Ensure strategic alignment across the FR sales org on agency priorities, partnership terms, and key commercial developments — acting as the connective tissue between agency partners and internal teams.
  • Own the commercial narrative across the agency portfolio — tracking revenue trends, spending patterns, and emerging client opportunities to inform partnership strategy and proactively recommend corrective measures to global, regional, and local sales leadership.
  • Structure and develop a strategic agency narrative — grounded in emerging areas like Ads Manager, programmatic, measurement, data collaboration, AI-enabled workflows, and evolving agency operating models — to drive growth and adoption of Spotify's portfolio of solutions across our holding company partnerships.
  • Create and deliver, in collaboration with sales leads, Spotify education & inspiration-focused programming that has a scaled impact on various constituents across holding company strategic planning and innovation teams.

You will have a deep knowledge of various deal types, compliance requirements, internal systems, approvals processes, and provide guidance and insights to the FR sales teams on further in-quarter and mid-term partnership opportunities.

  • Proven track record of successfully growing revenue through the development of strategic relationships
  • Strong understanding of Spotify user behaviour, product and targeting suite & the ability to translate technical or complicated ideas into ordinary and simple terms
  • Experience in working for matrix organizations & ability to win the support and drive deliverable timelines from key internal cross-functional stakeholders
  • Passion for developing high-impact presentations and leading training programs for large audiences
  • Responsibility for the creation and delivery of assigned agency partners’ company quarterly and annual business reviews
  • Proven experience and understanding of the French agency market dynamics
  • Proven success in a highly dynamic, rapidly changing environment
  • Fluent English & French language, spoken and written is required
  • Please apply to this role with a cv/resume in English

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in Paris
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. title: Staff Product Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Product Designer based in the United States.

We are looking for an accomplished Staff Product Designer to shape end-to-end member experiences for an innovative digital healthcare platform focused on improving metabolic health. In this strategic role, you will lead the design of seamless enrollment journeys that help people understand, access, and adopt personalized healthcare programs. You will combine exceptional visual design with sophisticated service design, connecting digital experiences with real-world interactions such as receiving health devices, setting up sensors, and scheduling virtual clinical appointments. Working across product, marketing, engineering, logistics, and clinical operations, you will transform complex workflows into intuitive, engaging, and trustworthy experiences. Your research-driven approach will help identify diverse member needs, reduce enrollment friction, and improve program adoption. This is an opportunity to influence product strategy, establish cohesive omnichannel experiences, and make a meaningful contribution to the future of personalized healthcare.

Accountabilities:

  • Define user personas and value propositions: Conduct and synthesize user research to identify distinct member personas, understand their motivations and barriers, and develop compelling value propositions tailored to their needs.

  • Design end-to-end enrollment journeys: Lead the creation of persona-driven enrollment experiences across multiple programs, guiding prospective members from initial discovery through registration and active participation.

  • Own comprehensive service design: Connect digital and physical touchpoints into cohesive experiences, including health kit shipment tracking, package unboxing, hardware and sensor setup, and initial virtual appointments with the clinical care team.

  • Deliver high-quality visual design: Create polished, engaging websites, landing pages, enrollment interfaces, and supporting assets that communicate program value clearly and build member trust.

  • Balance quality with speed: Maintain high visual and interaction standards while working efficiently in a fast-paced product environment.

  • Collaborate across disciplines: Partner with marketing, hardware, logistics, clinical operations, product, and engineering teams to ensure digital experiences reflect operational realities and technical capabilities.

  • Influence product direction: Champion user-centered design principles, communicate research-backed recommendations, and align cross-functional stakeholders around a shared vision for onboarding and enrollment.

  • Optimize adoption and conversion: Identify friction points across member journeys and develop design solutions that improve enrollment completion, reduce drop-off, and encourage sustained engagement.

  • Bridge digital and physical experiences: Account for platform constraints, hardware integrations, shipping workflows, appointment scheduling, and other real-world interactions when designing complete service journeys.

  • Develop persuasive product communication: Create clear, engaging user interface copy and present design concepts and decisions effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Support broader design initiatives: Contribute to additional projects and responsibilities as needed to advance product quality and member experience.

    • Requirements:

description:

Years of Experience

6+ years

  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure while managing multiple concurrent deadlines
  • Strong interviewing skills for gathering information from SMEs

Flexibility to work late nights and weekends, as required.

title: Associate Director, Alliance and Project Management
description:
The Opportunity

Precede Biosciences is seeking an Associate Director of Alliance and Project Management to enable delivery on the goals of our biopharma partnered programs As part of this role, this individual will work closely with key internal and external stakeholders, including Business Development, Translational Medicine, Computational Biology, R&D, and Operations, to ensure the development of program plans and drive execution of key programs for our liquid biopsy-based comprehensive epigenomic profiling platform.

About Precede Biosciences

We are pioneering an advanced, minimally invasive, comprehensive epigenomics platform with the potential to profoundly impact the research and development of new medicines and the use of approved medicines in clinical practice across a number of conditions, including cancer. More information on our company and platform can be found on our company website and in our seminal publication in Nature Medicine.

We care deeply about creating a place where folks can do their best work from the start and have intentionally created an environment that is defined by purpose, teamwork, and excellence. This means nurturing team spirit, facing challenges together, collaboratively solving complex problems, while also ensuring a strong focus on individual initiative, accountability, and delivery.

What You Will Do

  • Manage and serve as primary point of contact for designated biopharma collaborations.
  • Manage alliance lifecycle, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations with partners and compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Develop and maintain program plans in collaboration with internal stakeholders to ensure delivery on contractual obligations.
  • Lead day-to-day activities for alliances, driving successful program, project, and alliance execution through effective internal and external communication and alignment on project goals and timelines.
  • Facilitate partnership meetings, establish deliverable and timeline goals and expectations, regularly track and communicate progress and deviations, and prepare key documentation and reports.
  • Cultivate close-knit relationships and partnerships with internal stakeholders and collaborators to advance alliance and project goals and deliverables.
  • Drive goals of alliances while maintaining a broad perspective on the impact of short-term decisions on long term success.
  • Anticipate and identify potential gaps and conflicts both in contractual agreements and day-to-day execution, constructing a path forward while maintaining a collaborative working relationship with external partners.
  • Consult and engage with internal team members and Precede Biosciences business partners (e.g., corporate and business development, R&D, operations, legal, etc.) to ensure ongoing alignment towards goal achievement. Prepare for and facilitate proactive partnership management and coordinate key project activities.
  • Update and inform senior leadership through timely alliance reviews, resource evaluation, and gap analyses.
  • Educate and share best practices to foster Precede Biosciences-wide capability in alliance management.

title: Diagnostic Imaging Manager
description:
The Diagnostic Imaging Manager provides day-to-day leadership for diagnostic imaging services, ensuring safe, accurate exams and a consistent patient experience across age groups. This role exists to align imaging operations with quality standards, regulatory expectations, and departmental performance goals.

Key responsibilities include coordinating staffing for rotating 8-hour shifts (days/evenings/weekends/holidays), overseeing workflow and documentation, supporting modality performance, and addressing equipment and system issues (PACS/RIS, printers, copiers, fax, phones). The manager also supports staff development, communication, and compliance expectations.

Required qualifications/skills:
- Indiana Radiologic Technologist licensure
- ARRT certification (or equivalent) and maintenance of 24 CEUs each biennium
- Proficiency with radiographic imaging modalities, medical/imaging terminology, and MS Office
- Strong written and verbal communication with patients from neonate to geriatric
- Supervisory experience preferred

Apply today to be considered for this onsite, full-time opportunity in Corydon, IN.

Benefits at a Glance

Harrison County Hospital supports your well-being and stability with Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, plus a 401(k) and Life Insurance. You’ll also have HSA and FSA options, Competitive Salary, and Paid Time Off to help balance work and personal needs. Onsite extras include a Snack/Drink Room and Employee Discounts.

Daily Operations Flow

As the Diagnostic Imaging Manager, you’ll begin by confirming the day’s exam schedule, room readiness, and rotating 8-hour shift coverage. You’ll round with technologists and connect with nursing and providers to align on add-ons, stat needs, and patient preparation. During the shift, you’ll keep throughput steady by resolving questions at the front line and updating communication when priorities change. If PACS/RIS or other department equipment issues occur, you’ll coordinate quick troubleshooting to prevent delays. You’ll close out the day by reviewing key logs, following up on open items, and planning ahead for weekend and holiday staffing.

title: Control Systems Project Lead – Applied Science
description:
Xcimer Energy leverages decades of research on Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) combined with groundbreaking new laser architecture. Our mission is to deploy fusion power plants to meet global decarbonization goals as fast as possible. Xcimer has assembled a team of leaders in tough tech, fusion science, and manufacturing with a track record of rapid execution. Supported by leading investors, Xcimer is uniquely positioned to deliver limitless, clean, fusion power to combat climate change. Join us in powering a better world with inertial fusion!
This is a full-time, onsite role based at our headquarters in Denver, CO.

As a Control Systems Project Lead – Applied Science, you will own the controls system of a major development program, starting with one of our large, multi-subsystem laser test facilities. Our Applied Science group delivers control systems that integrate advanced hardware to demonstrate cutting-edge science, and in this role you will design, implement, verify, and commission the control, data acquisition, and interlock systems that enable scientific experimentation. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with coordination responsibility: you will plan and assign sprint work to other team members, deliver software releases on schedule, work directly with system operators, and coordinate controls activities with the other engineering teams on the program. We are looking for an engineer who brings strong diagnostic thinking, test stand experience, and demonstrable software capability, along with the organization to keep a multi-team controls effort on track.

Responsibilities

  • Own the controls system for a major development program as a hands-on individual contributor, including requirements, architecture, and delivery of its control, data acquisition, and interlock systems across multiple subsystems.
  • Lead sprint planning for the program's controls work, assign and track tasks, review contributions, and ensure software releases are delivered on time.
  • Coordinate controls work with other engineering stakeholders, such as optics, pulsed power, mechanical, software, and operations teams. You will lead collaboration with these teams to define system interfaces, set priorities, and schedule system access time for controls development and testing.
  • Gather feedback from system operators and other users, prioritize improvements, and respond to and resolve bug reports.
  • Apply diagnostic and systems-level troubleshooting methodologies to identify root causes of system, software, or hardware issues.
  • Plan and lead controls support for test campaigns, including readiness reviews, functional checkout, system integration testing, and on-the-floor support during experiments.
  • Design, develop, and commission control systems for test and measurement applications, including laboratory and industrial test stands.
  • Lead verification and validation (V&V) activities for the controls system, including test planning, test procedure development, execution, and reporting.
  • Develop control, automation, and data acquisition software using Python, LabVIEW, and related tools.
  • Integrate hardware and software for test systems, including instrumentation, DAQ hardware, off-the-shelf benchtop equipment, and custom hardware.
  • Implement and maintain automated test frameworks, unit tests, and regression tests to support reliable system evolution.
  • Interface with and integrate a wide range of communication protocols and interfaces such as RS‑232/422/485, TCP/IP, Ethernet-based fieldbuses such as EtherCAT, and instrument control protocols.
  • Own controls requirements development, interface definition, requirements traceability (RTM), and change control to support structured V&V and quality processes.
  • Design hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test systems, and collaborate closely with electrical, mechanical, and software engineers to ensure test systems accurately represent real-world operating conditions.
  • Support commissioning activities, acceptance testing, and ongoing lifecycle support for test infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in control systems engineering, with a strong emphasis on test and measurement or validation environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and commissioning test stands, automated test equipment (ATE), or experimental systems.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a controls system on a multi-disciplinary project, including sprint or release planning, task assignment, and on-time delivery of software releases.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience coordinating across engineering teams and presenting status, risks, and design decisions to stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in LabVIEW, including development of maintainable, version-controlled code.
  • Strong working knowledge of verification and validation methodologies, including test planning and execution and requirements tracking such as with a Requirements Traceability Matrix.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and modern software development workflows.
  • Working knowledge of unit testing, automated testing, or test-driven development concepts.
  • Familiarity with industrial and laboratory communication protocols (e.g., RS‑232, TCP/IP, Ethernet-based protocols).
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Desired

  • Experience in large experimental or test facilities such as laser, accelerator, pulsed power, aerospace, or national laboratory environments.
  • Experience supporting system operators in a production or experimental environment, including triaging bug reports and incorporating user feedback into releases.
  • Experience with agile or sprint-based planning tools and workflows (e.g., Jira) for engineering software delivery.
  • Experience with advanced architectural concepts, such as an Actor framework
  • Experience with Python
  • Familiarity with instrumentation standards and interfaces (e.g., SCPI, GPIB, USB instruments).
  • Experience with DAQ systems, high-speed data capture, or synchronization/timing systems.
  • Exposure to systems integration best practices commonly used by professional control system integrators (e.g., lifecycle documentation, change control, structured testing).
  • Knowledge of safety-related control concepts, interlocks, or fail-safe system design.
  • Experience supporting testing in R&D, prototype, or experimental environments.
  • Familiarity with documentation standards such as test plans, test procedures, verification matrices, and commissioning reports.
  • Experience collaborating with scientists, and developing support plans in service to scientific experiments & objectives.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Xcimer Energy is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified, diverse, and dedicated work force. Xcimer Energy hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. Benefits
Xcimer offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee health, well-being, and long-term success. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; basic and supplemental life insurance; short- and long-term disability; paid parental leave for employees at the time of birth or adoption; and a 401(k) with a company match of up to 6%. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

Working closely with Architects, Cyber Security, Infrastructure, Application and Analytics teams, you will provide technical leadership while delivering complex data platform modernisation and cloud transformation projects.

As the Senior Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building and supporting enterprise data solutions using the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem. Acting as a technical SME and escalation point, you will lead best practice implementation across data engineering, governance, performance optimisation and operational support.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing and optimising Microsoft Fabric solutions including OneLake, Lakehouses, Warehouses, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Spark notebooks and Semantic Models
  • Implementing scalable Medallion Architecture across Bronze, Silver, Gold and Serving data layers
  • Developing resilient batch and near real-time data integration pipelines from enterprise applications, APIs, databases and cloud platforms
  • Building complex data transformations using SQL, Python and PySpark
  • Delivering data platform migration, modernisation and reporting transformation initiatives

  • Designing and supporting backup, recovery, high-availability and disaster recovery solutions
  • Providing technical leadership, mentoring and knowledge sharing across data teams
  • Supporting production-critical environments through troubleshooting, root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives

About You

You are a senior data engineering professional with deep expertise across Microsoft data platforms and a strong track record delivering enterprise-scale solutions in complex environments.

Essential Experience

  • 7+ years' experience supporting enterprise data platforms, database environments and data infrastructure services
  • Hands-on experience delivering Microsoft Fabric implementations and transformation projects
  • Strong expertise across:
    • Microsoft Fabric
    • OneLake, Lakehouse and Warehouse architectures
    • Azure Data Factory
    • Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL
    • Power BI and Semantic Models
    • SQL, Python and PySpark
  • Experience designing secure, scalable and governed cloud data platforms
  • Strong understanding of data governance, security, encryption, auditing and compliance requirements
  • Experience with performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability and disaster recovery
  • Proven experience working within large-scale enterprise and cloud-enabled environments
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes

Highly Regarded

  • Microsoft Data, Azure or Fabric certifications

Why Join Us?

  • Lead enterprise-wide data and analytics transformation initiatives
  • Work with cutting-edge Microsoft Fabric technologies
  • Influence architecture, standards and platform strategy
  • Collaborate with highly skilled technology and business teams
  • Deliver solutions that support advanced analytics, reporting and AI capabilities
  • Flexible and supportive working environment
  • Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities

If you're passionate about modern data platforms and want to play a leading role in shaping the future of enterprise data and analytics, we'd love to hear from you.

WHO WE ARE

Pancheros grew from our very first restaurant-a local favorite in the college town of Iowa City back in 1992-to one of the most beloved Mexican Fast casual brands in the country. Scratch-made dough and fresh-pressed flour tortillas are integral to our burritos. Ingredients perfectly mixed into every bite is also a key component of Burritos Better Built, so in 2002 we introduced Bob The ToolÂ® to mix before roll. And of course, our homemade queso, which has earned a fan following for its ooey, gooey, extra cheesy, velvety texture and zip of zesty, mouthwatering flavor perfect for chip-dipping or slathering on your burrito.

WHAT SETS US APART

Delicious starts with a solid foundation.

Our fresh-pressed tortillas are the key to Burritos Better Built. Each one, made from house-made dough every morning and fresh-pressed in front of your eyes until perfectly golden brown. Then tightly wrapped to support all the freshest ingredients of your choice for a burrito that stands up to your wildest cravings.

URRITO. Burritos without the B.S.

When you keep things as fresh as we do, there's simply no need for the B and the S. (Otherwise known as shortcuts like fryers, freezers, packaged tortillas-we'd never!) We take pride in putting in the extra effort to do things the right way-from scratch, by hand-because that's what delivers the flavor that really sets us apart.

All the right stuff in all the right places.

The key to our burritos is mixing every ingredient together in every bite, because no one wants a mouthful of sour cream or rice. We take mixing so seriously, we even created our very own tool to get the job done right: Bob the Tool. Your single-handed assurance that every burrito you order at Pancheros won't just meet your expectations, it'll exceed them.

We take a fresh approach to service, too.

Every time you walk into one of our restaurants, we're on a mission to make your day even better. Carefully preparing your food from scratch, keeping our restaurants in tip top shape, making online ordering, delivery, and catering as smooth as our queso, and providing quick, courteous service that makes every meal an unforgettable one.

title: AM Filling Technician
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Fillers are responsible for processing orders (manifests) by organizing tasks based on date, color code, and priority using the assigned computer system. They scan barcodes to generate and print labels, then label and package products according to type and storage requirements.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


Accounts Management:

· Uses the assigned computer system to scan, track, and update each order in real time.

· Ensures that all labels correspond to the correct patient, medication type, and handling instructions.

· Maintains responsibility for the completeness and correctness of each individual order.


Collaboration & Communication:

· Works closely with other departments to resolve missing items or special-order requirements.

· Communicates inconsistencies or product-related problems to the supervising pharmacist or quality control.

· Ensures clear communication when transferring completed orders to the Runner or waiting for additional components (e.g., pills, custom items).


Documentation & Reporting:

· Documents order progress and labeling through barcode scanning and system input.

· Ensures that the packaging and labeling reflect the exact contents and storage requirements.

· Strictly follows and documents steps according to Standard Operating Procedures and safety protocols.


Daily Workflow Management:

· Organizes workflow based on color codes, dates, and priority levels.

· Maintains cleanliness and logical layout of supplies and products to support speed and accuracy.

· Understands production timelines and coordinates with others to keep the workflow continuous and free of delays


Skills and Abilities:

· Attention to Detail: Careful review of orders and accuracy in labeling and packaging.

· Technical Aptitude: Proficient in using computer systems for scanning and label printing.

· Organization: Ability to follow work priorities and keep workstations orderly.

· Communication: Clear coordination with coworkers across departments.

· Time Management: Efficiency in working under pressure and meeting deadlines.

· Teamwork: Active collaboration with technicians, runners, and pharmacists.


Education and Experience:

· High school diploma or equivalent (GED).

· Current certification as a Pharmacy Technician or applicable state license.

· 1 to 2 years of experience in a pharmacy or logistics setting focused on order fulfillment.

· Preferred experience in compounding pharmacies or preparation of injectable products.


Physical Requirements:

· Ability to stand or walk for continuous period of time during an 8 to 10 hours shift.

· Manual dexterity to handle injectables, supplies, and packaging accurately.

· Ability to lift or move trays of products or supplies up to 11 kg (25 lbs).

· Good vision (with correction if necessary) to read barcodes, labels, and prescriptions.

· Constant use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as gloves, masks, and lab coats.


AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

title: Adaptation Specialist (Jr/Mid)- TFDM
description:
Position Summary:

P17 Solutions is a distinguished Small Business Administration company, specializing in delivering professional services to a diverse range of clients, including Federal, State, and Local Government agencies, industry partners, and organizations across both public and private sectors. With an unwavering commitment to excellence and a proven track record of success, we have established ourselves as a trusted and reliable provider of cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions.

P17 Solutions is seeking a Junior Adaptation Specialist to join our Terminal Flight Data Manager (TFDM) team that supports the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). This is a 100% on-site, full-time position at the William J Hughes Technical Center (WJHTC) in Egg Harbor Township, NJ.

The Junior / Mid-Level Adaptation Specialist shall provide site-specific configuration, integration, validation, and maintenance support of TFDM capabilities at terminal facilities. The Adaptation Specialist is a subject matter expert responsible for translating operational requirements and local air traffic control procedures into facility-specific configurations (adaptations) that enable safe, efficient, and tailored deployment of the TFDM system.

This position plays a critical role in ensuring successful deployment and transition of TFDM capabilities into operational use at FAA terminal facilities, while maintaining alignment with national standards and program baselines.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for TFDM adaptation activities at assigned terminal sites.
  • Develop, manage, and validate site-specific TFDM configurations (e.g., gate/stand layouts, surface routing, flight data rules, alerting parameters).
  • Collaborate with Air Traffic Control (ATC), Technical Operations, engineering teams, and other stakeholders to gather and interpret operational data, procedures, and local requirements.
  • Use adaptation tools and configuration management systems to input, update, and version-control site adaptations.
  • Participate in pre-deployment assessments, dry-runs, and readiness reviews to ensure adaptation accuracy and completeness.
  • Support system integration testing (SIT), joint site acceptance testing (JSAT), and operational testing (OT&E) efforts.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise-level architecture, safety, and system engineering standards.
  • Assist in root cause analysis of adaptation-related issues and coordinate resolution strategies with engineering teams.
  • Maintain documentation of adaptation decisions, processes, and version histories for audit and knowledge management purposes.
  • Provide training, guidance, and technical support on adaptation concepts to local and national stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Aviation, Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related field; or equivalent experience
  • Jr Level: 1-4 years experience; Mid Level 5-9 years experience
  • Ability to interpret operational needs into technical requirements and translate them into functional system configurations.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, including the ability to interface with air traffic controllers, engineers, and program stakeholders
  • Ability to travel to FAA facilities for site surveys, adaptation workshops and deployment support as needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with TFDM, TFMS, STARS, ASDE-X, or other FAA automation platforms.
  • Experience with configuration management tools, geospatial layouts, or data adaptation platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of terminal facility layouts, aircraft movement, and ATC procedures.
  • Experience in aviation systems adaptation, air traffic operations, or system integration roles.
  • Prior experience working with or within the FAA's TFDM, TFMS, or ERAM programs.
  • Familiarity with FAA's implementation lifecycle (e.g., waterfall, Agile), Acquisition Management System (AMS), and Joint Resources Council (JRC) processes.
  • Experience using FAA's adaptation development environments, such as URET or TDDS.
  • Knowledge of enterprise geospatial systems such as ARCGIS or AutoCAD for airport layouts.
  • Ability to lift up to 20lbs

Security Clearance: Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

Citizenship/Permanent Residency Requirement All candidates must have the following to pass the Federal Background Investigation and obtain the FAA Public Trust security clearance.

  • Be a US Citizen, have a US Green Card, or a Non-immigrant Work Authorization (VISA).
  • Has resided in the US for three (3) consecutive years.
  • The company is unable to sponsor candidates at this time.

Relocation Requirement

Relocation expenses are not offered. Candidate must reside or be willing to relocate within a commutable distance to Egg Harbor Township, NJ.

Work Environment

  • Full-time position with a standard flexible work schedule and occasional non-standard work hours. Cubicle setting.
  • Significant travel (likely > 50%).

Travel Requirement: Signification travel (> 50%) to FAA facilities or integration labs

Base Pay: The base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Benefits: At P17 Solutions, we are dedicated to investing in the success and well-being of our employees. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally. Full-time employees are eligible for comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, educational assistance, generous leave policies, 11 paid holidays, and any additional paid leave required by law.

EEO Statement

P17 Solutions LLC is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, religion, marital status, ancestry, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor prohibited by applicable law. P17 Solutions is a VEVRAA federal contractor, and we request priority referral of veterans. We invite applications from all interested parties.

Pursuant to Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12, FAA Order 1600.1F and FAA Order 1600.78 employees are required to submit fingerprints and pass a 7-year background investigation. Employees may also be required to pass a drug test.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Audiences
description:
Meet Fetch Engineering
At Fetch, engineering is driven by curiosity, ownership, and a bias toward action. We operate in complex problem spaces where the right answer is not always clear, and success depends on adaptability, critical thinking, and informed decision-making. Our engineers are comfortable navigating ambiguity, understanding tradeoffs, gathering context, and turning uncertainty into progress while maintaining high technical standards.

Engineers at Fetch take pride in building reliable, scalable systems that serve millions of users. You will contribute directly to the codebase, collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, and help shape best practices that elevate the quality of our work. We foster a culture of mentorship and collaboration, where engineers grow by learning from one another and holding a high bar for quality, reliability, and impact.

About the Role:
Fetch is building the capabilities to turn purchase insights into a scalable audience business. We want to help advertisers reach both known buyers and prospective customers through predictive and lookalike audiences, combining Fetch’s purchase data with licensed identity and attribute data to expand reach beyond our existing users.

We’re looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to lead the engineering behind these products. You’ll partner with Data Science, Product, and Data Platform to take audience models from prototypes to reliable products that partners can activate through their advertising platforms.

This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

Role Responsibilities:
  • Build the audience lifecycle. Develop services and workflows for defining seed audiences, incorporating identity and attribute data, scoring eligible populations, validating membership, refreshing segments, and delivering audiences to partners and DSPs.
  • Bring predictive and lookalike models into production. Partner with Data Science to build repeatable training, evaluation, deployment, and batch-scoring workflows. Make it straightforward to introduce new models, compare versions, and refresh audiences as data and behavior change.
  • Make audience activation reliable. Integrate identity mappings and partner-specific delivery requirements. Track how audience coverage changes through matching and delivery, diagnose losses, and build repeatable integrations that support additional partners.
  • Build quality and operational controls into the product. Version datasets, models, and audience definitions so results are reproducible. Implement monitoring, quality checks, safe retries, corrections, and access controls, including enforcement of data-use restrictions.
  • Lead technical execution across the domain. Shape the audience engineering roadmap, make architecture and build-versus-reuse decisions, and guide other engineers through delivery. Build on shared ingestion, storage, orchestration, and governance capabilities with the core Data Platform team.

Minimum Requirements:
  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of data-intensive products from design through production adoption.
  • Strong coding, API design, data modeling, and distributed-systems skills.
  • Experience operationalizing ML or predictive systems, including data dependencies, evaluation workflows, deployment, batch scoring, and monitoring.
  • Demonstrated experience setting technical direction for an engineering domain, aligning teams around architecture and priorities, and leading complex initiatives from ambiguous requirements through production adoption.
  • Experience making and evolving architectural decisions for production systems, balancing near-term delivery with long-term reliability, scalability, operating cost, and maintainability.

title: Associate, Private Equity/Venture Capital
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate, Private Equity/Venture Capital based in the United States.

Join an innovative financial services environment at the intersection of traditional investment management and blockchain technology. As an Associate, Private Equity/Venture Capital, you will support the accounting and administration of private equity and venture capital funds, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely financial reporting. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements, oversee fund transactions, and contribute to the preparation of financial statements and investor reporting. Working closely with clients, auditors, and internal teams, you will help maintain high standards of financial integrity and operational efficiency. This role offers the opportunity to deepen your expertise in closed-end private investment funds while gaining practical exposure to cryptocurrency assets and digital finance. You will join a collaborative, globally distributed team that values professionalism, accountability, and continuous improvement. If you are passionate about fund accounting and the evolving relationship between finance and blockchain, this opportunity offers an exciting path for professional growth.

Accountabilities

  • Manage fund accounting activities: Prepare, maintain, and reconcile accounting records for approximately 10–20 client engagements, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable accounting standards.
  • Oversee financial transactions: Reconcile portfolio activity and cash movements against source documentation, record fund expenses promptly, and ensure accurate financial entries.
  • Prepare investor allocations: Calculate and review investor allocations, management fees, and other fund-related expenses to ensure transactions are recorded correctly.
  • Deliver financial reporting: Prepare quarterly net asset value (NAV) reports and ensure all client deliverables are complete, accurate, and submitted within established deadlines.
  • Calculate capital activity: Prepare capital call and distribution calculations for private equity and venture capital funds, ensuring the appropriate documentation and accounting treatment.
  • Support audits and financial statements: Draft annual financial statements and coordinate year-end audit activities with clients and independent auditors.
  • Coordinate treasury operations: Collaborate with the treasury team to initiate client wire transfers and support the accurate processing of fund-related payments.
  • Maintain client relationships: Respond to client inquiries promptly, communicate financial information clearly, and provide consistent, professional service.
  • Improve operational efficiency: Track time accurately, maintain productive work practices, identify process inefficiencies and client-related challenges, and communicate potential improvements to relevant stakeholders.
  • Uphold professional standards: Demonstrate integrity, discretion, and accountability in all interactions with clients, colleagues, and external partners.

Requirements

  • Professional experience: At least 3 years of experience in fund accounting, public accounting, or a related financial role, preferably with a focus on closed-end private investment funds.
  • Education: A bachelor's or master's degree in accounting, finance, or a related discipline.
  • Fund accounting expertise: Practical knowledge of fund accounting processes, including reconciliations, expense accruals, investor allocations, NAV reporting, capital calls, distributions, and financial statement preparation.
  • Financial and analytical skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with strong attention to detail and the ability to analyze complex financial data accurately.
  • Cryptocurrency knowledge: Practical experience working with cryptocurrency assets and a working understanding of digital asset markets.
  • Communication skills: Excellent written and verbal communication abilities, with a professional approach to client service, teamwork, and stakeholder management.
  • Organization and time management: Ability to manage multiple client engagements, prioritize competing deadlines, maintain accurate records, and deliver high-quality work efficiently.
  • Professional judgment: Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, integrity, and the ability to identify and communicate accounting discrepancies or operational risks.
  • Preferred qualifications: CPA, CFA, or MBA credentials are highly desirable but not required.
  • Interest in digital finance: Curiosity about blockchain technology, tokenized assets, and the evolving relationship between traditional investment funds and digital financial infrastructure.

Benefits

  • Flexible paid time off: Paid time off designed to support work-life balance and personal well-being.
  • Equity opportunities: Eligibility for equity grants, providing an opportunity to participate in the company's growth.
  • Remote work flexibility: Work remotely while collaborating with a globally distributed and supportive team.
  • Health insurance: Employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for eligible employees in the United States, including family coverage.
  • Retirement savings: Access to an employer-sponsored 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Professional development: Opportunities to expand expertise in private fund accounting, cryptocurrency assets, and emerging financial technologies.
  • Collaborative environment: Work alongside professionals across financial services and blockchain, contributing to an evolving digital asset ecosystem.

title: Respiratory Therapy Program Director
description:
Summary:

The Program Director is responsible for overseeing the academic integrity and operational success of their assigned program(s), including curriculum development, faculty management, student outcomes, accreditation compliance, and overall program performance. This position plays a key role in student retention and success, while also ensuring that educational programs meet institutional and accreditation standards. The Program Director will ensure that faculty are well-qualified and equipped to deliver quality education and may also teach courses as part of their duties. The position also involves managing resources, developing external partnerships for clinical rotations, and ensuring continuous program improvement based on assessment data from a variety of metrics.

Compensation: The starting pay range for this position is $90,000 - $125,000 annually.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Administrative:

  • Ensures faculty qualifications, licensure, and work experience meet program standards.
  • Assists in faculty recruitment, selection, onboarding, and ongoing professional development.
  • Develops academic schedules, conducts faculty evaluations, and participates in classroom observations.
  • Coordinates faculty activities and ensures they adhere to curriculum standards and best practices.
  • Trains, supervises, and evaluates faculty, ensuring quality instructional delivery.
  • Acts as a mentor for faculty, providing support and guidance to help them improve their teaching techniques.
  • Ensures faculty meet ongoing professional development requirements and performance standards.
  • Manages academic program compliance with college policies, accreditation standards, and industry regulations.
  • Develops and implements retention strategies to enhance student success; monitors student progress including those on leave of absence and in clinicals/externships.
  • Oversees externship and clinical site placements, ensuring they meet program requirements.
  • Maintains and manages program-specific equipment, supplies, textbooks, and materials.
  • Monitors and assesses course and program outcomes, student retention, graduation rates, licensure exam pass rates, and other performance metrics; develops and implements improvement plans as needed.
  • Organizes and facilitates advisory committee meetings, faculty meetings, and curriculum review sessions.
  • Prepares and submits accreditation documentation accurately and timely.
  • Leads program-level training for faculty, providing support and resources to improve teaching practices.
  • Participates in college governance committees, and professional development activities.

Instructional:

  • Participates in the student recruitment and selection process.
  • Teaches assigned courses.
  • Assesses student learning outcomes (SLOs) and monitors course effectiveness.
  • Provides feedback to students, facilitating continuous improvement.
  • Offers additional student support, including tutoring and communication regarding attendance or academic concerns.
  • Ensures proper record-keeping and student evaluations as required by institutional and accreditation policies.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Directly supervises faculty members (1-15).

  • Integrity and Ethics: Demonstrates honesty and integrity in all professional interactions.
  • Professionalism: Treats others with respect and follows through on commitments.

  • Relevant degree(s) from accredited institutions.

Skills:

  • Strong communication skills, both oral and written.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
  • Ability to assess and analyze student learning outcomes and improve instructional practices.
  • Experience in managing faculty and developing programs to ensure student success.

  • The ability to regularly stand, sit, talk, and hear.
  • Ability to frequently walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Ability to occasionally climb or balance.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to handle and manipulate program equipment and materials.

Work Environment:

  • Moderate noise levels in the workplace.
  • Occasional exposure to wet, humid, or outside weather conditions depending on the program.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must maintain knowledge of the latest developments in the relevant program field.
  • Must possess or have the ability to obtain any required certifications or licenses related to program instruction.

title: Alumni Engagement Specialist
description:
Society for Science is dedicated to expanding scientific literacy, access to STEM education and scientific research for more than 100 years. As a nonprofit 501(c)(3) membership organization, our mission promotes the understanding and appreciation of science and the vital role it plays in human advancement: to inform, educate, and inspire. We are best known for our award-winning magazine, Science News, our world class science research competitions and our outreach and equity STEM Programs making sure that every young person can strive to become an engineer or scientist.

Position Overview

The Society is looking for an Alumni Engagement Specialist to support the Advancement team. The Alumni Engagement Specialist is the day-to-day engine of the Society's alumni program, supporting the Director of Alumni Relations across event logistics, communications, and CRM (Microsoft Dynamics) data so that the Society's Science Talent Search (STS), International Science and Engineering Fair (ISEF), and Junior Innovators Challenge (JIC) / Broadcom MASTERS alumni stay connected, informed, and engaged. This role is where the alumni program's plans become action – coordinating the events, correspondence, content, and records that keep the program running smoothly day to day.

This is a detail-oriented, service-minded position that requires strong organizational skills and the judgment to represent the Society well with alumni, donors, and senior leadership. The Alumni Engagement Specialist is the person the Director relies on to execute engagement plans accurately and on schedule.

We value strong analytical and interpersonal skills, and the ability to contribute to a fast-paced environment as an individual and as part of a team.

This role offers a clear path of growth. A Specialist who demonstrates strong performance and develops their programmatic and relationship-management capabilities will be considered for advancement to a higher-level position as the alumni program continues to scale.

Responsibilities

Engagement Activities

  • Support alumni engagement activities at major events, including the Science Talent Search (STS), International Science and Engineering Fair (ISEF), and Junior Innovators Challenge (JIC), by coordinating logistics and providing high-touch, on-site service to VIP guests and award recipients.
  • Coordinate logistics for National Leadership Council (NLC) meetings, including scheduling, materials preparation, and minute-taking.
  • Coordinate logistics for alumni programming, including virtual reunions for Science Talent Search alumni across class years.
  • Coordinate the Jon C. Graff Prize selection process, including committee outreach and scheduling.
  • Participate in regular team meetings, sharing updates and ideas to support the program's planning.

Content and Communication

  • Assist with production of the alumni e-newsletter – drafting content, coordinating audience segmentation (via Customer Insights), and managing email deployment in coordination with the Annual Giving team.
  • Assist with drafting and production of alumni-facing marketing materials (direct mail, email appeals, sustainer campaign communications) from messaging direction provided by the Director.
  • Maintain and update web content highlighting alumni achievements, such as prestigious awards and recognitions.
  • Assist with routine updates to alumni web pages in WordPress.
  • Monitor and moderate day-to-day activity in online alumni communities, including LinkedIn, following the team's established engagement plan.
    Correspondence and Stakeholder Support
  • Draft correspondence and invitations for review and approval by senior leadership, including outreach to prospective speakers, panelists, and other key stakeholders.
  • Assist with research to build alumni profiles, supporting the Individual Giving team's prospecting efforts.

Data and CRM Management

  • Maintain and update alumni records in CRM (Microsoft Dynamics) and run standard reports to support the team's data needs.
  • Support execution of alumni engagement campaigns designed by the Director, such as photo requests, volunteer recruitment, and feedback surveys via Customer Voice.
  • Collaborate with Advancement's Donor Research & Portfolio Manager and the IT team to audit, clean, and improve the data integrity of the 80,000+ alumni base within the CRM, ensuring accurate records and streamlined data processes.
  • Identify highly engaged alumni, such as event attendees, volunteers, NLC members and first-time donors, and flag them in the CRM for the Individual Giving team, following criteria set by the Director of Alumni Relations. Provide regular reports so that engaged alumni move smoothly into the Society's donor pipeline.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
  • One to two years of experience in alumni relations, donor or member engagement, event planning, or a related role in a nonprofit or membership organization.
  • CRM/database experience, preferably Microsoft Dynamics; other CRM platforms (e.g., Raiser's Edge, Salesforce) accepted.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with a track record of accuracy in data entry and content production.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously and flag issues proactively rather than reactively.
  • Demonstrated affinity for the mission of Society for Science.
  • Ability to develop rapport with colleagues and external clients.

Preferred

  • Experience with database migration, data hygiene projects, or cross-departmental CRM collaboration.
  • Familiarity with WordPress or other content management systems.
  • Experience with email marketing/segmentation tools (e.g., Customer Insights) or survey platforms (e.g., Customer Voice).
  • Experience moderating online communities or social media platforms (e.g., LinkedIn).
  • Experience supporting donor or alumni engagement campaigns in a nonprofit or membership organization.
  • Experience drafting correspondence on behalf of senior leadership.

What Success Looks Like

  • In the first 90 days: This person has mastered the full range of alumni engagement activities and events supported by the team, has demonstrated a strong command of the CRM for meticulous day-to-day data entry, hygiene, and reporting, and has begun independently handling logistics for recurring meetings such as the NLC. Newsletter and correspondence drafts require only light editing from the Director.
  • At six months: This person is running event and meeting logistics with minimal oversight, ensures alumni records, segmentation data, and metrics remain rigorously accurate and current in the CRM, and acts as a trusted data and logistics resource for the team. Content drafts consistently reflect the program's voice with minimal revision.
  • At one year: This person has helped carry at least one major event (such as ISEF) and a full cycle of the Jon C. Graff Prize process from start to finish, serves as an expert power-user in the CRM who actively drives data integrity initiatives alongside IT and Advancement Operations, and is ready to begin taking on greater ownership of content, database segmentation strategies, and engagement planning.

Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee usually works in an office setting. This position is based at Society for Science's Washington, D.C. headquarters, near the Dupont Circle and Farragut North Metro stations. The Society is operating on a hybrid work schedule, with an in-office requirement of 2 days a week.

Position Type and Expected Hours

Standard hours are Monday through Friday during normal business hours (8:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. Eastern time, with core hours of 10:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m.). Light travel and occasional evening or weekend work are required to support major events such as ISEF, NLC meetings, and class reunions.
