title: Reservoir Engineer, Modeling
description:
Fervo is working to build the most cost-effective, repeatable geothermal power plants in the world. Delivering on this mission requires operational excellence across every function — including the reservoir models and calibration workflows that translate field data into a predictive understanding of how our fractured geothermal reservoirs behave.


Joining Fervo as a Reservoir Engineer focused on reservoir modeling and history matching means owning the calibration of our subsurface models against real field performance — both the stimulation fracture growth created during completions and the production and pressure response of the reservoir over time. This role also defines and drives the testing and data acquisition programs needed to close calibration gaps and continuously improve history-matching accuracy. The position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys rigorous model-to-data reconciliation, diagnosing the sources of mismatch, and designing the next test that resolves it.


The Reservoir Engineer will build, calibrate, and maintain reservoir and fracture models, with a strong focus on history matching both stimulation-induced fracture growth and reservoir production/pressure behavior. This role emphasizes quantitative rigor, root-cause diagnosis of model mismatch, and the design of targeted diagnostic testing to improve match quality over time.


The position collaborates closely with Completions, D&C, Reservoir, and Data Science teams to align stimulation design, field data acquisition, and simulation workflows so that models stay predictive as the asset base grows.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation based in the United States.

We are seeking a seasoned machine learning engineer to shape the future of personalized content discovery within an innovative, AI-driven consumer platform. In this senior individual contributor role, you will own the recommendation, search, and ranking systems that connect users with engaging, relevant interactive experiences. You will design and deploy production-grade machine learning models that influence what people discover, play, and return to. Working at the intersection of AI, consumer social products, and interactive entertainment, you will turn complex behavioral data into meaningful product improvements. You will collaborate closely with product, data, and engineering teams to experiment rapidly, measure impact, and deliver scalable solutions. This is an opportunity to take significant technical ownership, influence long-term ML architecture, and build next-generation discovery experiences in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.

Accountabilities

  • Build, optimize, and maintain recommendation and search systems across personalized feeds, discovery pages, search experiences, and content continuation features.

  • Own retrieval and ranking pipelines, including candidate generation, embedding-based retrieval, two-tower models, ranking features, and online serving performance.

  • Design, launch, and analyze end-to-end recommendation and search experiments, using quantitative insights to improve model quality and product outcomes.

  • Improve discovery experiences for new users, newly published content, and rapidly evolving content catalogs by addressing cold-start challenges and changing user preferences.

  • Develop meaningful user, content, creator, and session representations using behavioral signals and other relevant data sources.

  • Partner with product, data, and engineering teams to establish success metrics, conduct experiments, and deliver measurable improvements in user engagement, retention, satisfaction, and content distribution.

  • Build practical machine learning solutions that move efficiently from prototypes to production, supported by robust evaluation, monitoring, and performance optimization.

  • Translate complex user behavior and product challenges into effective modeling strategies and actionable recommendations.

  • Contribute to the long-term architecture and technical direction of AI-powered content discovery systems.

  • Explore emerging approaches in recommendation, semantic search, personalization, and AI-driven content understanding to improve discovery quality and relevance.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 5 years of industry experience developing and deploying production machine learning systems, with senior-level ownership of recommendation, search, ranking, advertising ranking, feed ranking, or content discovery.

    • Hands-on experience building recommendation or search systems for consumer-facing applications.

    • Background working on entertainment, social, gaming, short-form content, creator platforms, or other engagement-driven consumer products.

    • Strong practical expertise in two-tower models, embedding-based retrieval, candidate generation, ranking algorithms, and offline and online model evaluation.

    • Strong product intuition and understanding of relevance, engagement, retention, user satisfaction, cold-start problems, and content distribution.

    • Ability to transform complex and imperfect behavioral data into useful modeling signals and measurable product improvements.

    • Solid engineering fundamentals spanning machine learning development, data pipelines, backend integration, experimentation frameworks, and production deployment.

    • Demonstrated ownership, rapid execution, analytical thinking, and clear communication in ambiguous, fast-paced product environments.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and product teams while independently driving complex projects from concept to launch.

    • Preferred: Experience with AI-powered recommendations, LLM-based ranking, semantic search, personalized content generation, or AI-native content understanding.

    • Preferred: Familiarity with user-generated content ecosystems, creator marketplaces, or rapidly changing content catalogs.

    • Preferred: Experience with multimodal machine learning involving text, images, video, interaction data, or AI-generated content.

    • Preferred: Knowledge of explore-exploit strategies, contextual bandits, reinforcement learning, or long-term user value optimization.

    • Preferred: Startup experience or a track record of building machine learning systems from the ground up with limited infrastructure.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation: A strong overall compensation package.

      • Equity opportunity: Meaningful equity participation.

      • Healthcare coverage: Comprehensive health insurance and benefits.

      • Remote-first flexibility: A remote-first working environment.

      • Technical ownership: Opportunities to lead significant machine learning initiatives and influence product and architecture decisions.

      • Innovation-driven culture: The opportunity to explore emerging AI technologies and develop new approaches to personalized discovery.

      • High-impact work: The chance to shape consumer experiences at the intersection of artificial intelligence, social products, and interactive entertainment.

title: Parts Associate
description:
SUMMARY

The TMHS Parts associate is dedicated to providing top level support to customers, technicians and sales associates in need

of repair parts. You will be responsible for using the data provided to locate the correct parts required as well as making

recommendations for associated parts needed to do the job right in an efficient manner. Ultimately, you will maintain and

improve our brand, ensuring that we exceed the customers’ expectations with exceptional product knowledge and superior

customer service skills.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The parts associate is the person responsible for locating and supplying parts for the customer. He/she must have above

average people skills and adequate product knowledge that enables you to know all the applicable parts required to do

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
'Safe journeys, every time'. This is what we strive for at Safe Transport Victoria (ST Vic).

As the safety regulator for commercial passenger vehicles, buses and maritime, what we do impacts the everyday lives of Victorians. Our role is to work with these industries and the communities they serve to ensure a transport system that inspires confidence for users.

Company description:

About Us

'Safe journeys, every time'. This is what we strive for at Safe Transport Victoria (ST Vic).

As the safety regulator for commercial passenger vehicles, buses and maritime, what we do impacts the everyday lives of Victorians. Our role is to work with these industries and the communities they serve to ensure a transport system that inspires confidence for users.

We are focused on creating impact by being an intelligence-led regulator, agile to technological disruptions in the market and highly responsive to community expectations and needs.

We are also in the business of thinking big. We are reimagining what's possible in how we regulate, and we welcome those who are interested in reshaping and redefining how we work.

Safe Transport Victoria is committed to building a culture of 'working as one'. This means our people share openly, question respectfully and build together. This also means we invest in our people and provide personal and professional development programs to create a workforce that is empowered, innovative and adaptable.

Job description

Job Title

Senior Data Engineer

VPS Level

VPS 6

Salary

$142,790 - $191,084 plus superannuation

Work type

Fixed Term - 12 months

About the Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Platform the role is responsible for the development, maintenance, and improvement of the Data Platform and related Cloud environment. Providing technical leadership within the team, the role leads the engineering integrity of the ST Vic data platform and ensures data solutions are fit for purpose and support the Data Strategy.

The responsibilities of the Senior Data Engineer will include, but are not limited to:

  • Develop Organisational Capability - Apply your knowledge of external factors relating to capability development such as demographic trends, skills shortages and future workforce requirements.

  • Lead and Navigate Change - Identify long-term organisational changes.

  • Outcomes Thinking - Be up to date with the STV operational requirements and formulate strategies that align organisational deliverables with community expectations.

  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement - Drive a culture of quality by design where quality practices are embedded in the service and solution delivery process.

Using your credentials related to data science, mathematics, actuary, statistic or related fields, you will bring demonstrated experience working in high volume, high impact Data Literacy environments. Your experience in formulating complex data models or algorithms has enabled you to develop and maintain data architectures, including databases and large-scale processing systems. You have contributed to improved production reliability and created the environment for improved data quality decisions by your stakeholders.

About You

You will be known for and highly respected by your colleagues and leaders for your thought leadership and have been involved in building organisational capability in data literacy. Your deep expertise in formulating complex data models or algorithms and using advanced statistical techniques has led you to be a subject matter expert in this field.

Qualifications

Tertiary qualifications in Statistics, Engineering, Maths, Computer Science, Finance, Marketing, Economics or another relevant quantitative discipline will be highly regarded along with strong working experience in a data engineering capability.

Further Information

For a confidential discussion, please contact Dylan Matthews, Senior Manager Data Platform via email **************@safetransport.vic.gov.au.

It is an inherent requirement of this position that the employee is ready, willing, and able to perform work outside their ordinary place of residence, including at ST Vic workplaces.

Other relevant information

Preferred candidates will be required to undertake pre-employment screening, including a Declaration and Consent form and a National Police Check.

To be eligible for appointment to this role, applicants will possess corresponding work rights for the advertised employment period. Appointment to an ongoing position is only available to an Australian/New Zealand citizen or an Australian Permanent Resident.

What we offer you?

ST Vic is committed to building a culture of flexible work arrangements, providing professional development programs and supporting ways of working that help employees balance work and life. We welcome applicants from a diverse range of backgrounds, including veterans, people who identify as Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, have a disability, are from varied cultural backgrounds and those who identify as LGBTIQ+.

ST Vic is committed to providing a safe and healthy workplace for all its people, including contractors and visitors. We have a strong focus on initiating wellness events for our people to foster a sense of enjoyment and positive mental health. In some instances, ST Vic also offers flexible working arrangements.

Diversity and Inclusion

ST Vic's broad diversity program enables us to attract, recruit, retain and develop a diverse workforce to foster greater innovation, greater customer connection and increased wellbeing and satisfaction.

Learning and Development

We want you to grow, develop and learn with us! ST Vic provides you with access to a range of internal and external learning and development opportunities to support your performance in your role and further your career aspirations.

title: Senior Technical Trainer — Machine Learning
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Trainer — Machine Learning based in Brazil.

We are seeking a hands-on machine learning practitioner with a passion for teaching to design and deliver engaging technical courses for engineers. In this remote freelance role, you will help learners progress from core machine learning concepts to training and evaluating their own models through practical, lab-based learning. You will collaborate with curriculum specialists and production teams to develop clear lessons, hands-on exercises, and real-world demonstrations. The focus is on sharing your technical expertise through compelling scripts, video presentations, and lab walkthroughs rather than managing production tasks. The initial paid course project typically lasts around three months and can be completed alongside existing professional commitments. With flexible hours and a delivery plan agreed in advance, the opportunity may lead to further projects or a full-time position.

Accountabilities

  • Design and develop course content: Collaborate with the curriculum team to define course structure, sections, lessons, practical labs, and notebooks that support progressive learning.

  • Create hands-on learning experiences: Write detailed lab specifications for the dedicated lab development team, then test the completed environments to ensure they work as intended.

  • Write engaging educational scripts: Develop short, story-driven video lessons of approximately six minutes each, making machine learning concepts accessible, intuitive, and relevant to engineers.

  • Deliver technical presentations: Narrate scripted lessons confidently in English and record demonstrations and lab-solution walkthroughs that reinforce key concepts.

  • Apply practical machine learning expertise: Build course material grounded in real experience with training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models.

  • Incorporate editorial feedback: Work through structured reviews, particularly during the initial course section, and refine content to meet established quality and teaching standards.

  • Collaborate remotely: Coordinate with curriculum and production teams through weekly syncs and Slack, maintaining sufficient time-zone overlap with colleagues based in Europe and Asia.

  • Focus on teaching and technical content: Partner with the production team, which manages video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

    • Requirements:

    • Hands-on machine learning experience: Demonstrated ability to train, evaluate, and ship models using frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

    • Strong technical communication skills: Ability to explain machine learning concepts, including the reasoning behind different approaches, clearly to engineers who are new to the field.

    • Excellent English proficiency: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to write natural scripts, deliver clear narration, and communicate confidently on camera.

    • A genuine passion for teaching: Evidence of enjoying knowledge-sharing through online courses, tutorials, technical talks, workshops, mentoring, or other educational activities.

    • Current technical knowledge: An active interest in machine learning developments and a commitment to continuously learning and improving.

    • Presentation confidence: Comfort presenting technical material on camera in a clear, engaging, and accessible way.

    • Openness to feedback: Willingness to follow an established teaching methodology, collaborate with editors, and improve course content through structured feedback.

    • Preferred qualifications:

      • Experience publishing courses on platforms such as Udemy, Pluralsight, or Coursera, or creating educational content on YouTube.

      • Experience writing a technical book or teaching at a university, bootcamp, or similar educational setting.

      • Practical knowledge of fine-tuning, MLOps, or deploying machine learning models in production.

      • Cloud machine learning certifications related to AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or Databricks.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive project-based compensation: A fixed fee is agreed upfront for each course, based on its length and technical complexity, with competitive rates for advanced topics and exceptional instructors.

        • Flexible working arrangements: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with no fixed weekly-hour requirement and a delivery schedule agreed in advance.

        • Compatible with existing commitments: Complete the initial freelance course project alongside your current job or other professional responsibilities.

        • Defined project scope: The initial course project typically takes around three months, providing a clear timeframe for planning and delivery.

        • Payment upon completion: Receive the agreed course fee when the completed course is delivered.

        • Long-term career potential: Successful collaboration may lead to additional course projects or a full-time opportunity as part of a growing trainer network.

        • Dedicated production support: Focus on instructional content and teaching while the production team handles editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

        • Collaborative remote environment: Work closely with curriculum and production specialists through regular team syncs and Slack communication.

        • Professional visibility: Showcase your technical expertise and teaching ability by developing practical learning experiences for a broad engineering audience.

title: Executive Director, Key Accounts Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Executive Director, Key Accounts Lead based in the United States.

The Executive Director, Key Accounts Lead will drive strategic market access initiatives within the oncology space, helping ensure healthcare providers and patients can access innovative therapies with appropriate coverage and reimbursement. This senior leadership role combines field team management, strategic account development, and high-level stakeholder engagement across specialty group purchasing organizations, oncology networks, community oncology practices, integrated delivery networks, and clinical pathway organizations. You will work closely with commercial, medical, payer, and operational teams to develop effective access strategies and address complex reimbursement challenges. By translating market insights into actionable plans, you will help strengthen product positioning, support launch readiness, and improve patient affordability. This opportunity is suited to an experienced oncology market access leader who excels at building relationships, influencing decision-makers, and leading cross-functional initiatives in a dynamic, highly regulated environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Build, develop, and lead a field-based key accounts team responsible for specialty group purchasing organizations, oncology aggregators, community oncology practices, integrated delivery networks, and other market access stakeholders.

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned with business objectives to expand product access, strengthen reimbursement pathways, and support appropriate product positioning.

  • Establish and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, including formulary and Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) leaders, pathway committee members, medical and pharmacy directors, and other population-health stakeholders.

  • Represent the organization with oncology networks, professional associations, state societies, community oncology groups, and other influential access stakeholders.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Market Access, Medical Affairs, Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR), Commercial Operations, Regulatory, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Sales teams to address access barriers and develop coordinated solutions.

  • Co-develop field strategies, tools, and tactics that communicate product value effectively and support account engagement.

  • Contribute to pricing and contracting strategies, evidence-generation plans, patient support programs, payer marketing initiatives, and account management approaches.

  • Lead discussions and negotiations with internal and external partners to align coverage, reimbursement, and market access priorities.

  • Establish a high-performance team culture centered on accountability, urgency, ethical conduct, collaboration, and continuous professional development.

  • Monitor healthcare industry developments, payer policies, reimbursement trends, and competitive activity, translating insights into recommendations for strategic planning and product launches.

  • Ensure that all market access activities comply with applicable legal, regulatory, and ethical requirements.

  • Travel as needed to support business priorities and perform other related duties as assigned.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.

    • At least 15 years of experience in pharmaceutical payer strategy, group purchasing organization (GPO) strategy, pricing, and reimbursement.

    • At least 7 years of focused account management experience within the oncology market access landscape.

    • Demonstrated success engaging specialty GPOs, oncology aggregators, community oncology practices, and integrated delivery networks.

    • Strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare payer and market access landscape, reimbursement processes, and relevant regulatory requirements.

    • Proven leadership experience building and developing field teams, setting strategic priorities, and driving performance.

    • Strong strategic thinking, negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building capabilities.

    • Experience leading cross-functional teams and delivering complex projects in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to deliver compelling presentations and influence senior stakeholders.

    • A consistent track record of operating in compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, and operational standards.

    • Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, adaptability, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.

    • Willingness and ability to travel as required to support account engagement and business objectives.

    • Recent commercial launch leadership experience in oncology and experience in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) or lung oncology are relevant areas of expertise for this opportunity.

      • Benefits:

      • Base salary range: $228,000–$285,000 USD, with actual compensation determined by factors such as experience, skills, certifications, and work location.

      • Potential eligibility for additional compensation, including bonuses, stock-based compensation, and other applicable variable compensation.

      • Benefits are referenced as part of the overall compensation package; specific healthcare, retirement, paid leave, and other benefit details were not provided in the job description.

      • Remote-field work arrangement within the United States, with travel as required by business priorities.

title: Scheduling Planner
description:
The Scheduling Planner role is vital in controlling on time delivery, inventory levels, and revenue targets for the company. This role is responsible for developing high-level production schedules, analyzing constrained versus unconstrained capacity, understanding machining capabilities to offer capacity solutions, and driving future scheduling automation objectives.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Monitor flow of low mix / high volume production jobs. Includes controlling the flow through bottleneck resources and ensuring minimal disruptions throughout the rest of the supply chain.

· Support the Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) process, aligning demand forecasts with available production capacity.

· Analyze constrained versus unconstrained capacity scenarios to identify bottlenecks and problem solve for optimal outcome.

· Build and maintain capacity planning models incorporating machine hours, labor availability, and tooling constraints.

· Collaborate with Production, Planning, and Program Management to prioritize jobs and resolve scheduling conflicts.

· Maintain accurate data in the ERP/MRP system, including routings, standard times, and work center capacities.

· Track schedule adherence and analyze root causes of schedule slippage, driving corrective actions with cross-functional teams.

· Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to streamline scheduling, planning, and capacity analysis processes.

· Schedule and manage expedite requests in coordination with the sales team.

· Monitor ESB (Electronic Scheduling Boards) and work with Plant managers and Team leaders to maximize scheduling outcome in tandem with setup time reduction.

· Establish AR target and monitor monthly progress to ensure it is met.


Key Roles

· Production Scheduling & Capacity Management
Own high-level production scheduling across machining work centers and analyze constrained versus unconstrained capacity to optimize available resources.

· ERP/MRP Scheduling Management
Maintain accurate scheduling, capacity, and production data within the ERP/MRP system to support effective planning and execution.

· Expedite & Revenue Management
Manage expedite requests, establish and communicate expectations with Sales and Production, and monitor anticipated monthly revenue to identify and prioritize orders needed to achieve targets.

· Master Scheduling Support
Provide backfill and operational support for the Master Scheduler, ensuring continuity of scheduling activities and timely resolution of capacity and production issues.

Full salary range: $65,382.26 - $93,151.44 annually; moves to Grade 16 after license is obtained and training is completed $68,474.46 - $98,365.72 annually.
Work Schedule: Monday - Friday 7:00am - 3:00pm


Key Responsibilities

  • Works from manufacturer's manuals and specifications, blueprints, schematics and verbal instructions to install, repair, troubleshoot, inspect, check & maintain mechanical, electrical-mechanical & hydraulic systems including HVAC mechanical components, which may include those carrying refrigerant. Performs electrically related activities specified by work order.
  • Performs preventive and corrective maintenance on mechanical, electromechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic equipment according to vendor specifications.
  • Performs various non-licensed maintenance, repair & installation tasks related to plant equipment and systems in the areas of instrumentation and control, plumbing, heating, ventilation and air conditioning and electrical.
  • Fabricates devices and assemblies of sheet metal using powered and manual sheet metal forming tools.
  • Welds, brazes and solders using gas and electric equipment common to trade.
  • Operates equipment manually and through instrument panels and programmable logic control units as required in performance of maintenance tasks. Equipment may include, but will not be limited to, pumps, valves, gates, meters, gauges, controllers, motor control centers, level control devices, mixers, oxygen generation, chemical feed and odor control equipment.
  • Follows established safety, operating, and emergency response procedures and policies established by MWRA.
  • Operates motor vehicles, such as vans and pickup trucks, to pick up and deliver supplies and equipment to work sites.
  • Installs retrofits/installation of new equipment related systems, modification and alignment of existing equipment to specifications.
  • Supervises assigned Skilled Laborers, Building & Grounds Workers, and other maintenance personnel as needed.
  • Performs, documents and reports results in the MAXIMO database of inspections and work performed.
  • Performs work in compliance with the Operations Integrated Contingency Plan.
  • Assists other trades in the performance of their work, as required or as assigned.
  • Performs light maintenance independently or as part of a team. Light maintenance shall include but not limited to:
    • Operates forklift or other light equipment not requiring a special license.
    • Generates inspection lists and maintenance reporting through the Computerized Maintenance Management System
    • Inspects and troubleshoots various systems and equipment.
    • Installs and retrofits/new equipment related to plant systems.
    • Modifies and/or aligns existing equipment to specifications.
    • With proper safety training sets up ladders, staging and rigging and utilizes hoists, jacks, dollies, lifts, etc. for proper access to job and to remove and install equipment.
    • Operates portable pumping, ventilation and other equipment necessary to support and accomplish assigned tasks.
    • Greases and lubricates, replaces oil reserves, minor packing adjustments and opens hatches.
    • Installs safety rails, changes light bulbs and replaces HVAC filters.
    • Removes snow from immediate work area in order to perform tasks.
    • Conducts routine testing, lockout/tagout, operation (startup/shutdown) and adjustment of process equipment.
    • Performs necessary cleanup and housekeeping for work area and other light maintenance tasks.

Required Qualifications

  • A high school diploma or GED; or
  • Satisfactory completion of formal mechanic training program and at least two (2) years related experience, and
  • Satisfactory completion of training in accordance with the Productivity Improvement Program; or
  • Any equivalent combination of education or experience.
  • Possession of a Valid Class D Drivers License.
  • For DI and Clinton, a valid Grade II Wastewater Treatment Plant Operator's License or the ability to obtain the correct license within one (1) year.
  • For Southboro, a valid Water Distribution II or Treatment II License or the ability to obtain the correct license within one (1) year.
  • For Chelsea, a valid Grade II Wastewater Operator's License, Water Distribution II License, Water Treatment II License, or Collections Systems II License or the ability to obtain the correct license within one (1) year.
  • Complete competency based training program related to ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES as outlined above and successfully demonstrates required competencies.
  • This position has been designated as essential in instances where the MWRA Executive Director requires essential personnel to report to work such as inclement weather or other emergencies.

Knowledge and Abilities

  • Basic reading, writing, mathematical and oral communication skills.
  • Thorough knowledge of the standard practices, materials, tools, occupational hazards and safety practices common to the trade.
  • Skills in the operation of tools, instruments and equipment of the trades.
  • Computer skills necessary to access and use the Maximo & Lawson Database.
  • Trained in Confined Space Entry, CPR and First Aid, and must be capable of entering, setting-up, installing, disassembling confined space equipment and ability to work in a confined space.
  • Ability to attain knowledge and work processes required to perform maintenance tasks required by Reliability Centered Maintenance or similar Maintenance Management Program.

Tools and Equipment Used

Motor vehicle, power and hand tools, hoist, mobile truck radio, beeper.


Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the essential functions the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, feel or operate objects, tools, or controls and reach with hands and arms. The employee frequently is required to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, talk or hear, sit, climb, or balance. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, peripheral vision and the ability to adjust focus.


Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee regularly works in outside weather conditions. The employee occasionally works near moving mechanical parts and is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions and vibration. The employee occasionally works in high, precarious places and is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals. The job is hearing protection required and the noise level in the work environment is very loud in field settings and moderately loud at pumping stations.

title: Senior Technical Trainer — Machine Learning
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Trainer — Machine Learning based in Belgium.

We are seeking a hands-on machine learning practitioner with a passion for teaching to design and deliver engaging technical courses for engineers. In this remote freelance role, you will help learners progress from core machine learning concepts to training and evaluating their own models through practical, lab-based learning. You will collaborate with curriculum specialists and production teams to develop clear lessons, hands-on exercises, and real-world demonstrations. The focus is on sharing your technical expertise through compelling scripts, video presentations, and lab walkthroughs rather than managing production tasks. The initial paid course project typically lasts around three months and can be completed alongside existing professional commitments. With flexible hours and a delivery plan agreed in advance, the opportunity may lead to further projects or a full-time position.

Accountabilities

  • Design and develop course content: Collaborate with the curriculum team to define course structure, sections, lessons, practical labs, and notebooks that support progressive learning.

  • Create hands-on learning experiences: Write detailed lab specifications for the dedicated lab development team, then test the completed environments to ensure they work as intended.

  • Write engaging educational scripts: Develop short, story-driven video lessons of approximately six minutes each, making machine learning concepts accessible, intuitive, and relevant to engineers.

  • Deliver technical presentations: Narrate scripted lessons confidently in English and record demonstrations and lab-solution walkthroughs that reinforce key concepts.

  • Apply practical machine learning expertise: Build course material grounded in real experience with training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models.

  • Incorporate editorial feedback: Work through structured reviews, particularly during the initial course section, and refine content to meet established quality and teaching standards.

  • Collaborate remotely: Coordinate with curriculum and production teams through weekly syncs and Slack, maintaining sufficient time-zone overlap with colleagues based in Europe and Asia.

  • Focus on teaching and technical content: Partner with the production team, which manages video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

    • Requirements:

    • Hands-on machine learning experience: Demonstrated ability to train, evaluate, and ship models using frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

    • Strong technical communication skills: Ability to explain machine learning concepts, including the reasoning behind different approaches, clearly to engineers who are new to the field.

    • Excellent English proficiency: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to write natural scripts, deliver clear narration, and communicate confidently on camera.

    • A genuine passion for teaching: Evidence of enjoying knowledge-sharing through online courses, tutorials, technical talks, workshops, mentoring, or other educational activities.

    • Current technical knowledge: An active interest in machine learning developments and a commitment to continuously learning and improving.

    • Presentation confidence: Comfort presenting technical material on camera in a clear, engaging, and accessible way.

    • Openness to feedback: Willingness to follow an established teaching methodology, collaborate with editors, and improve course content through structured feedback.

    • Preferred qualifications:

      • Experience publishing courses on platforms such as Udemy, Pluralsight, or Coursera, or creating educational content on YouTube.

      • Experience writing a technical book or teaching at a university, bootcamp, or similar educational setting.

      • Practical knowledge of fine-tuning, MLOps, or deploying machine learning models in production.

      • Cloud machine learning certifications related to AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or Databricks.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive project-based compensation: A fixed fee is agreed upfront for each course, based on its length and technical complexity, with competitive rates for advanced topics and exceptional instructors.

        • Flexible working arrangements: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with no fixed weekly-hour requirement and a delivery schedule agreed in advance.

        • Compatible with existing commitments: Complete the initial freelance course project alongside your current job or other professional responsibilities.

        • Defined project scope: The initial course project typically takes around three months, providing a clear timeframe for planning and delivery.

        • Payment upon completion: Receive the agreed course fee when the completed course is delivered.

        • Long-term career potential: Successful collaboration may lead to additional course projects or a full-time opportunity as part of a growing trainer network.

        • Dedicated production support: Focus on instructional content and teaching while the production team handles editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

        • Collaborative remote environment: Work closely with curriculum and production specialists through regular team syncs and Slack communication.

        • Professional visibility: Showcase your technical expertise and teaching ability by developing practical learning experiences for a broad engineering audience.

title: Experienced Municipal Water Engineer
description:
Job Purpose

Provide civil engineering support for ongoing electrical and water transmission and distribution, technical services, generation, and telecommunication projects. Independently perform and coordinate engineering activities, provide technical guidance to internal and external customers, and administer contract responsibilities as needed. Work with other departments, contractors, consultants, and customers to coordinate and schedule project work.

The Civil Engineer II is responsible for performing engineering assignments requiring demonstrated experience, technical knowledge, and independent engineering judgment.

Specific Responsibilities

  1. Monitor, coordinate, and provide engineering support for construction and maintenance projects, including:

    • Coordinate work with contractors, consultants, and internal departments.
    • Review and update construction standards, specifications, and engineering practices.
    • Apply engineering principles and judgment to evaluate alternatives and develop appropriate solutions.
    • Design and assist with the layout of electrical transmission and distribution lines, including substation structures.
    • Coordinate, interpret, and prepare electrical and water transmission and distribution, technical services, generation, and telecommunication system studies and computer models.
    • Design and document civil and structural components of projects, including site surveys and inspections, grading and drainage systems, foundations, structures, and roadways.
    • Prepare and review engineering drawings, specifications, cost estimates, and other project documentation.
    • Provide technical support during construction and assist in resolving design, field, and construction issues.
    • Monitor project progress to help ensure work is completed in accordance with plans, specifications, schedules, and applicable standards.

  2. Coordinate engineering activities with industrial and commercial customers, including providing guidance regarding MPW policy, technical requirements, service installations, and other engineering-related matters.

  3. Provide technical guidance and engineering support to other departments related to civil and structural components of utility projects.

Other Responsibilities

  1. Assist the Chief Operations Engineer with technical matters related to the operation and maintenance of electrical and water transmission and distribution, technical services, generation, and telecommunication systems.

  2. Support system reliability improvement efforts, including the development, population, analysis, and use of databases used to track failure, maintenance, and outage-related issues.

  3. Assist in the development of the annual operating and capital budgets and appropriate departmental projections.

  4. Coordinate engineering consultants and contractors as assigned, including reviewing technical documents, project requirements, and completed work.

  5. Participate in project planning, scheduling, cost estimating, and construction coordination activities.

  6. Provide technical guidance and support to less experienced engineering staff as appropriate.

  7. Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Knowledge

  1. Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline required.

  2. Minimum of two years of relevant engineering experience required; utility experience preferred.

  3. Registration as a Professional Engineer in the State of Iowa preferred, or demonstrated progress toward licensure. If obtained, licensure must be maintained while employed in the position.

  4. Knowledge of civil and structural engineering principles and their application to utility infrastructure and construction projects.

  5. Knowledge of applicable local, state, and federal codes, regulations, and engineering standards governing electrical and water transmission and distribution systems and related infrastructure.

  6. Knowledge of engineering design, construction practices, project coordination, and contract administration.

  7. Familiarity with CAD and GIS applications preferred.

Skills

  1. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  2. Excellent interpersonal and listening skills, with the ability to build productive professional relationships and promote a team atmosphere.

  3. Strong project management and coordination skills.

  4. Sound engineering judgment, analytical, and reasoning skills.

  5. Strong problem identification, analysis, and problem-solving skills.

  6. Ability to communicate technical information effectively to employees, contractors, consultants, customers, and other stakeholders.

  7. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Word at an intermediate level and Excel at an advanced level.

Abilities

  1. Ability to work effectively as part of a team and serve as a project or technical lead when assigned.

  2. Ability to independently perform engineering assignments and exercise sound engineering judgment within established policies, standards, and procedures.

  3. Ability to drive results and ensure work is completed properly, safely, accurately, and in a timely manner.

  4. Ability to effectively prioritize work, manage multiple projects and assignments, meet deadlines, and adjust priorities to meet department and organizational objectives.

  5. Ability to develop, read, review, and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, specifications, technical reports, and manuals.

  6. Ability to plan and coordinate engineering activities involving multiple departments, contractors, consultants, and customers.

  7. Ability to identify engineering and construction issues and develop practical solutions.

  8. Ability to distinguish colors.

Other Position Requirements

  1. Must be able to attend work on a regular basis and work extended hours as needed.

  2. Must maintain a method of communication in order to be contacted by MPW outside normal work hours.

  3. Must maintain required professional licenses or certifications, if applicable to the position.

Work Environment

  1. Work is performed primarily in an office environment with periodic work at construction sites, utility facilities, industrial facilities, and other field locations. Fieldwork may be performed in varying weather and site conditions.

  2. Must comply with all safety requirements and site rules at all locations.

title: Manager, Land Development
description:
Fervo Energy is building the most cost-effective, repeatable geothermal power plants in the world — requiring a durable land and resource portfolio, disciplined long-range planning, and the ability to secure the resources, rights, and agreements needed for growth. As Fervo scales from first-of-a-kind projects to fleet-wide deployment, we're seeking a Manager — Land Portfolio to lead the company's land portfolio maturation strategy and its integration into the great Fervo Team’s long-range planning. This role reports to the Sr. Director of Land, Environmental and Permitting, working extensively with Sr. Management and individual contributors across the wide ranging Fervo Team.


The role partners with internal and external stakeholders to develop and execute the company's land resource portfolio development strategy and is focused on the full development lifecycle—from initial site evaluation, acquisition, and access through permitting, drilling, construction, interconnection and into long-term operations. The ideal candidate combines deep land acquisition, subsurface development, and energy production expertise with strong analytical and communication to prepare and develop our geothermal energy production land portfolio.

title: Software Engineer
description:
iSelect and Compare the Market are trusted, well-known brands dedicated to helping millions of Australians compare and buy personal finance and household products such as insurance, energy, and loans. Together, we provide a seamless, customer-focused experience that makes it easier for Australians to find the right products to suit their needs.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Software Engineer, you'll contribute to the development and ongoing enhancement of software solutions that deliver real value to our customers. Working as part of a collaborative Agile team, you'll apply modern engineering practices to build secure, scalable and high-quality applications while continuously improving the way we deliver technology.

Software Development:

Develop and maintain scalable, secure and reliable digital products and services. Write clean, well-tested code, follow established engineering standards, and contribute to code reviews to support the delivery of high-quality software.

Technical Strategy & Innovation:

Contribute to technical design discussions, technology selection and solution development. Participate in Agile ceremonies and embrace DevSecOps principles, with a focus on automation, CI/CD, security and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication:

Collaborate effectively with developers, product owners, project managers and solution architects to deliver business outcomes. Communicate technical concepts clearly and contribute to a positive and high-performing team culture.

Continuous Learning & Growth:

Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies and engineering best practices. Actively participate in knowledge sharing, team initiatives and professional development opportunities.

AI & Emerging Technologies:

Utilise AI-powered tools and emerging technologies to improve development efficiency, automate routine tasks, enhance code quality, and accelerate software delivery while maintaining security, governance and engineering standards.

What’s In It For You

At Compare the Market and iSelect, we’re all about helping people make smart choices – and joining us might just be yours.We offer an environment where your ideas are heard, your contributions are valued, and your growth genuinely matters. Collaboration is part of our DNA and you’ll be joining a supportive, forward-thinking team where you can do meaningful work (and be recognised for it!)

Plus, we offer a range of great perks to help you thrive both in and out of work:

  • Vibrant and social community who have annual celebrations, family fun days and regular events
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements, including the option of one day working from home each week or a 9-day fortnight
  • Enjoy additional leave days - ‘ME’ leave and ‘Volunteer Day’ leave
  • Free coffee on Mondays
  • Option to purchase additional leave
  • Return To Work bonus for returning parents
  • Quarterly Award and Recognition program

What Sets You Apart

  • 3+ years of software development experience in full-stack environments.
  • Experience with AWS cloud technologies, serverless and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with modern CI/CD practices, observability, and end-to-end software development.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and a passion for leveraging emerging technologies to improve productivity, code quality, testing, and software delivery outcomes.
  • Experience in regulated industries and hybrid delivery models is desirable.

At Compare the Market and iSelect we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we embrace diversity.

This role is available to candidates with unlimited Australian working rights only. Sponsorship is not available.

title: Supervisor, Cloud Technical Account Management
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Supervisor, Cloud Technical Account Management based in the United States

We are seeking a commercially minded technical leader to oversee and grow a cloud Technical Account Management (TAM) service while leading a high-performing team of technical account managers and cloud services engineers. In this role, you will combine people leadership, cloud technology expertise, sales enablement, and financial management to drive sustainable service growth. You will partner closely with sales and customer success teams to develop new opportunities, expand existing accounts, improve customer retention, and increase recurring revenue. You will also own service performance reporting, financial forecasting, profitability analysis, and resource planning to guide strategic decisions. As a key escalation point for complex customer issues, you will ensure consistent service quality while building scalable processes and developing team capabilities. This is an opportunity to shape a growing cloud services practice in a collaborative, customer-focused environment

Accountabilities

  • Lead the growth and commercial performance of the Cloud Technical Account Management service, partnering with sales leadership, account executives, and customer success managers to position the offering for new and existing cloud customers.

  • Act as the subject matter expert for the TAM service during sales engagements, participating in customer calls, presenting service capabilities, scoping requirements, and supporting proposals and pricing discussions.

  • Develop sales enablement materials, including pitch decks, value propositions, qualification criteria, and customer success stories, to strengthen sales effectiveness.

  • Identify and advance upsell, cross-sell, expansion, and service attachment opportunities across the existing customer base.

  • Support customer retention and renewals by ensuring customers understand the value and business impact of the service.

  • Collaborate with Product and Pricing teams to refine service packaging, pricing structures, and market positioning using customer feedback and commercial insights.

  • Manage the service sales pipeline in Salesforce, monitoring opportunity stages, forecast accuracy, bookings, and win/loss trends in partnership with sales teams.

  • Build and maintain a financial model covering service revenue, delivery costs, team utilization, customer-level margins, and overall profitability.

  • Develop dashboards and reporting processes to track pipeline, bookings, recurring revenue, churn, utilization, customer health, and financial performance.

  • Provide regular financial and operational updates to the Director of FTS, highlighting trends, risks, business performance, and recommended actions.

  • Forecast revenue and staffing requirements and prepare business cases for team expansion based on bookings, utilization, and profitability.

  • Use customer-level financial and utilization data to guide pricing decisions, account assignments, staffing levels, and resource allocation.

  • Supervise Cloud Technical Account Managers and cloud services engineers, providing daily direction, prioritization, coaching, and operational support.

  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, establish clear performance objectives, lead performance reviews, and maintain accountability for service quality and commercial outcomes.

  • Lead recruitment, hiring, and onboarding in collaboration with the Director of Managed Services and People and Culture teams.

  • Coach team members to recognize expansion opportunities, communicate service value effectively, and contribute to account growth.

  • Develop individual growth plans and promote cross-training between account managers and engineers to strengthen shared expertise and team flexibility.

  • Allocate customer accounts and engineering resources based on technical requirements, account complexity, profitability, skill sets, and available capacity.

  • Act as the escalation point for critical customer issues, major incidents, and executive-level concerns.

  • Ensure consistent delivery of technical reviews, customer health checks, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and root cause analysis (RCA) reviews.

  • Manage a limited portfolio of strategic customer accounts when business needs require direct involvement.

  • Establish and maintain operational standards, service playbooks, and repeatable processes that support scalable, profitable service delivery.

    • At least 7 years of experience in technical account management, customer success, solutions engineering, or managed services.

    • At least 2 years of formal or informal leadership experience overseeing technical or customer-facing teams.

    • Demonstrated success partnering with sales teams to grow a service line or book of business, with measurable results against revenue or bookings targets.

    • Experience supporting sales activities, developing customer expansion opportunities, and contributing directly to revenue generation.

    • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience with financial reporting, forecasting, business performance metrics, and dashboard development.

    • Proven ability to coach, develop, and hold team members accountable while fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture.

title: Client Intake and Information Specialist
description:
Organization Overview:

Minnesota Assistance Council for Veterans (MACV) is a statewide nonprofit organization with a mission to end Veteran homelessness in Minnesota. MACV provides comprehensive programs in the areas of housing, employment, and legal services to support Veterans and their families throughout Minnesota who are homeless or at risk of homelessness. MACV operates a budget over $14 million annually and has a team of approximately 100 employees throughout Minnesota. The organization has office locations throughout the state, with administrative functions centralized within a headquarters office based in St. Paul.

MACV offers a competitive benefits package that includes healthcare coverage, dental, vision, life, STD and LTD insurance, generous paid time off, retirement benefits, 12 holidays per year, paid parental leave, paid family and medical leave, technology and wellness reimbursement programs, tuition reimbursement, continued professional development support, and more.


Position Overview:

This position serves as a primary point of contact for Veterans seeking assistance from MACV and for community partners making referrals. The Intake Coordinator is responsible for assessing eligibility, gathering necessary information, coordinating referrals, and ensuring Veterans are connected to appropriate services in a timely manner.


The Intake Coordinator must be able to communicate professionally with a wide range of individuals, manage multiple priorities, and remain organized and composed in challenging or rapidly changing situations. The ideal candidate is professional, poised, resourceful, and able to use sound judgment while balancing the needs of Veterans, community partners, and internal staff.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Conduct initial screening and assessment of Veteran eligibility for MACV services through phone, email, walk-in contacts, website requests, and referrals from community partners.
  • Review and assess information to determine appropriate next steps and connect Veterans with MACV or other community resources.
  • Process, document, and forward eligible referrals for assignment to appropriate case management staff.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of Veteran contacts, referrals, dispositions, and services in shared databases and client tracking systems.
  • Communicate eligibility determinations and referral outcomes to Veterans and community partners as appropriate.
  • Obtain additional documentation or information from Veterans and referral sources as needed to facilitate timely assistance.
  • Respond professionally and effectively to Veterans, community providers, and other stakeholders, including during situations involving urgency, uncertainty, or competing needs.
  • Identify barriers to assistance and use sound judgment and problem-solving skills to determine appropriate next steps.
  • Manage multiple referrals, communications, and administrative responsibilities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Maintain client confidentiality in accordance with MACV policies and applicable regulations.
  • Provide administrative support to the Northern Region as needed, which may include financial, operational, reporting, and other organizational processes.

Key Skills and other Characteristics

  • Communicate confidently and professionally with Veterans, community partners, service providers, and internal staff.
  • Demonstrate a poised and respectful presence, particularly when navigating difficult, emotional, or high-pressure situations.
  • Be highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities and competing demands without losing attention to detail.
  • Exercise sound judgment and problem-solving skills when information is incomplete, circumstances are changing, or immediate solutions are not obvious.
  • Experience working with databases, client tracking systems, or other information management systems.
  • Learn new systems and processes quickly and use technology confidently to manage information and workflows.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

title: Senior Technical Trainer — Machine Learning
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Trainer — Machine Learning based in Netherlands.

We are seeking a hands-on machine learning practitioner with a passion for teaching to design and deliver engaging technical courses for engineers. In this remote freelance role, you will help learners progress from core machine learning concepts to training and evaluating their own models through practical, lab-based learning. You will collaborate with curriculum specialists and production teams to develop clear lessons, hands-on exercises, and real-world demonstrations. The focus is on sharing your technical expertise through compelling scripts, video presentations, and lab walkthroughs rather than managing production tasks. The initial paid course project typically lasts around three months and can be completed alongside existing professional commitments. With flexible hours and a delivery plan agreed in advance, the opportunity may lead to further projects or a full-time position.

Accountabilities

  • Design and develop course content: Collaborate with the curriculum team to define course structure, sections, lessons, practical labs, and notebooks that support progressive learning.

  • Create hands-on learning experiences: Write detailed lab specifications for the dedicated lab development team, then test the completed environments to ensure they work as intended.

  • Write engaging educational scripts: Develop short, story-driven video lessons of approximately six minutes each, making machine learning concepts accessible, intuitive, and relevant to engineers.

  • Deliver technical presentations: Narrate scripted lessons confidently in English and record demonstrations and lab-solution walkthroughs that reinforce key concepts.

  • Apply practical machine learning expertise: Build course material grounded in real experience with training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models.

  • Incorporate editorial feedback: Work through structured reviews, particularly during the initial course section, and refine content to meet established quality and teaching standards.

  • Collaborate remotely: Coordinate with curriculum and production teams through weekly syncs and Slack, maintaining sufficient time-zone overlap with colleagues based in Europe and Asia.

  • Focus on teaching and technical content: Partner with the production team, which manages video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

    • Requirements:

    • Hands-on machine learning experience: Demonstrated ability to train, evaluate, and ship models using frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

    • Strong technical communication skills: Ability to explain machine learning concepts, including the reasoning behind different approaches, clearly to engineers who are new to the field.

    • Excellent English proficiency: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to write natural scripts, deliver clear narration, and communicate confidently on camera.

    • A genuine passion for teaching: Evidence of enjoying knowledge-sharing through online courses, tutorials, technical talks, workshops, mentoring, or other educational activities.

    • Current technical knowledge: An active interest in machine learning developments and a commitment to continuously learning and improving.

    • Presentation confidence: Comfort presenting technical material on camera in a clear, engaging, and accessible way.

    • Openness to feedback: Willingness to follow an established teaching methodology, collaborate with editors, and improve course content through structured feedback.

    • Preferred qualifications:

      • Experience publishing courses on platforms such as Udemy, Pluralsight, or Coursera, or creating educational content on YouTube.

      • Experience writing a technical book or teaching at a university, bootcamp, or similar educational setting.

      • Practical knowledge of fine-tuning, MLOps, or deploying machine learning models in production.

      • Cloud machine learning certifications related to AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or Databricks.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive project-based compensation: A fixed fee is agreed upfront for each course, based on its length and technical complexity, with competitive rates for advanced topics and exceptional instructors.

        • Flexible working arrangements: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with no fixed weekly-hour requirement and a delivery schedule agreed in advance.

        • Compatible with existing commitments: Complete the initial freelance course project alongside your current job or other professional responsibilities.

        • Defined project scope: The initial course project typically takes around three months, providing a clear timeframe for planning and delivery.

        • Payment upon completion: Receive the agreed course fee when the completed course is delivered.

        • Long-term career potential: Successful collaboration may lead to additional course projects or a full-time opportunity as part of a growing trainer network.

        • Dedicated production support: Focus on instructional content and teaching while the production team handles editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

        • Collaborative remote environment: Work closely with curriculum and production specialists through regular team syncs and Slack communication.

        • Professional visibility: Showcase your technical expertise and teaching ability by developing practical learning experiences for a broad engineering audience.

title: Clinician - Licensed or License Eligible
description:
What We Offer:

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Make a meaningful impact in the lives of individuals, families, and communities throughout Western Massachusetts.
  • Professional Growth – Access ongoing training, mentorship, career development, and advancement opportunities across one of the region's largest behavioral health organizations.
  • Supportive Team Culture – Join a collaborative workplace guided by our HEART values: Humanity, Empowerment, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork.
  • Stability & Opportunity – Build your career with a well-established organization serving Western Massachusetts since 1938.
  • Comprehensive Benefits – Generous PTO, 403(b), educational assistance, medical, dental, vision, employee assistance programs, and more.
  • Certified Great Place to Work – Work for an organization recognized for creating a positive and engaging employee experience.

What You Will Do:

As a Licensed Clinician, you will provide evidence-based counseling and case management services to individuals receiving medication for opioid use disorder (MOUD). Working collaboratively with physicians, nurses, recovery coaches, and other behavioral health professionals, you will help develop individualized treatment plans that promote long-term recovery and wellness.

Responsibilities include:

  • Conduct comprehensive biopsychosocial assessments and ongoing clinical evaluations.
  • Develop, implement, and update individualized treatment plans.
  • Provide individual, group, and family counseling using evidence-based practices.
  • Complete timely and accurate clinical documentation in the electronic health record.
  • Monitor client progress and adjust treatment interventions as appropriate.
  • Collaborate with medical providers, nursing staff, recovery coaches, and community partners to coordinate care.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings, case conferences, and utilization reviews.
  • Provide crisis intervention and risk assessments when necessary.
  • Educate individuals and families on addiction, recovery, relapse prevention, and community resources.
  • Maintain compliance with all federal, state, accreditation, and organizational standards, including confidentiality requirements.

Who You Are:

  • Master's degree in Social Work, Mental Health Counseling, Psychology, Marriage and Family Therapy, or a related behavioral health field.
  • Current Massachusetts licensure as LICSW, LMHC, LADC I, or equivalent or license-eligible and actively working toward independent licensure.
  • Experience providing behavioral health or substance use disorder treatment preferred.
  • Knowledge of trauma-informed, person-centered, and recovery-oriented care.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred.
  • Experience working in an Opioid Treatment Program (OTP), Medication for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD), or other substance use disorder treatment setting (preferred).

    PAY RANGE:

    Licensed Clinician: $75,000 - $81,000 per year

    Unlicensed (license eligible): $65,000 - $73,000 per year

    We Hire for HEART!

    Since 1938, BHN has delivered high-quality, culturally responsive behavioral health care, building deep roots in Western Massachusetts while expanding our impact in communities throughout the state. Our core values—Humanity, Empowerment, Accountability, Respect, and Teamwork—guide how we lead, serve, and support one another. If you’re ready to bring your skills and experience to a mission-driven organization where your work can make a meaningful difference, we’d love to hear from you.
